Get chalitza sheanu kotvin lah eno ella maase bet din kede sheyyihye beyadah reaya shennechletza veen haddayyanin choltzin ella im ken makkirin. lefichach mi sheraa zot shennechletza kotvin lah get chalitza af al pi sheenan makkirin shezzo hi bat peloni veeshet peloni veshezze shechalatz lah achiv hu. shehare haddayyanin shechaltza bifnehem hikkiru ze veachar kach chaltza:

Vezehu nusach get chalitza shennahagu bo haam: beyom peloni kach vechach leyerach peloni shenat kach vechach livriat alma leminyana deragilna lemimne bah bemakom peloni anachna dayyane demiktzatna chatimin letatta bemotav telata kachada havena yatvin beve dina uselika lokodamana pelonit barat peloni armelata difloni. vekarvat lokodamana gevar chad dishmeh peloni bar peloni. vechen amra lana pelonit da. peloni bar peloni dena achuha difloni bali meavuha hava dahavena nesiva leh veshachiv vechayye lerabbanan ulechol yisrael shavak. uvar uvarat yarit umachsin umokim shema beyisrael lo shavak. vehaden peloni achohi chazi leyibbumi yati. kean rabbanan amru leh i tzavi leyibbumi yati yeyabbem vei lo yitla li ragleh dimina kodomechon veashre seneh meal ragleh veerok beanpohi. veishtemodanuhu lifloni dena daachohi difloni mitna meavuhi hu vaamarna leh i tzavit leyibbume yatah yabbem vei lo atla lah kodomana raglach dimina vetishre senach meal raglach vetarok beanpach. veani veamar lana let ana tzavi leyibbume yatah. miyyad akrinuha liflonit da meen yevami lehakim leachiv shem beyisrael lo ava yabbemi. veaf lehay peloni akrinuhu leh lo chafatzti lekachtah. veatla lah ragleh dimina vesharat seneh meal ragleh verakat beanpohi roka deitchazi lana mippumah al ara. vetuv akrinuha liflonit da kacha yease laish asher lo yivne et bet achiv venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal. vaanachna dayyane vechol dehauu yatvin kodomana anenan batreh chalutz hannaal chalutz hannaal chalutz hannaal telat zimnin. umiddeitavid uvda da kodomana sharinuha liflonit da limhach lehitnasba lechol man detitzbe veinash lo yimche beyodah min yoma denan ulealam. uvait minnana pelonit da gitta dachalitzuta da uchetavna vachatamna vihavna lah lizchu kedat moshe veyisrael. peloni bar peloni ed. peloni bar peloni ed:

Umeidin alav shelosha o shenayim min hashshelosha o shenayim sherau hachalitza af al pi sheenan haddayyanin shechaltza bifnehen kemo shebbearnu. vaafillu ishsha o eved o katan shehu makkir venavon neemanin lomar ze peloni achi peloni vezo hi yevimto vecholtzin al pihen. ma sheen ken bishar eduyyot shel tora ben leedut mamon ben leedut issur. shezze davar heasuy lehiggalot hu efshar leda amittat haddavar shello mippihen kainyan shebbearnu besof hilchot gerushin. veim ratza hayyavam leyabbem mekaddesh umeyabbem vechotev lah ketubba kemo shehodanu:

Vezehu nusach ketubbat yevamin shennahagu haam: beyom peloni kach vechach leyerach peloni shenat kach vechach leminyan peloni leminyana deragilna lemimne bemakom peloni ech peloni ben peloni ata lokodamana vechen amar lana. achi demin abba shachiv vechayye lerabbanan ulechol yisrael shavak. uvar uvarat yarit umachsin umokim shema beyisrael lo shavak. veshavak hahi itteta dishmah pelonit bat peloni vechazi li min orayta leyibbume yatah kedichtiv besefer orayta demoshe yevamah yavo aleha. utzeviat pelonit da veityabbemat lifloni bar peloni yevamah leokume shema beyisrael kedichtiv vehaya habbechor asher teled yakum al shem achiv hammet vegomer. vechatav lah peloni yevamah liflonit yevimteh kesef zuze matan dechazu lah dahavu ketivin bichtubbatah dechatav lah balah kadmaa veosif lah middileh kach vechach veda neduneya dehanalat leh vechulei kishar tafse ketubbot:

Tavepas hakketuva: beyom peloni kulei. ech peloni ben peloni amar liflonit bat peloni betulta kallata hevi li leintu kedat moshe veyisrael vaana bememar dishmayya eflach veokir vaasovar veezun vaafarnes veichse yatichi kehilchot guvrin yehudain demokrin umesovrin vezanin umefarnesin umechassin yat neshehon bekushta. veyahivna lechi mohar betullechi kesef zuze matan deinun mizzuze kaspa 20"5 dechazu lechi middeorayta umezonaychi uchesutaychi vesippukaychi. umeal alaychi keorach kol ara. utzeviat pelonit da vahavat leh leintu lifloni dena. veratza vehosif lah tosefet al ikkar ketubbatah ad mishlam kach vechach veda neduneya dehanalat leh kach vechach hakkol nitkabbel chatan ze uva leyado venaase birshuto vezakaf hakkol al atzmo kemilve ureshu. vechen amar lana peloni chatana dena acharayut ketuvta kola ikkar ketubba uneduneya vetosefet ushear tenae ketubba kabbalit alay veal yartay batrai veal kol shefar arag nichsin vekinyanin deit li techot [kol] shemayya dekannai udeatid ana lemikna mimmekarkee umimmittaltele aggav mekarkee kullehon yehon achrain vearvain lichtubba da kola ikkar uneduneya vetosefet leitpara minnehon bechayyay uvatar moti vaafillu miggelima deal katfai. vekaninan mippeloni da mikkol may dichtiv umefarash leela kinyan shalem delo keasmachta udela ketofsa dishtare ella kechozek uchechomer kol shitre ketubbot hannohagot beyisrael vechahogen uchetikkun rabbotenu za"30 vechatamnu al shetar ketubba zo bazzeman hannizkar leel vehakkol barir vesharir vekayyam:

Veim hayta ketubbat almana kotev pelonit almenata. veim hayta ketubbat gerusha kotev pelonit haggerusha. vechen im hayta shevuya kotev pelonit hashshevuya kede shello yikkashel bah kohen. vechotev veyahivna lechi moharaychi kesef zuze mea deinun mizzuze kaspa teresar ufalga dechazu lechi vechulei:

Keshekkotvin get yevamin o ketubbat yevamin mesartet mekom happesukim. sheasur lichtov shalosh tevot belo sirtut. vivama shechaltza mutteret lehinnase beyom chalitzatah shehare enah choletzet ad shettashlim tishim yom:

Hayevama shennatan lah hayyavam get keritut pesalah ufasal et tzaroteha alav veal shear haachin shehare naasa kemi shechalatz lah. veen hagget moil bivama ella middivrehen hoil vehagget megaresh eshet ish. vechol get shepposel ishto min hakkehunna posel et yevimto min hayyibbum veenah mutteret lezar ad sheyyachalotz lah:
Hammaamar af al pi sheeno kone bivama kinyan gamur veenah naaset bo eshet ish gemura tzericha mimmennu get veenah nitteret lezar ella bachalitza:

Ketzad. haose maamar bivimto veeno rotze livol tzarich lichtov lah get shehare nitkaddesha lo. vetzarich lachalotz lah kede lehattirah lezar. sheen hayevama nitteret lezar ella achar beilat hayyavam o achar chalitza. aval hagget poslah leyibbum veeno mattirah lezar. vehammaamar eno kone bah kinyan gamur kemo habbeila:
Natan maamar livimto vechazar venatan get lemaamaro ma sheasa hare bittelo vehuttera. veyerae li shello huttera ella leechav aval ze shennatan hagget asura hi lo:
Natan get lezikkato [velo lemaamaro] pesalah alav veal shear haachin kemo shebbearnu utzericha get lemaamaro vachalitza lehattirah lezar:

Hammaamar shennittan livama techilla velo kedamo davar acher velo naasa acharav davar acher ella shebbaal otah ze shennatan lah hammaamar hu hannikra maamar kasher. veim kedamo get o chalitza ben miyyavam ze ben miyyavam acher ben bah ben betzaratah. vechen im kedamattu beila betzaratah ben mimmennu ben meechav. o shennaasa acharav get o chalitza ben bah ben betzaratah ben mimmennu ben meechav. o shebbaal o natan maamar acher letzaratah ben hu ben achiv. o shennatan lah achiv maamar acher o bealah hare ze nikra maamar pasul. ben hammaamar shekkedamuhu hammaasim haellu ben hammaamar shennitacharu acharav:

Ketzad. natan get o chalatz livimto vechazar venatan maamar lah o letzaratah ben hu ben echav. o shebba al yevimto o natan lah maamar vechazar venatan lah maamar acher letzaratah ben hu ben echav. o shennatan maamar livimto vechazar achiv venatan lah maamar acher o bealah hare ze maamar pasul ben hammaamar harishon ben hammaamar haacharon:

Nimtzeta lamed shehammaamar ben shekkedamo maamar acher o get o chalitza o beila. ben shekkadam hammaamar leechad meellu. hare ze maamar pasul. chutz min hannoten maamar uvaal beila achar hammaamar shezzo hi kehilchatah:

Habbeila shebboel hayyavam et yevimto techilla o achar maamaro bah velo kedamah davar acher nikret beila keshera. veim kedamah maamar meechav o get ben mimmennu ben meechav ben bah ben betzaratah. o shekkedamah maamar betzaratah ben mimmennu ben meechav hare zo nikret beila pesula:

Hachalitza shecholetz hayyavam livimto techilla im lo kedamah davar acher nikret chalitza meulla. veim kedamah get o maamar ben miyyavam ze ben meechav ben bah ben betzaratah hare zo nikret chalitza pechuta:

Yevamot rabbot habbaot mibbayit echad kevan shennivala achat mehen beila keshera o nechletza chalitza meulla hutteru hakkol venistalleka zikkat hayyavam mealehen. veim nivala achat mehen beila pesula o nittan lah maamar pasul neesru kullan leyibbum utzericha get zo shennivala o shennittan lah maamar. utzericha chalitza [kol] achat mehen lehattiran lezar. sheen zikkat hayyibbum mistalleket bivila pechuta:

Nechletza achat mehen chalitza pechuta huttera lehinnase lezar zo shennechletza aval tzaratah asura ad shettachalotz gam hi o ad sheyyachletzu kol haachin larishona shennechletza hachalitza happechuta. sheen chalitza pechuta mesalleket zikkat yibbum mibbayit ze ad shettachazor al kol haachin o ad shettechaletz kol achat mehen:

Kol yevama shennivala livamah ben beila keshera ben beila pesula. vaafillu bealah achar shechalatz lah ben hu ben echav ben leshem ishut ben leshem yabbemut. vaafillu baal tzaratah achar shebbaal beila keshera ben hu ben echav. hare zo tzericha get shehare naaset eshet ish babbeila. vechen kol yevama shennittan lah maamar ben maamar kasher ben maamar pasul hare zo tzericha get mippene hammaamar kemo shebbearnu veachar kach yasur issur hammaamar:

Kevar amarnu sheen hagget doche hayevama dechiyya gemura vechen hammaamar eno kone bah kinyan gamur. aval habbeila kona kinyan gamur. vehachalitza docha otah dechiyya gemura. lefichach get achar get bivama o maamar achar maamar moil. aval beila achar beila vachalitza achar chalitza en haacharona moelet kelum. vechen get o chalitza achar habbeila enah kelum:

Ketzad. yavam shennatan get livimto vechazar venatan get letzaratah hare ze asur bikrovot shetehen. vechen shene yevamin shennatnu shene gittin livama achat ze achar ze hare zo kigrusha lishnehen ushenehen asurin bikrovoteha veechad mehen choletz. vechen im natan get livimto vechazar venatan achiv get letzaratah kol echad asur bikrovot zo shennatan lah hagget. vechen im natnu maamar achar maamar kemo shebbearnu. aval hayyavam shechalatz livimto vechazar vechalatz letzaratah ben hu ben achiv. vechen shete yevamin shechaltzu ze achar ze livama achat en chalitza acharona kelum veen hacholetz otah baacharona asur bikrovoteha. shezze kecholetz lishar hannashim sheen lo alehen zikka:

Vechen habboel yevimto vechazar ben hu ben achiv vechalatz lah o letzaratah en chalitza zo kelum. vechen im chazar achiv venatan get lah o letzaratah eno kelum. chazar achiv venatan lah maamar o baal lo asa kelum meachar shebbaal achiv techilla kana kinyan gamur veen hakkiddushin tofsin beeshet ish. aval im natan maamar letzaratah o baal tzaratah tzericha get mimmennu kemo shebbearnu:

Shene yevamin sheyyibbemu shete yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad velo noda mi yibbem techilla shenehen yotziu beget veyutteru lezarim vaasurot layvamin. lefichach reuven shehaya birushalayim velo shete nashim achat beakko veachat betzor veshimon achiv beakko velevi achiv betzor veshamu shemmet reuven haddin noten shello yeyabbem echad mehen ad sheyyivvada me asa achiv shemma kadam veyibbem. kadam echad mehen veyibbem en motziin miyyado ad sheyyivvada sheachiv yibbem techilla. ratza haechad lachalotz kodem sheyyada me asa achiv en monin oto:

Yavam katan ben tesha shanim veyom echad biato kemaamar min haggadol sheeno kone kinyan gamur. umaamar ben tesha shanim veyom echad im netano battechilla moil vahare hu posel bo al haggadol aval im netano bassof eno kelum. vegitto vachalitzato enam kelum ben battechilla ben bassof:

Ketzad. ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto o shennatan lah maamar techilla pesalah al shear achin. aval im asa haggadol maamar bivimto vechazar ben tesha shanim veyom echad venatan lah o letzaratah maamar lo asa kelum velo pesalah al achiv haggadol. chazar ben tesha shanim veyom echad uva aleha o al tzaratah achar maamar achiv haggadol pesalah al haggadol kishne gedolim sheasu maamar achar maamar kemo shebbearnu:

Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto vechazar achiv haggadol uva aleha o chalatz o natan get lah o letzaratah hare ze pesalah al hakkatan. vechen im chazar hakkatan uva al tzaratah o ba achiv haacher shehu ben tesha shanim veyom echad aleha o al tzaratah nifsela alav kedin kol maamar umaamar:

Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto vehigdil velo ba aleha mishshehigdil tzericha get vachalitza. get mippene biato shehi kemaamar vachalitza lehattirah lezar shehare lo nivala beila shekkona kinyan gamur. veim ba aleha mishshehigdil hare zo tzericha get bilvad:
Echad ben tesha shanim veyom echad. veechad ben esrim shana shello hevi shete searot velo noldu bo simane saris kemo shebbearnu bitchillat hassefer:

Ketanna sheruya lemaen. vehachereshet. af al pi shekkiddushe shetehen middivre sofrim kemo shebbearnu shene mine kiddushin hen. ketanna yesh lah kiddushin kede shello yinhagu bah minhag hefker. vekiddusheha teluyin ad shettagdil. vechereshet tikkenu lah nissuin kede shello tishshaer penuya leolam. lefichach im hayu kol hayevamot habbaot mibbayit echad ketannot o chershot biatah shel achat mehen poteret et kullan:

Hayta achat chereshet veachat ketanna en biat achat mehen poteret et tzaratah. vechetzad takkanatan. melammedin hakketanna shettemaen vechones et hachereshet. veim ratza legarshah kotev lah get achar sheyyavo aleha vetuttar lezar:

Hayta achat pikkachat veachat chereshet biat happikkachat o chalitzatah poteret hachereshet. veen biat hachereshet poteret happikkachat sheen kiddusheha ella middivrehen. vechen gedola uketanna biat haggedola o chalitzatah poteret hakketanna veen biat hakketanna poteret et haggedola:

Hayu shetehen ketannot haruyot lemaen uva hayyavam al achat mehen vechazar uva o hu o achiv al hashsheniyya lo pasal et harishona. aval melammedin et hashsheniyya shettemaen vikayyem ze yevimto hakketanna shennivala techilla:

Vechen haddin biktanna vechereshet shebba hayyavam techilla al hakketanna vechazar uva hu o achiv al hachereshet lo pasal et hakketanna vehachereshet tzericha get. shebbiat hakketanna meulla mibbiat hachereshet. shehakketanna reuya leachar zeman. lefichach yekayyem hakketanna shennivala techilla:
Ba hayyavam techilla al hachereshet vechazar uva hu o achiv al hakketanna pasal et hachereshet. umelammedin hakketanna shettemaen vehachereshet yotza beget:

Hayu achat pikkachat veachat chereshet. ba hayyavam al happikkachat vechazar uva hu o achiv al hachereshet lo pasal et happikkachat vehachereshet tzericha get. ba hayyavam al hachereshet vechazar hu o achiv uva al happikkachat pasal et hachereshet. vehachereshet yotza beget. vehappikkachat beget uvachalitza:

Hayu gedola uketanna uva al haggedola vechazar hu o achiv uva al hakketanna lo pasal haggedola umelammedin et hakketanna shettemaen. ba al hakketanna vechazar uva hu o achiv al haggedola. melammedin et hakketanna shettemaen vikayyem haggedola shebbeilatah kona kinyan gamur:

Yesh achin sheruyin leyibbum o lachalitza. veyesh achin sheenan reuyin lo leyibbum velo lachalitza veen lahen zikka kelal ella yevimto mutteret lezar. veyesh achin sheruyin lachalitza veenan reuyin leyibbum. veyesh achin shehen reuyin leyibbum veenan reuyin lachalitza:
Veellu hem sheen lahen zikka kelal. seris chamma veanderoginus mippene sheenan reuyin leled velo haya lahen sheat hakkosher:

Veellu meyabbemin velo choltzin. hacheresh vehashshote vehakkatan mippene sheen bahen daat lachalotz. uchesheyyibbem hacheresh eno motzi leolam shebbeilato osa otah eshet ish gemura veen gerushav gerushin gemurin. uven tesha shanim veyom echad sheyyibbem eno yachol legaresh ad sheyyagdil kemo shebbearnu:

Veellu choltzin velo meyabbemin. hassefekot kegon shehayta sefek erva al achiv. ufetzua dakka ucherut shafcha vechayyotze bahen mimmine hasserus. vehazzaken beyoter shettashash kocho vechashal. veim baal seris adam kana shehare hayta lo sheat hakkosher umotzi beget mippene shehu asur lavo bakkahal. vehattumtum choletz velo meyabbem mippene shehu safek. veim nikra venimtza zachar ratza choletz ratza meyabbem. ushear haachin o choltzin o meyabbemin:

Yesh yevamot shehen reuyot lachalitza o leyibbum. veyesh yevamot sheenan reuyot lo lachalitza velo leyibbum veen alehen zikka kelal umuttarot lehinnase lezar. veyesh yevamot shehen reuyot lachalitza aval lo leyibbum. veyesh yevamot shehen reuyot leyibbum aval lo lachalitza:
Veellu shemmityabbemot velo choltzot. hachereshet vehashshota vehakketanna lefi sheen bahen daat likrot ulehavin. veim ratza hayyavam legaresh hachereshet beget achar sheyyivol otah hare ze megaresh:

Veellu shecholtzot velo mityabbemot. issure lavin vehashsheniyyot veissure ase kemo sheyyitbaer. vechol ishsha shehi sefek megoreshet choletzet velo mityabbemet shemma yifga beerva. sheeshet achiv sheggershah asura alav mishshum erva. aval mi shehi mekuddeshet leachiv bisfek kiddushin hare hi kishar kol hayevamot vecholetzet o mityabbemet sheen kan davar lachush lo. vechen eshet hacheresh uzekena vaakara hare hen kishar kol hayevamot. ratza choletz ratza meyabbem. shezzekena vaakara hayta lahen sheat hakkosher:

Veellu hen shehen peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. eshet seris chamma veanderoginus veeshet hashshote veeshet hakkatan veaylonit umi shehi erva. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 6)</small> "velo yimmache shemo miyyisrael" perat lisris chamma veanderoginus sheshshemam machuy hoil veenan reuyin leled mittechillat beriyyatan hare hen kemin bifne atzmo. <small>(Devarim 25 6)</small> "vehaya habbechor asher teled" perat leaylonit sheenah reuya leled mittechillat beriyyatah. <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "lo tihye eshet hammet" perat leeshet shote vekatan mippene sheen lahem ishut kelal. <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "ulekachah lo leishsha" perat leerva sheen lo bah likkuchin:

Ketzad. yevama shehi erva al yevamah kegon shehayta achot ishto o immah o bittah hare zo petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum veen lo aleha zikka kelal shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "ulekachah lo leishsha veyibbemah". mi sheruya lelikkuchin vekiddushin tofsin bah hi zekuka leyavam:

Hayta hayevama asura al yevamah issur lav o issur ase o shehayta sheniyya hare zo choletzet velo mityabbemet. umippene ma tzericha chalitza mippene sheyyesh bah likkuchin hoil vekiddushin tofsin bahen hare hen zekukot leyavam. umin haddin haya sheyyityabbemu shehayyibbum mitzvat ase vechol makom sheatta motze ase velo taase yavo ase veyidche et lo taase. aval chachamim gazru shello yityabbemu chayyave lavin velo sheniyyot gezera shemma yavo aleha paam sheniyya vahare biatah asura veen sham mitzva sheen mitzvat ase ella bia rishona bilvad. lefichach im avar uvaal yevimto haasura lo mishshum lav o mishshum ase veen tzarich lomar sheniyya hare ze kana kinyan gamur umotziah beget vehi vechol tzaroteha muttarot lezar shehare nifteru:
Vivama shehi almana min hannissuin uva aleha kohen gadol lo niftera tzaratah sheen ase doche et lo taase vaase. vehoil velo kana min hattora kinyan gamur lo huttera tzaratah lezar ad shettachalotz:

Hayta hayevama erva al balah. kegon sheavar o taa velakach achoto meaviv venafla lifne achiv. en zo ishto sheen kiddushin tofsin bah veenah lo bat yibbum velo bat chalitza. veim hayta lah tzara choletzet [o] mityabbemet. veim hayta zo shehi erva al habbaal mutteret layyavam veratza hayyavam lissa otah uleyabbem tzaratah harshut beyado:

Hayta hayevama asura al balah mishshum lav o mishshum ase o shehayta sheniyya labbaal velo hayta asura al hayyavam mitztzad ellu hatztzedadim hare zo mutteret layyavam. chutz mimmachazir gerushato mishshennisset umet shehi choletzet velo mityabbemet. vechen yevama shehi sefek erva al hayyavam o sefek erva al balah hare zo choletzet velo mityabbemet. lefichach mi shekkiddesh ishsha bisfek kiddushin veachar kach met achiv shehaya nose achotah venafla lo leyibbum shehi sefek achot ishto hare zo choletzet velo mityabbemet. umotzi et ishto beget missafek ushetehen asurot alav. yevimto mippene shehi sefek erva vaarusato mippene shehi sefek kerovat chalutzato shehi kishniyya kemo shebbearnu:

Mi shemmet achiv vehinniach shete nashim haachat asura alav mishshum erva vehashsheniyya enah erva. keshem shehaerva petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum kach tzaratah petura velo nafla lo zikka kelal al bayit ze. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 9)</small> "asher lo yivne et bet achiv" bayit sheyyesh lo likkuchin bee ze mehen sheyyirtze hu sheyyesh lo alav zikka. uvayit shemmiktzato eno yachol livnoto shehare en lo bah likkuchin eno bone afillu miktzato shehu muttar. venimtzet tzarat haerva erva alav mishshum eshet achiv shehare en lo aleha zikka:

Lefichach reuven shemmet vehinniach shete nashim haachat erva al shimon ushetehen reuyot lelevi en leshimon zikka al bayit ze vahare shetehen tachat zikkat levi. yibbem levi haachat mehen shehi tzarat erva shel shimon vehayta lo ishsha acheret umet levi venaflu shetehen lifne shimon shetehen peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum mishshimon. haachat mippene shehayta tzarat erva vehashsheniyya mippene shehi tzaratah. vechen haddin betzarat tzaratah ad sof haolam. shekkol ishsha sheen lo aleha zikka beissur eshet ach omedet leolam:

Vechen eshet achiv shello haya beolamo hoil veen lo aleha zikka shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "ki yeshvu achim yachdav" ad sheyyeshvu shenehem baolam hare zo erva alav leolam mishshum eshet ach ufoteret tzaratah:

Ketzad. reuven shemmet vehinniach ishsha venafla lifne shimon veachar shemmet reuven nolad levi. ben shennolad levi kodem sheyyibbem lah shimon ben shennolad achar sheyyibbemah. hare eshet reuven erva al levi leolam. lefichach im met shimon venafla zo vetzaratah lifne levi shetehen peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum:
Asa shimon maamar bivimto eshet reuven umet kodem sheyyichnos otah hare levi choletz letzaratah velo meyabbem. sheen hammaamar kone bayvama kinyan gamur kemo shebbearnu:

Ishsha shezzinneta tachat balah beratzon uveedim umet kodem sheyyegarshenna venafla lifne yavam hare hi petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. vechen tzaratah keillu hayta erva al hayyavam mippene shettuma ketuva bah kaarayot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 13 14)</small> "vehi nitmaa". aval sota shemmet balah kodem sheyyashkenna me hammarim o sheenah bat shetiyya ella bat gerushin hare zo choletzet velo mityabbemet. veim hayta lah tzara hare tzaratah mutteret vecholetzet o mityabbemet:

Vechen shete yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad shehayta haachat mehen sheniyya al hayyavam o mechayyave lavin o mechayyave ase o aylonit hare tzaratah mutteret vecholetzet o mityabbemet. aval hacholetz livimto vehalcha achot chalutzato o immah vechayyotze bahen venisset leachiv velo ishsha acheret vamet venaflu shetehen lefanav. keshem shekkerovat chalutzato asura alav kach tzaratah asura. vahare shetehen kishniyyot lo vecholtzot velo mityabbemot. umippene ma asru tzarat kerovat chalutzato. mippene shemmitchallefet betzarat chalutzato:

Shete yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad shehaachat mehen erva al hayyavam vahare haerva aylonit. tzaratah mutteret vecholetzet o mityabbemet. hoil vehaaylonit enah bat yibbum vachalitza hare zo kemi sheenah. venafla zikkato al tzaratah bilvad. vechen im geresh achiv et haerva o meana bo kodem sheyyamut. o shemmeta bechayye balah veachar kach met achiv. hare tzaratah mutteret vecholetzet o mityabbemet. veen omrin hoil venaaset tzara leerva shaa achat teaser leolam. sheen hatztzara asura ad shettihye tzarat erva bishat nefila leyibbum:

Hayta zo shehi erva al hayyavam mekuddeshet leachiv shemmet besafek o megoreshet mimmennu besafek. o shehayta ketanna haruya lemaen velo meana beachiv bechayyav. af al pi shemmeana bayyavam tzaratah choletzet velo mityabbemet:
Halcha tzarat erva venisset leacher veachar kach nimtzet haerva aylonit. tetze hatztzara mibbalah umivamah utzericha get mibbalah vachalitza mivamah kede lehattirah lashshuk:
Yibbem hayyavam hatztzara mippene sheddimmu shehaerva aylonit venimtzet haerva sheenah aylonit tetze mivamah beget vehavvalad mamzer:

Shelosha achin. shenayim mehen nesuin shete achayot veechad mehen nasuy nachrit. met hannasuy nachrit veachar kach met echad mibbaale achayot. hare hannachrit choletzet velo mityabbemet mippene shehi tzarat achot ishto bezikkat achiv shemmet acharon. velo od ella afillu geresh echad mibbaale achayot et ishto achar shemmet hannasuy nachrit umet hamegaresh hare hannachrit choletzet velo mityabbemet hoil venaaset tzarat achot ishto bezikka shaa achat. sheim tityabbem shemma yavo leyabbem otah. vaafillu lo geresh ze shemmet acharon et ishto:

Umippene ma lo gazru davar ze bannissuin shehare tzarat erva bannissuin im geresh et haerva umet tzaratah mutteret layyavam kemo shebbearnu. mippene sheissur tzarat haerva bannissuin yadua lakkol veenan bain lehattir hatztzara im lo geresh haerva. veissur tzarat erva bezika eno yadua lakkol uvain lehattir hatztzara vaafillu lo nitgarsha haerva:

Shelosha achin nesuin shalosh nashim nachriyyot. met echad mehen veasa hashsheni maamar bivimto umet kodem sheyyichnos venaflu shetehen lifne hayyavam hare ellu choltzot velo mityabbemot. mippene shebbaalat hammaamar aleha zikkat shene yevamin. venimtzet keillu hi eshet shene metim. vedarshu chachamim veamru <small>(Devarim 25 5)</small> "eshet hammet" velo eshet shene metim. lefichach kol ishsha shealeha zikkat shene yevamin choletzet velo mityabbemet vechen tzaratah. veissuran middivre sofrim:

Umippene ma lo yachalotz levaalat hammaamar shealeha zikkat shene yevamin viyabbem tzaratah. gezera shello yomru shete yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad achat choletzet veachat mityabbemet. ulefichach asru af tzaratah:
Asa maamar bivimto venatan get lemaamaro umet chazra lehetterah. shehammaamar sheasarah hare bittelo. veratza choletz ratza meyabbem:

Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto umet keshehu katan venafla paam sheniyya lifne achiv haggadol hare zo choletzet velo mityabbemet. shebbiat ben tesha shanim veyom echad kemaamar min haggadol kemo shebbearnu venimtza aleha zikkat shene yevamin:

Mi shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha liruven venishtachrera vechazra venitkaddesha leshimon umetu shenehem mityabbemet lelevi veenah eshet shene metim. im kiddushe reuven kiddushin en kiddushe shimon kelum. veim kiddushe shimon kiddushin en kiddushe reuven kelum:

Shennayim min haachin nesuin lishte achayot umetu shenehem velo noda e ze mehem met rishon. hoil vei efshar leyabbem shetehen vahare zikka nafla al shetehen shetehen choltzot velo mityabbemot. vaafillu hayta achat mehen asura al hayyavam mishshum sheniyya o mechayyave ase o mechayyave lavin hare ellu choltzot velo mityabbemot. aval im hayta achat mehen erva alav kegon shehayta em ishto o bittah. hare achotah mutteret lo veratza choletz ratza meyabbem. shehare lo nafla zikkato al shetehen, sheen zikka al haerva:

Hayta achat mehen asura al yavam ze mishshum erva. vehaacheret asura al hayyavam hashsheni mishshum erva. haasura laze mutteret leachiv vehaasura laze mutteret leachiv. shehare nafla zikkat kol echad mehen al hammutteret lo bilvad. veratza choletz ratza meyabbem lezo hammutteret lo:
Met echad min haachin venafla ishto leyibbum veachar kach met sheni venafla ishto leyibbum shehi achot harishona vahare shetehen kayyamot. shetehen choltzot velo mityabbemot kemo shebbearnu:

Meta haacharona chazra harishona lehetterah vecholetzet o mityabbemet. meta harishona hare acharona beissurah omedet vecholetzet velo mityabbemet. shehare lo hayta reuya leyibbum bishat nefilatah. vechen im kadam echad min haachin vechalatz laacharona huttera harishona lishar haachin shehare hazzikka sheasra otah hesirah achiv bachalitzato:

Vechen im hayta harishona erva al echad min haachin vekadam veyibbem et haacharona shehi mutteret lo huttera harishona lishar haachin shehare haacharona sheasra otah alehen nityabbema lemuttar lah. aval im hayta haacharona hi sheasura al achat mehen bilvad mishshum erva hare hu meyabbem larishona ushear haachin asurin bishtehen vecholtzin velo meyabbemin kemo shebbearnu. veim kadmu vechansu kol echad achat min haachayot motziin otan mehen:

Shelosha achin shenayim mehen nesuin lishte achayot. met echad mibbaale achayot veasa hashshelishi bivimto maamar veachar kach met baal achot hashsheniyya venafla haachot hashsheniyya lifne haach hashshelishi. hare ze noten get levaalat hammaamar vecholetz lah vecholetz laachot haacharona kede lehattiran lezar:

Met ze sheasa hammaamar vehayta lo ishsha acheret venaflu shetehen lifne baal haachot. baalat hammaamar petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum shehare hi achot ishto. vehaishsha haacheret choletzet velo mityabbemet. sheen hammaamar kone kinyan gamur ad sheyyiftor et hatztzara:

Echad min hayevamin shekkiddesh achot yevimto omrin lo hameten veal tegarshenna veal tissaenna ad sheyyeyabbem achicha o yachalotz livama zo hazzekuka lechullechem. chalatz lah achiv o yibbemah o shemmeta hayevama hare ze yichnos arusato. metu echav kullam motzi et arusato beget vivimto bachalitza. veim meta arusato ben shemmeta kodem mitat haachin ben shemmeta leachar mitat haachin chazra hayevama lehetterah veratza choletz ratza meyabbem:

Shelosha achin shenayim mehen nesuin lishte achayot veyesh lechol achat mishshetehen tzara. umetu hannesuin et haachayot venaflu haachayot vetzarotehen lifne yavam. im chalatz latztzarot nifteru haachayot. aval im chalatz laachayot lo nifteru tzarotehen ad sheyyachletzu hatztzarot. mippene shechalitzat achayot chalitza sheenah meulla. vachalitza sheenah meulla enah poteret et hatztzara kemo shebbearnu:

Yerae li shekkach haddin bishte yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad vehaachat mehen asura al yevamah mishshum sheniyya o mechayyave lavin o mechayyave ase. sheim chalatz laasura lo huttera tzaratah. chalatz latztzara huttera haasura:

Shelosha achin shenayim mehen nesuin shete achayot vehashshelishi nasuy nachrit. met echad mibbaale achayot veyibbem hannasuy nachrit et ishto. veachar kach meta ishto shel sheni veachar kach met hashshelishi venaflu shete nashav lifne hashsheni (sheen lo ishsha). hare ellu peturot min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. haachat mippene shehayta achot ishto beshaa shemmet achiv harishon neesra alav leolam mishshum eshet ach kedin eshet achiv shello haya beolamo. vehannachrit mishshum tzaratah:

Vechen shene achin nesuin lishte achayot umet echad mehen. veachar kach meta ishto shel sheni. hare zo asura olamit hoil veneesra alav bishat nefila. aval hamegaresh et ishto vehechezirah vamet hare zo mutteret layyavam. veaf al pi shenneesra alav bechayye achiv beshaa sheggershah hare chazra lehetterah ucheshemmet achiv behetterah hayta omedet:

Ketanna shehissiah aviha vegershah balah vehechezirah umet vaadayin hi ketanna hare zo asura layyavam mippene sheggerusheha gerushin gemurin shehare aviha hissiah. veen chazaratah chazara gemura sheen kiddushe ketanna kiddushin gemurin kemo shebbearnu:

Vehu haddin limgaresh pikkachat venitcharsha vehechezirah umet vehinnichah chereshet shehi asura layyavam veenah choletzet velo mityabbemet. vetzarat ketanna zo o chereshet zo choletzet o mityabbemet. veim hechezirah keshehi ketanna o chereshet vegadla o nitpakkecha etzlo veachar kach met hare zo mutteret livamah:

Shene achin nesuin lishte achayot. hayu shetehen ketannot haruyot lemaen o chershot umet echad mehen tetze mishshum achot ishsha ufetura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. hayu achat gedola veachat ketanna umet baal hakketanna tetze mishshum achot ishsha ufetura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum. met baal haggedola melammedin hakketanna shettemaen bevalah vetihye gedola zo mutteret livamah:

Shene achin chershin nesuin lishte achayot pikchot o chershot. o achat pikkachat veachat chereshet. vechen shete achayot chershot nesuot lishne achim pikchin o chershin o echad pikkeach veechad cheresh umet echad mehen. ishto petura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum mishshum achot ishto. shehare en nissue echad mehen nissuin gemurin:

Shene achin echad pikkeach veechad cheresh nesuin lishte achayot pikchot o achat pikkachat veachat chereshet vahare happikkachat hi eshet happikkeach. met hacheresh tetze ishto mishshum achot ishsha. met happikkeach hoil venissue happikkeach shemmet nissuin gemurin vezikkat ze hacheresh gemura venissue hacheresh enan nesuin gemurin. hare ze hacheresh motzi et ishto beget mippene sheachotah zekuka lo. veeshet achiv happikkeach asura leolam sheeno yachol lichnos mippene achotah. velo yachalotz mippene shehu cheresh:

Velamma gazru chachamim sheyyotzi ze hacheresh ishto hachereshet vehen enan bene chiyyuv ella hare hen kekatan ochel nevelot sheen bet din metzuvvin lehaferisho. amru chachamim im teshev ishto immo nimtzet achotah nisset lezar veyomru niftera mishshum achot ishsha. lefichach motzi hacheresh ishto beget kede shettihye achotah asura leolam:

Vechen shene achin pikchin nesuin lishte achayot achat pikkachat veachat chereshet. met baal hachereshet tetze mishshum achot ishsha. met baal happikkachat motzi et ishto hachereshet beget veet eshet achiv bachalitza. mippene shehu pikkeach veyachol lachalotz:

Shene achin echad pikkeach veechad cheresh. hacheresh nasuy shete nashim pikchot haachat mehen erva al happikkeach umet hacheresh shetehen peturot al kol panim. im nissue haerva nissuin hare hashsheniyya tzaratah ufetura. veim en nissue haerva nissuin kach lo yihyu nissue tzaratah nissuin:
Hayta bitto vechayyotze bah chereshet unesua leachiv happikkeach tzaratah choletzet velo mityabbemet. sheen nissue hachereshet nissuin gemurin:

Kol makom sheamarnu bahalachot ellu shete achayot achat shete achayot o ishsha uvittah o ishsha uvat bittah vechayyotze bahen inyan haddevarim shehen shete nashim shehaachat mehen erva im haacheret vei efshar lissa shetehen mishshum erva. vechen kol makom sheamarnu achot ishto o achot yevimto echad achotah o immah o bittah inyan haddevarim achat mikkerovoteha shehen erva immah:

Mi shekkiddesh achat mishshete achayot veen yadua e ze mehen kiddesh umet velo ach. echad choletz lishtehen kede lehattiran laacherim. hayu lo shene achin echad choletz leachat mehen battechilla vehashsheni meyabbem lashsheniyya al kol panim. im zo hi shekkiddesh achiv hare yibbem otah. veim enah eshet achiv hare nasa ishsha mishshear hannashim vaachotah shehayta eshet achiv kevar nechletza. aval lo yeyabbem haachat techilla shemma haacheret hi eshet achiv venimtza shennasa kerovat zekukato. kadmu shene haachim vechansu shete hayevamot en motziin otan miyyadan:

Shenayim shekkiddeshu shete achayot. ze eno yodea e zo kiddesh veze eno yodea e zo kiddesh. umetu shenehen. laze ach velaze ach. ze choletz lishtehen veze choletz lishtehen. laze ach echad velaze shenayim. hayechidi choletz lishtehen battechilla vehashshenayim echad choletz rishona vehashsheni meyabbem. veim kadmu vechansu en motziin miyyadan. vaafillu hayu kohanim shehachalitza shechalatz hayechidi missafek chalatz vehachalutza asura lechohen middivre sofrim uvisfek chalutza lo gazru:

Hayu laze shene achin velaze shene achin. achiv shel ze choletz leachat veachiv shel ze choletz laacheret. veachar kach haach hashsheni shel ze meyabbem chalutzato shel ze. vehaach hashsheni shel ze meyabbem chalutzato shel ze. kadmu shenehen vechaltzu lishtehen lo yeyabbemu shene haachin haacherim. ella echad choletz battechilla veachiv meyabbem lashsheniyya. veim kadmu vechansu en motziin miyyadan:

Haishsha shehayu lah banim vehayu lechallatah banim venitabbera haishsha venitabbera kallatah veyaldu shetehen bemachavoa achat venitarvu shene hayeladim vehigdilu hattaarovot venasu nashim umetu. ketzad hen nittarot. bene hakkalla choltzin lishtehen techilla velo meyabbemin shekkol achat mehen safek shehi eshet achiv vetihye mutteret lo, safek shehi eshet achi aviv vehi erva alav. aval bene hazzekena o choltzin o meyabbemin. sheim hi zo eshet achiv hare yibbemah. veim hi eshet ben achiv mutteret lehinnase lo shekkevar nechletza:

Metu habbanim hayeduim shel zekena veshel kallatah vahare bene hattaarovot kayyamin. bene hattaarovot linshe bene hazzekena choltzin velo meyabbemin shehi sefek eshet achi aviv shehi erva alav, sefek eshet achiv shehi mutteret leyabbemah. velinshe bene hakkalla echad choletz battechilla veechad meyabbem al kol panim. im ben hakkalla hu shechalatz techilla hare chalatz eshet achiv vehashsheni min hattaarovot hu ben hazzekena umuttar lo lissa eshet ben achiv achar shennechletza mivamah. veim ze shechalatz techilla hu ben hazzekena hare chalatz leeshet ben achiv velo asa kelum vehashsheni min hattaarovot hu ben hakkalla vahare yibbem eshet achiv:

Mi shello shahata achar mitat balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda veen yadua im ben tisha larishon im ben shiva laacharon. vehayu lah banim min harishon umin hashsheni. im met ze habben hassafek. bene harishon uvene hashsheni choltzin leishto velo meyabbemin. shekkol echad mehen sheyyavo leyabbem shemma eno achiv meaviv vahare hu achiv meimmo bevadday veeshet achiv meimmo asura alav leolam mishshum erva. vechen ze habben hassafek choletz linshotehen velo meyabbem:

Haya ben larishon uven lashsheni shello meishsha zo shennisset betoch zeman umet echad mehen. hare habben hassafek choletz leeshet ze shemmet o meyabbem. sheim achiv meaviv hu hare yibbem et ishto veim eno achiv meaviv hare en benehen achava kelal lefichach muttar lo lissa et ishto:

Met habben hassafek echad mishshene habbanim havvaddain choletz leishto techilla vehashsheni meyabbem al kol panim. im achiv hu hare yibbem et ishto. veim eno achiv vehu ben haav haacher hare nechletza meachi balah:
Mi shehalach balah limdina acheret veshama shemmet venisset veachar kach ba habbaal harishon umetu shenehen velaze achin velaze achin. echav shel ze veechav shel ze choltzin velo meyabbemin:

Chamesh nashim shehaya lechol achat mehen ben yadua venitabberu chamishtan veyaldu keechad bemachavoa achat chamishsha banim acherim venitarvu hayeladim vehigdilu hattaarovot venasu nashim umetu chamishsha haanashim venaflu chamesh hannashim lifne chamishsha habbanim havvaddain sheen echad mehen yodea e zo hi eshet achiv ketzad takkanatan. arba mehen choltzin leachat techilla vehachamishi yissa zo shennechletza arba chalitzot al kol panim:

Ketzad. im eshet achiv hi hare yibbem otah. veim enah eshet achiv hare hi eshet ach echad mearbaa vahare chaltzu lah arbatan techilla. vechen hashsheniyya choltzin lah arbaa vehaechad min haarbaa yihye ze shennasa harishona vehachamishi yissaenna. ad shennimtzeu habbanim hachamishsha nasu hechamesh nashim achar shennechletza kol achat mehen arba chalitzot:

Uleolam hizzaher bechol hassefekot hallalu beikkarim ellu. shekkol mi shennistappek lecha shemma bat chalitza hi leish ze o enah tzericha lachalitza mimmennu. enah nitteret lehinnase lezar ad sheyyachalotz lah oto haish. vechol mi sheyyistappek lecha shemma biatah asura al ish ze ben middivre tora ben middivre sofrim enah mityabbemet lo. vechol shennechletza chalitza meulla o nivala beila keshera huttera tzaratah lezar:

Veal derech zo tavin vetore bechol hassefekot sheyyeeru leinyan yibbum vachalitza shehare bearnu kol haikkarin shealehen tismoch veteda mi hu shecholetz umi hu shemmeyabbem umi hi happetura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum umi hi haruya leyabbem: seliku lehu hilchot yibbum vachalitza besiyyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 1:
Kodem mattan tora haya adam pogea ishsha bashshuk im ratza hu vehi lissa otah machnisah letoch beto uvoalah beno leven atzmo vetihye lo leishsha. kevan shennittena tora nitztauu yisrael sheim yirtze haish lissa ishsha yikne otah techilla bifne edim veachar kach tihye lo leishsha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 13)</small> "ki yikkach ish ishsha uva eleha": 
Velikkuchin ellu mitzvat ase shel tora hem. uveechad mishshelosha devarim ellu haishsha niknet. bechesef. o bishtar. o bevia. bevia uvishtar mehattora. uvechesef middivre sofrim. velikkuchin ellu hen hannikrain kiddushin o erusin bechol makom. veishsha shenniknet beechad mishshelosha devarim ellu hi hannikret mekuddeshet o meoreset: 
Vechevan shenniknet haishsha venaaset mekuddeshet af al pi shello nivala velo nichnesa levet balah hare hi eshet ish vehabba aleha chutz mibbalah chayyav mitat bet din. veim ratza legaresh tzericha get: 
Kodem mattan tora haya adam pogea ishsha bashshuk im ratza hu vehi noten lah secharah uvoel otah al em hadderech veholech. vezo hi hannikret kedesha. mishshennittena hattora neesra hakkedesha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 18)</small> "lo tihye kedesha mibbenot yisrael". lefichach kol habboel ishsha leshem zenut belo kiddushin loke min hattora lefi shebbaal kedesha: 
Kol sheasar biato battora vechayyav al biato karet vehem haamurot befarashat <small>(Vayikra 16 1)</small> "achare mot" hen hannikraot arayot vechol achat mehen nikret erva kegon em veachot uvat vechayyotze bahen: 
Veyesh nashim acherot shehen asurot mippi hakkabbala veissuran middivre sofrim vehen hannikraot sheniyyot mippene shehen sheniyyot laarayot vechol achat mehen nikret sheniyya. veesrim nashim hen veellu hen. 1) em immo vezo en lah hefsek ella afillu em em em immo ad mala mala asura: 2) em avi immo bilvad: 3) em aviv vezo en lah hefsek ella afillu em em em aviv ad lemala asura: 4) em avi aviv bilvad: 5) eshet avi aviv vezo en lah hefsek afillu eshet yaakov avinu asura al echad mimmennu: 6) eshet avi immo bilvad: 7) eshet achi haav min haem: 8) eshet achi haem ben min haem ben min haav: 9) kallat beno vezo en lah hefsek afillu kallat ben ben ben beno ad sof kol haolam asura ad shettihye eshet echad mimmennu sheniyya al yaakov avinu: 10) kallat bitto bilvad: 11) bat bat beno bilvad: 12) bat ben beno bilvad: 13) bat bat bitto bilvad: yad) bat ben bitto bilvad: 15) bat ben ben ishto bilvad: 16) bat bat bat ishto bilvad: 17) em em avi ishitto bilivad: 18) em av em ishitto bilivad: 19) em em em ishitto bilivad: 20) em av avi ishitto bilivad. nimtzeu hashsheniyyot sheen lahen hefsek arba. em haem ad lemala. veem haav ad lemala. veeshet avi haav ad lemala. veeshet ben beno ad lematta: 
Kol sheasar biato battora velo chiyyev alav karet hen hannikraim issure lavin. veod nikrain issure kedushsha. vetisha hen veellu hen. almana lechohen gadol. gerusha o zona o chalala ben lechohen gadol ben lechohen hedyot. umamzeret leven yisrael. uvat yisrael lemamzer. uvat yisrael leammoni umoavi. uvat yisrael liftzua dakka. ucherut shafcha. ugerushato achar shennisset leacher. vivama shennisset lezar vaadayin reshut hayyavam aleha. hachalutza hare hi kigrusha vehi asura lechohen middivre sofrim. vehannetinim hare hem kemamzerim echad zecharim veechad nekevot veissuram middivre sofrim. uvehilchot issure bia yitbaer lecha ma hem hannetinim: 
Veyesh sheissur biatan baase veeno mechayyave lavin ushelosha hem. mitzri veedomi dor rishon vedor sheni echad zecharim veechad nekevot. uveula lechohen gadol. lefi shello neemar beellu lo yavo o lo yikkach ella mikkelal shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 9)</small> "dor shelishi yavo lahem bikhal Adonai" atta lamed sheddor rishon vesheni lo yavo. umikkelal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 13)</small> "vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach" atta lamed sheenah betula lo yikkach. velav habba mikkelal ase hare hu kaase:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 2:
Habbat miyyom ledatah ad shettihye bat 12 shana gemurot hi hannikret ketanna venikret tinoket. vaafillu hevia kamma searot betoch hazzeman hazze enam ella keshuma. aval im hevia shete searot lematta bagguf bammekomot hayeduot lahavaat sear vehi mibbat 12 shana veyom echad vamala nikret naara: 
Vahavaat shete searot bazzeman hazze nikra siman hattachton. umeachar shettavi siman hattachton tikkare naara ad shishsha chodashim gemurim. umittechillat yom tashlum hashshishsha chodashim vamala tikkare bogeret. veen ben naarut levagrut ella shishsha chodashim bilvad: 
Higgia leyv shana veyom echad velo hevia shete searot af al pi shenniru bah simane aylonit adayin ketanna hi ad esrim shana. ucheshettavi shete searot afillu bishnat esrim tihye naara shishsha chodashim veachar kach tikkare bogeret: 
Hayta bat esrim shana pachot sheloshim yom velo hevia shete searot veniru bah (kol) simane aylonit hare hi aylonit. veim lo niru bah (kol) simane aylonit adayin ketanna hi ad shettavi shete searot o ad shettihye bat 35 shana veyom echad: 
Higgia lazzeman hazze velo hevia shete searot hare zo nikret aylonit af al pi shello nire bah siman missimane aylonit. nimtzeta atta lamed shehaaylonit en lah yeme naarut ella mikkatnutah tetze levagrut: 
Veellu hen simane aylonit. kol sheen lah dadin. umitkashsha bishat tashmish. veen lah shippule meayim kenashim. vekolah ave veenah nikkeret ben ish leishsha. vehannaara vehabbogeret vehaaylonit kol achat mishshelashtan nikret gedola: 
Veyesh bevat simanin millemala vehen hannikrain siman haelyon. veellu hen. mishshettachazir yadeha leachorah veyease kemet (bimkom haddadin). umishsheyyashchir rosh haddad. umishsheyyitten adam yado al oketz haddad vehu shokea veshohe lachazor. umishsheyyippatzel rosh chotem haddad veyease berosho kaddur katan. verabbotay pershu mishsheyyippatzel hachotem atzmo. vechen mishsheyyittu haddadin. umishsheyyitkashkeshu haddadin. umishshettakkif haatara shehu mekom habbasar hattafuach shellemala min haerva leemmat habbeten. umishsheyyitmaech habbasar hazze velo yihye kashe: 
Kol ellu hassimanin shemona. nire babbat siman echad mikkol ellu o kullan vehi bat 12 shana o pachot en mashgichin bo vahare hi ketanna. naaset bat 12 shana veyom echad venire bah siman hattachton en mashgichin beechad mikkol ellu. veim lo nire hattachton venire bah echad mikkol ellu hare hi safek ben naara liktanna vedanim bah lehachamir. veim niru kullan [velo nire siman hattachton] hare zo gedola vaddait. shei efshar sheyyavou kullan ella kevar ba siman hattachton venashar: 
Habbat sheyyalda achar shetem esre shana af al pi shello hevia simanim lo tachton velo elyon hare zo gedola. banim hare hem kesimanin: 
Habben mishsheyyivvaled ad sheyyihye ben shelosh esre shana nikra katan venikra tinok vaafillu hevi kamma searot betoch hazzeman hazze eno siman ella shuma. hevi shete searot lematta bammekomot hayeduot lesear. vehu mibben shelosh esre shana veyom echad vamala nikra gadol venikra ish: 
Higgia lazzeman hazze velo hevi shete searot af al pi shenniru bo simane saris hare hu katan ad sheyyihye ben esrim shana pachot sheloshim yom. higgia lazzeman hazze velo hevi shete searot lematta velo hevi shete searot bazzakan. im nire bo echad missimane saris hare hu saris vedino din haggadol lechol davar. veim lo nire bo siman missimane saris adayin katan hu ad sheyyavi shete searot lematta bammakom harauy lahen o ad sheyyihye ben 35 shana veyom echad: 
Higgia lazzeman hazze velo hevi hare ze saris af al pi shello nire bo echad missimane saris. higgia lishnat esrim pachot sheloshim yom velo hevi shete searot lematta vehevi shete searot bazzakan af al pi shennolad lo echad missimane saris eno saris. ella hare hu bekatnuto ad sheyyivvaldu lo kol simane saris o ad sheyyihye ben 35 shana veyom echad: 
Veellu hen simane saris. kol sheen lo zakan. usearo lakuy. uvesaro machalik. veen meme raglav maalim reticha. ucheshemmetil mayim eno ose kippa. veshichvat zaro diha. veen meme raglav machmitzin. verochetz bimot haggeshamim veeno maale besaro hevel. vekolo lakuy veeno nikkar ben ish leishsha: 
Vesaris ze hu hannikra seris chamma bechol makom. aval habben shechatchu o nitteku o miachu gidav o betzav kemo shehaakkum osin hu hannikra seris adam. uchesheyyihye ben 13 shana veyom echad nikra gadol sheen ze mevi siman leolam: 
Ben 13 shana veyom echad shello hevi siman shellematta veniru bo kol hassimanin shel mala hare ze safek ben gadol lekatan. veim lo nivdak millematta kevan shennire bo simane bagrut millemala hare ze bechezkat gadol: 
Shete searot haamurot beven uvevat bechol makom shiuran kede lachof roshan leikkaran. umishsheyyitzmechu veyihyu yecholot lehinnatel befi hazzug ad sheyyaggiu lachof roshan leikkaran danin bahen lehachamir bechol makom. lefichach beven uvevat nachshov otam gedolim lehachamir hoil vetzamchu kede lehinnatel befi hazzug. venachshov otam ketannim lehachamir hoil velo higgiu lachof roshan leikkaran: 
Shete searot ellu tzerichot sheyyihyu bimkom haerva. uvet haerva kullo mekom simanin ben lemala ben lematta ben al evre hazzera atzman. utzerichot lihyot bemakom echad. vesheyyihye beikkaran gummot. vaafillu shetehen begumma achat hare ellu siman. nimtzeu shete gummot zo betzad zo veen bahen sear hare ellu siman. chazaka en gumma belo sear usearot hayu bahen venashru: 
Habbat shehevia shete searot betoch 12 shana vehabben shehevi betoch 13 shenehem shuma kemo shebbearnu. af al pi sheotan searot bimkoman hem omdot achar 13 lezachar veachar 12 linkeva enan siman: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshennivdeku betoch hazzeman venoda shehen shuma. aval im lo nivdeku ella achar zeman venimtzeu sham shete searot hare hen bechezkat simanin. veen omrin shemma kodem zeman tzamchu kede sheyyihyu shuma: 
Keshebbodkin habbat ben betoch hazzeman shehu kol shenat 12 ben kodem zeman ze ben leachar hazzeman bodkin al pi nashim kesherot veneemanot. vaafillu ishsha achat bodeket veshomin lah im hevia veim lo hevia: 
Kol hashshanim haamurot beven uvevat uveerchin uvechol makom enan lo shene hallevana velo shene hachamma ella shanim shel seder haibbur shehen peshutot umeebbarot al pi bet din kemo shehem kovin otan kemo shebbearnu behilchot kiddush hachodesh. uveotan hashshanim monin lechol divre haddat: 
En somchin al hannashim beminyan hashshanim velo al hakkerovim ella al pi shenayim anashim kesherim lehaid: 
Haav sheamar beni ze ben tesha shanim veyom echad. bitti zo bat shalosh shanim veyom echad neeman lekarban aval lo lemakkot velo loonashim. beni ze ben 13 shana veyom echad bitti zo bat 12 shana veyom echad neeman lindarim uleerchin velacharamot ulehekdeshot aval lo lemakkot velo loonashim: 
Mi sheyyesh lo evar zichrut veevar nekevut hu hannikra anderoginus vehu safek im zachar safek im nekeva. veen lo siman sheyyivvada bo im hu zachar vadday im hi nekeva vaddait leolam: 
Vechol mi sheen lo lo zichrut velo nekevut ella atum hu hannikra tumtum vegam hu safek. veim nikra hattumtum venimtza zachar hare hu kezachar vadday. veim nimtza nekeva hare hu nekeva. vetumtum veanderoginus shehayu ben shetem esre shana veyom echad hare hen bechezkat gedolim vehem shennedabber bahen bechol makom: 
Cheresh vechereshet haamurim bechol makom hen haillemim sheen shomin velo medabberim. aval mi shemmedabber veeno shomea o shomea veeno medabber hare hu kechol adam. veish veishsha shehen shelemim bedatan veenan lo chershim velo shotim nikrain pikkeach ufikkachat: 
Nimtzeu kol hashshemot shebbearnu inyanam bishne perakim ellu esrim shemot. veillu hen. kiddushin. erva. sheniyya. issure lavin. issure ase. ketanna. naara. bogeret. aylonit. gedola. siman hattachton. siman haelyon. katan. seris chamma. seris adam. gadol. anderoginus. tumtum. chershim. pikchim. sim kol hashshemot haellu leummatcha tamid veal yalozu meenecha kol inyenehem kede shello nihye tzerichin levaer kol shem mehen bechol makom shennazkir oto:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 3: Ketzad haishsha mitkaddeshet. im bechesef hu mekaddesh en pachot mipperuta kesef o sheve peruta. omer lah hare at mekuddeshet li. o hare at meoreset li. o hare at li leishsha baze. venoten lah bifne edim. vehaish hu sheomer devarim shemmashmaan shekkone otah lo leishsha vehu sheyyitten lah hakkesef:

Natna hi veamra lo hare ani mekuddeshet lecha. hareni meoreset lecha. hareni lecha leintu o bechol leshon hakenaa enah mekuddeshet. vechen im natna hi lo veamar hu enah mekuddeshet. veim natan hu veamra hi hare zo mekuddeshet missafek:
Veim kiddesh bishtar kotev al hanneyar o al hacheres o al heale o al kol davar sheyyirtze. hare at mekuddeshet li o hare at meoreset li vechol kayyotze bidvarim ellu venotno lah bifne edim:

Vetzarich sheyyichtov oto leshem haishsha hammitkaddeshet keget. veeno kotvo ella middatah. ketavo shello lishmah o lishmah shello middatah af al pi shennetano lah ledatah bifne edim enah mekuddeshet:

Veim kiddesh bevia omer lah hare at mekuddeshet li o hare at meoreset li o hare at li leishsha bivila zo vechol kayyotze baze. umityached immah bifne shene edim uvoalah. vehamekaddesh bevia (missetama) dato al gemar bia. uchesheyyigmor biato tihye mekuddeshet. (uven shebba aleha kedarkah uven shebba aleha shello kedarkah hare zo mekuddeshet):

Haddevarim sheyyomar haish kesheyyekaddesh tzarich sheyyihye mashmaam shehu kone haishsha velo sheyyehe mashma shehikna atzmo lah. ketzad. hare sheamar lah o shekkatav bashshetar shennetano lah. hareni balech. hareni arusech. hareni ishech vechol kayyotze baze. en kan kiddushin kelal. amar lah o katav lah. hare at ishti. hare at arusati. o hare at kenuya li. hare at shelli. hare at lekuchati. hare et charufati. hare at birshuti. hare at zekuka li vechol kayyotze bahen. hare zo mekuddeshet:

Amar lah o katav lah hare at meyuchedet li. hare at meyoedet li. hare at ezrati. hare at negdati. hare at tzalati. hare at segurati. hare at tachtay. hare at atzurati. hare at tefusati. hare zo mekuddeshet besafek. vehu sheyyihye medabber immah techilla al iske kiddushin. aval im eno medabber immah techilla al isike kiddushin en choshishin limillot ellu:

Veyesh laish lekaddesh haishsha bechol lashon shehi makkeret bo. veyihye mashma haddevarim beotah hallashon shekkenaah kemo shebbearnu. haya medabber im haishsha al iske hakkiddushin veratzta veamad vekiddesh velo peresh velo amar lah kelum ella natan beyadah o baal hoil vehen asukin bainyan dayyo veeno tzarich lefaresh. vechen ede hakkiddushin vehaggerushin eno tzarich lomar lahem attem eday. ella kevan sheggeresh o kiddesh bifinehem hare zo mekuddeshet o migoreshet:

Haomer leishsha hitkaddeshi lechetzyi hare zo mekuddeshet. ha lema ze dome leomer lah tehi ishti at veacheret shennimtza sheen lah ella chatzi ish. aval im amar chetzyech mekuddeshet li enah mekuddeshet sheen ishsha achat reuya lishnayim. vechen im omer hare at mekuddeshet li velaze enah mekuddeshet:

Amar lah hare chetzyech mekuddeshet li bifruta vechetzyech bifruta. o sheamar lah chetzyech mekuddeshet li bachatzi peruta vechetzyech haacheret mekuddeshet bachatzi peruta hare zo mekuddeshet. amar lah chetzyech mekuddeshet li bifruta hayyom vechetzyech bifruta lemachar. shete chatzayayich bifruta. shete benotecha lishne banay bifruta. bittecha mekuddeshet li ufaratcha mechura li bifruta. o bittecha vekarkaatcha li bifruta. bechol ellu mekuddeshet besafek:

Haav mekaddesh et bitto shello ledatah kol zeman shehi ketanna. vechen keshehi naara reshutah beyado shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 16)</small> "et bitti natatti laish hazze leishsha". vekiddusheha leaviha. vechen hu zakkay bimtziatah uvemaase yadeha uvichtubbatah im nitgarsha o nitalmena min haerusin hu zakkay bakkol ad shettibbager. lefichach mekabbel haav kiddushe bitto miyyom shettivvaled ad shettibbager. vaafillu hayta chereshet o shota vekiddeshah haav hare hi eshet ish gemura. veim hayta bat shalosh shanim veyom echad mitkaddeshet bevia middaat aviha. pachot mikken im kiddeshah aviha bevia enah mekuddeshet:

Bagra habbat en leaviha bah reshut vahare hi kishar kol hannashim sheenam mitkaddeshot ella ledatan. vechen im hissiah aviha venitalmena o nitgarsha bechayye aviha hare hi birshut atzmah veaf al pi sheadayin hi ketanna. kevan shennisset en leaviha bah reshut leolam:

Nitkaddesha kodem shettivgor shello ledaat aviha enah mekuddeshet vaafillu im nitratztza haav achar shennitkaddesha. vaafillu im nitalmena o nitgarsha min otan hakkiddushin enah asura lechohen. uven hi uven aviha yecholin leakkev. ben im nitkaddesha befanav ben shennitkaddesha shello befanav enah mekuddeshet:

Hayta habbat safek bogeret. ben shekkiddeshah aviha shello ledatah ben shekkiddesha hi atzmah shello ledaat aviha. hare zo mekuddeshet besafek lefichach tzericha get missafek. yesh laish laasot shaliach lekaddesh lo ishsha ben ishsha pelonit ben ishsha mishshear hannashim. vechen haishsha haggedola osa shaliach lekabbel kiddusheha ben meish peloni ben meish mishshear anashim. vechen haav ose shaliach lekabbel kiddushe bitto keshehi birshuto. veomer haav levitto hakketanna tzei vekabbeli kiddushayich:

Kol haose shaliach lekabbel hakkiddushin tzarich laasoto bifne edim. aval haish sheasa shaliach lekaddesh lo ishsha eno tzarich laasoto beedim sheen makom leedim bishlichut haish ella lehodia amittat haddavar. lefichach im hodu hashshaliach vehameshalleach enan tzerichin edim kemo sheliach hagget uchemo shaliach shehirshahu lehaferish lo teruma vechayyotze bahen bechol makom sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto veeno tzarich edim:

Hashshaliach naase ed lefichach im asa shene sheluchin lekaddesh lo ishsha vehalchu vekiddeshu otah hen hen sheluchav vehen hen ede hakkiddushin veenan tzerichin lekaddeshah lo bifne shenayim acherim:

Hakkol kesherin lishlichut chutz mecheresh shote vekatan lefi sheenan bene daat vehaakkum lefi sheeno bene berit veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 18 28)</small> "ken tarimu gam attem" lerabbot hashshaliach uma attem bene berit af sheluchachem bene berit lehotzi et haakkum. aval haeved af al pi shehu naase shaliach ledavar shebbemamon hare hu pasul lishlichut hakkiddushin vehaggittin lefi sheeno betorat gittin vekiddushin:

Sheliach haish shemmekaddesh omer lah hare at mekuddeshet lifloni bechesef ze o bishtar ze. im sheliach haishsha hu shemmekabbel hakkiddushin omer lo hare pelonit sheshshalcha otcha mekuddeshet li vehu omer lo kiddashtiha lecha o erastiha lecha o netattiha lecha leishsha vechol kayyotze baze. vechen hamekaddesh al yede haav omer lo hare bittecha pelonit mekuddeshet li vehu omer lo kiddashtiha lecha. im amar haav o hashshaliach hen dayyo vaafillu shatak. veim hayu asukin beoto inyan venatan laav o lashshaliach velo peresh velo amar davar dayyo vehi mekuddeshet. veim kiddesh bishtar eno kotvo ella middaat haav o middaat hashshaliach. vechen bechol haddevarim kullan shel kiddushin din haish im haishsha kedin shaliach im shaliach o im haav:

Mitzva sheyyekaddesh adam et ishto beatzmo yoter meal yede shelucho. vechen mitzva laishsha shettekaddesh atzmah beyadah yoter meal yede sheluchah. veaf al pi sheyyesh reshut laav lekaddesh bitto keshehi ketanna ucheshehi naara lechol mi sheyyirtze en rauy laasot ken ella mitzvat chachamim shello yekaddesh adam bitto keshehi ketanna ad shettagdil vetomar lifloni ani rotza. vechen haish en rauy lekaddesh ketanna. velo yekaddesh ishsha ad sheyyirenna vetihye keshera beenav shemma lo timtza chen beenav venimtza megarshah o shochev immah vehu sonah:

Hamekaddesh bevia hare ellu kiddushe tora. vechen mitkaddeshet bishtar min hattora. keshem sheggomer umegaresh shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 1)</small> "vechatav lah sefer keritut" kach gomer umachnis. aval hakkesef middivre sofrim (vechen din hakkesef din tora uferusho middivre sofrim) shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 13)</small> "ki yikkach ish ishsha" veamru chachamim likkuchim ellu yihyu bechesef shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 23 13)</small> "natatti kesef hassade kach mimmenni":

Af al pi sheikkar haddavar kach hu kevar nahagu kol yisrael lekaddesh bechesef o bishve kesef. vechen im ratza lekaddesh bishtar mekaddesh. aval en mekaddeshin bevia lechattechilla veim kiddesh bevia makkin oto makkat mardut kede shello yihyu yisrael perutzim bedavar ze af al pi shekkiddushav kiddushin gemurin:

Vechen hamekaddesh belo shidduchin o hamekaddesh bashshuk af al pi shekkiddushav kiddushin gemurin makkin oto makkat mardut kede shello yehe davar ze hergel liznut veyidme likdesha shehayta kodem mattan tora:

Kol hamekaddesh ishsha ben al yede atzmo ben al yede shaliach tzarich levarech kodem hakkiddushin o hu o shelucho kederech shemmevarchin al kol hammitzvot veachar kach mekaddesh veim kiddesh velo berech lo yevarech achar hakkiddushin shezzo beracha levattala ma shennaasa kevar naasa:

Ketzad mevarech. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vehivdilanu min haarayot veasar lanu et haarusot vehittir lanu et hannesuot al yede chuppa vekiddushin baruch atta Adonai mekaddesh yisrael. zo hi birkat erusin. venahagu haam lehasedir beracha zo al kos shel yayin o shel shechar. veim yesh sham yayin mevarech al hayyayin techilla veachar kach mevarech birkat erusin veachar kach mekaddeshah. veim en lo yayin o shechar mevarech otah bifne atzmah:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 4:
En haishsha mitkaddeshet ella lirtzonah vehamekaddesh ishsha beal karchah enah mekuddeshet. aval haish sheanasuhu ad shekkiddesh beal karcho hare zo mekuddeshet. veyesh laish lekaddesh nashim rabbot keachat vehu sheyyihye bechesef im kiddesh bechesef peruta lechol achat veachat. veyesh leachat mehen o leacher lekabbel hakkiddushin al yede kullan middatan: 
Hamekaddesh et haishsha venatan hakkiddushin middatah beyad chavertah veamar lachavertah keshennatan hakkiddushin beyadah veat nammi. o vechen gam at vechayyotze baze. hare shetehen mekuddashot. aval im natan beyadah veamar lah veat. hare zo shekkibbela hakkiddushin mekuddeshet besafek. shemma lo nitkavvin ella lirot ma belibbah ucheillu amar lah veat ma tomri bedavar ze. ulefichach kibbela hakkiddushin hi shehare ze adayin shoalah lirot ma belibbah umippene ze hi safek mekuddeshet: 
Amar lah hitkaddeshi li bedinar ze netalattu uzerakattu lefanav o layyam o laur o ledavar haaved enah mekuddeshet. amra lo tenehu leabba o leavicha o leish peloni venatan enah mekuddeshet. veim amra lo tenehu lo sheyyekabbelehu li venatan hare zo mekuddeshet: 
Amra hannichehu al hassela enah mekuddeshet veim haya sela shellah mekuddeshet. haya sela shel shenehem hare zo mekuddeshet besafek. amar lah hitkaddeshi li bechikkar ze amra lo tenehu leani afillu haya ani hassamuch aleha enah mekuddeshet. tenehu lakkelev hare zo enah mekuddeshet veim haya hakkelev shellah mekuddeshet. veim haya ratz achareha lenashchah veamra lo tenehu lechelev ze hare zo safek mekuddeshet: 
Haya mocher perot o kelim vechayyotze bahen baa ishsha veamra lo ten li meat meellu veamar lah im etten lach tehi mekuddeshet li. im amra hen venatan lah hare zo mekuddeshet aval im amra lo ten li mehen o hashelech li o devarim sheinyanam lo tischak immi bidvarim ellu ella ten li bilvad venatan enah mekuddeshet. vechen im haya shote yayin veamra lo ten li kos echad veamar lah im etten lach hare at mekuddeshet li bo veamra hashekeni hashekot o ten hasheke hashelech enah m [ke] deshet sheen haddevarim nirin ella hashekeni bilvad velo tischak immi bedavar acher: 
Hamekaddesh beed echad en choshshin lekiddushav veaf al pi sheshshenehem modin. kal vachomer limkaddesh belo edim. hamekaddesh bifsule edut shel tora enah mekuddeshet. bifsule edut shel divre sofrim o beedim shehen safek pesule tora im ratza lichnos chozer umekaddesh bichsherim veim lo ratza lichnos tzericha get mimmennu missafek. vaafillu kafra haishsha vehichchisha et haedim veamra lo kiddashtani kofin otah likkach get. vechen din kol kiddushe safek im ratza lichnos chozer umekaddesh vadday veim lo ratza lichnos tzericha get mimmennu missafek: 
Katan shekkiddesh en kiddushav kiddushin. aval gadol shekkiddesh et hakketanna hayetoma. o ketanna sheyyatza mershut aviha. im hayta pechuta mibbat shesh af al pi shehi nevonat lachash beyoter umakkeret umavchenet en kan shem kiddushin veenah tzericha lemaen. veim hayta mibbat eser shanim ulemala af al pi shehi sechala beyoter hoil venitkaddesha ledatah hare zo mekuddeshet lemeun. hayta mibbat shesh vead sof eser bodkin et yefi datah im makkeret umavchenet iske hannissuin vehakkiddushin tzericha lemaen. veim lav enah mekuddeshet lemeun veenah tzericha lemaen: 
Ketzad mekuddeshet lemeun. sheim nitkaddesha velo ratzta leshev im balah tzericha lemaen bifne shenayim velomar eni rotza bo veyotza belo get kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot gerushin. vezo hi hannikret memaenet. velamma yotza belo get mippene sheen kiddusheha kiddushin gemurin min hattora ella middivre sofrim vehen teluyin sheim yashva im balah ad sheggadla gamru kiddusheha venaaset eshet ish gemura veeno tzarich lachazor ulekaddeshah achar sheggadla. veim lo ratzta leshev tzericha lemaen vetetze belo get: 
Cheresh shennasa pikkachat vechen chereshet shennisset lefikkeach en kiddushehen gemurin min hattora ella middivre sofrim lefichach im ba pikkeach vekiddesh eshet cheresh happikkachat hare zo mekuddeshet lashsheni kiddushin gemurin venoten get vehi mutteret levalah hacheresh. aval hashshote shekkiddesh pikkachat o pikkeach shekkiddesh shota en kan kiddushin kelal lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim: 
Saris shekkiddesh ben seris chamma ben seris adam vechen aylonit shennitkaddesha hare ellu kiddushin gemurin: 
Tumtum veanderoginus shekkiddeshu ishsha o shekkiddeshan ish hare ellu kiddushe safek utzerichin get missafek: 
Hamekaddesh achat min haarayot lo asa kelum sheen kiddushin tofsin laerva chutz min hannidda shehamekaddesh et hannidda hare zo mekuddeshet kiddushin gemurin veen rauy laasot ken: 
Eshet ish sheppashta yadah vekibbela kiddushin meacher bifne balah hare zo mekuddeshet lashsheni. shehaishsha sheamra levalah befanav gerashtani neemenet chazaka en ishsha meizza paneha bifne balah. aval im kiddeshah acher shello bifne balah en kiddushin tofsin bah ad shettavi reaya shennitgarsha kodem shettekabbel hakkiddushin, kol shello befanav meizza: 
Hamekaddesh achat min hashsheniyyot o meissure lavin o meissure ase. vechen yavam shekkiddesh tzarat yevama. hare zo mekuddeshet kiddushin gemurin chutz mivama shennitkaddesha lezar shehi mekuddeshet besafek. nistappek lachachamim im hakkiddushin tofsin bivama kishar chiyyuve lavin o en kiddushin tofsin bah keerva. veaf al pi sheasur lo lichnos achat mikkol ellu hare ze megaresh beget: 
Hamekaddesh kutit o shifcha enan kiddushin ella hare hi achar hakkiddushin kemo shehayta kodem hakkiddushin. vechen akkum veeved shekkiddeshu bat yisrael en kiddushehen kiddushin. yisrael mumar shekkiddesh af al pi shehu oved akkum birtzono hare ellu kiddushin gemurin utzericha get mimmennu: 
Hamekaddesh ishsha shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin enah mekuddeshet kiddushin gemurin ad shettishtachrer vechevan shennishtachrera gamru kiddusheha kekiddushe ketanna sheggadla veeno tzarich lekaddeshah kiddushin acherim. ba acher vekiddeshah achar shennishtachrera hare ze safek kiddushin lishnehem: 
Vee zo hi shifcha charufa haamura battora zo mi shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shekkiddeshah eved ivri. umi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin shekkiddesh bat chorin hare zo safek kiddushin: 
Shikkor shekkiddesh kiddushav kiddushin veaf al pi shennishtakker harebe. veim higgia leshichruto shel lot en kiddushav kiddushin. umityashshevin bedavar ze: 
Hamekaddesh befachot mipperuta enah mekuddeshet. kiddeshah beochel o bichli vechayyotze bo sheshshave pachot mipperuta hare zo mekuddeshet besafek utzericha get missafek shemma davar ze shave peruta bemakom acher. ha lamadta shekkol hamekaddesh bishve kesef im haya beotah hammedina sheve peruta hare ellu kiddushe vadday veim eno sheve peruta hare ellu kiddushe safek. yerae li sheim kiddesh betavshil o beyarak sheeno mitkayyem vechayyotze bahem im lo hayu sheve peruta beoto hammakom enah mekuddeshet kelal shehare davar ze eno maggia lemakom acher ad sheyyippased veyovad velo yihyu sheve peruta. vedavar shel taam hu ze verauy lismoch alav: 
Hamekaddesh (ishsha) befachot mipperuta o shekkiddesh shete nashim bifruta af al pi sheshshalach sivlonot leachar mikken enah mekuddeshet. vechen katan shekkiddesh af al pi sheshshalach sivlonot leachar shehigdil enah mekuddeshet shemmechamat kiddushin harishonim shelachan shehayu kiddushin pesulin: 
Hamekaddesh et haishsha bechesef o bishtar eno tzarich sheyyitten hakkiddushin letoch yadah ella kevan sheratzta lizrok lah kiddusheha uzerakan ben letoch yadah ben letoch chekah o letoch chatzerah o letoch sade shellah hare zo mekuddeshet. hayta omedet birshut habbaal tzarich sheyyitten letoch yadah o letoch chekah. hayta omedet birshut shehi shel shenehen vezarak lah kiddusheha middatah velo higgiu leyadah o lechekah hare zo mekuddeshet kiddushe safek. vaafillu amra lo hannach kiddushin al makom ze veoto hammakom shel shenehem hare ellu kiddushe safek: 
Hayu omdim birshut harabbim o birshut sheeno shel shenehem vezarak lah kiddusheha. karov lo enah mekuddeshet. karov lah hare zo mekuddeshet. mechetza al mechetza o shehayu safek karov lo safek karov lah veavdu kodem sheyyaggiu leyadah hare zo safek mekuddeshet. ketzad hu karov lo vekarov lah. kol shehu yachol lishmor otan vehi enah yechola ze hu karov lo. hi yechola lishmor otan vehu eno yachol zehu karov lah. shenehen yecholin lishmor otan o shenehen en yecholim lishmor otan ze hu mechetza al mechetza:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 5: Hamekadesh bedavar shehu asur bahanaa kegon chametz befesach o basar bechalav vechayyotze bahen mishshear issure hanaa enah mekuddeshet. vaafillu haya asur bahanaa middivrehem kegon chametz beshaa shishshit miyyom arbaa asar enah mekuddeshet:

Avar umachar davar haasur bahanaa vekiddesh bedamav hare zo mekuddeshet chutz meakkum sheim kiddesh bedameha enah mekuddeshet mippene sheddeme akkum asurin bahanaa kamoha. hamekaddesh beferesh egle akkum enah mekuddeshet shehakkol meakkum asur bahanaa shenneemar <small>(Devarim 13 18)</small> "velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem". aval hamekaddesh beferesh shor hanniskal hare zo mekuddeshet af al pi sheshshor hanniskal asur bahanaa pirsho eno asur bahanaa sheeno davar chashuv legabbe hashshor:

Hamekaddesh beferot sheviit o beefer para adumma o bemayim shemmillean laasotan me nidda hare zo mekuddeshet. hamekaddesh behekdesh shel bedek habbayit beshogeg hare zo mekuddeshet. vehu yeshallem keren vechomesh lehekdesh veyavi ashamo kedin kol moel bishgaga. veim kiddesh bo ishsha bemezid enah mekuddeshet:
Kiddeshah bemaaser sheni ben beshogeg ben bemezid enah mekuddeshet. lefi sheen lo laasot bo shear chafatzav ad sheyyitchallel shenneemar bemaaser <small>(Vayikra 27 30)</small> "laAdonai hu":

Kohen shekkiddesh bechelko mikkadshe kadashim o mikkadashim kallim enah mekuddeshet mippene shello hutteru ella laachila bilvad. aval kohen shekkiddesh bitruma gedola uvitrumat maaser uvevikkurim vechen levi shekkiddesh bemaaser rishon veyisrael shekkiddesh bemaasar ani hare zo mekuddeshet:

Mattanot shello huremu hare hem kemo shehuremu. lefichach yisrael shennaflu lo tevalim mibbet avi immo kohen vehifrish mehen teruma umaasrot hare hen kitrumot umaasrot shennaflu lo birushsha meavi immo. veim kiddesh bahen ishsha hare zo mekuddeshet. sheaf al pi sheenan reuyin lo laachila yesh lo lemachran lemi shehen reuyin lo. aval yisrael shekkiddesh bitruma shehifrish miggarno enah mekuddeshet shehare en lo lemachrah veen lo bah ella tovat hanaa. lefi shennotnah lechol kohen sheyyirtze vetovat hanaa enah mamon:
Hamekaddesh et haishsha begezel o bigneva o bechamas. im nityaashu habbealim venoda shekkana oto davar beyeush hare zo mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet:

Hannichnas levet chavero velakach lo keli o ochel vechayyotze bahen vekiddesh bo ishsha uva baal habbayit af al pi sheamar lo lamma lo natatta lah davar ze shehu tov mimma shennatatta lah enah mekuddeshet. shello amar lo davar ze ella kede shello lehitbayyesh immo. vehoil vekiddesh bemamon chavero shello middaat chavero hare ze gezel veenah mekuddeshet. veim kiddeshah bedavar sheen baal habbayit makpid alav kegon temara o egoz hare zo mekuddeshet missafek:
Hayta sechora beno uven chavero vechillekah shello middaat chavero vekiddesh bechelko hoil utzericha shumat bet din enah mekuddeshet sheen ze notel leatzmo ma sheyyirtze veyanniach ma sheyyirtze:

Gazal et haishsha o ganav mimmenna o chamasah vechazar vekiddeshah baggezel uvaggeneva uvechamas shellah veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet bo. im kadam benehen shidduchin venatla veshatka hare zo mekuddeshet. veim lo shiddech otah meolam af al pi sheshshatka keshennatan lah devarim ellu betorat kiddushin enah mekuddeshet. veim amra hen hare zo mekuddeshet:

Vechen im natan lah pikkadon veamar lah kinsi pikkadon ze vechazar veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bo. im amar lah kodem shennetalattu unetalattu veshatka hare zo mekuddeshet. veim achar shennetalattu betorat pikkadon amar lah hare at mekuddeshet bo veshatka en ze kelum shekkol shetika shelleachar mattan maot enah moelet. aval im amra hen achar shennatla hare zo mekuddeshet:

Hechezir lah chov shehaya lah etzlo veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet bo kodem shettittelennu unetalattu veshatka. im haya benehen shidduchin hare zo mekuddeshet. veim lo shiddech enah mekuddeshet ad shettomar hen. veim amar lah achar shennatla hachov shellah hare at mekuddeshet bo afillu amra hen enah m[ku]deshet. shehare lo higgia leyadah mimmennu kelum ella shellah natla uchevar nifra chovo mishshaa shennatla veenah yechola lachazor uletavo bachov paam acheret:

Hamekaddesh bemilve afillu hayta bishtar enah mekuddeshet. ketzad. kegon shehaya lo etzlah chov dinar veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet li baddinar sheyyesh li beyadech enah mekuddeshet. mippene shehammilve lehotzaa nittena veen kan shum davar kayyam lehanot bo meatta shekkevar hotzia oto dinar veavra hanaato:
Haya lo etzlah milve al hammashkon vekiddeshah beotah hammilve vehechezir lah hammashkon hare zo mekuddeshet shehare hi nehenet bammashkon meatta vahare higgia hanaa leyadah:

Hamekaddesh bahanaat milve hare zo mekuddeshet. ketzad. kegon shehilva otah atta matayim zuz veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bahanaat zeman shearviach lach bemilve zo shettihye beyadech kach vechach yom veeni tovah mimmech ad zeman peloni hare zo mekuddeshet. shehare yesh lah hanaa meatta lehishtammesh bemilve zo ad sof zeman shekkava. veasur laasot ken mippene shehi keribbit. ufershu rabbotay bahanaat milve devarim sheen rauy leshaman:
Amar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bifruta zo uvachov sheyyesh li etzlech hare zo mekuddeshet. vechen im amar lah bammilve sheyyesh li etzlech uvifruta zo hare zo mekuddeshet:
Haya lo chov beyad acherim veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bachov sheyyesh li beyad ze bemaamad shelashtan hare zo mekuddeshet:
Kiddeshah befikkadon sheyyesh lo beyadah o bishela shehishilah. im haya happikkadon vehashsheela peruta o sheve peruta beechad mehen kayyam birshutah hare zo mekuddeshet:

Amar lah hare et mekuddeshet li bischar sheadabber alayich lashshilton vedibber aleha lashshilton vehinniach hashshilton velo tevaah enah mekuddeshet ella im natan lah peruta mishshello. shehahanaa shebbaa lah middevarav hare hi kemilve vehamekaddesh bemilve enah mekuddeshet:

Hare at mekuddeshet li bimlacha zo sheeese immach veasa enah mekuddeshet ella im ken natan lah peruta mishshello. lefi shehassechirut yizke bah happoel mittechilla vead sof kol zeman sheyyaase miktzat min hammelacha zoche bemiktzat min hassachar venimtza hassachar kullo milve etzlah vehamekaddesh bemilve enah mekuddeshet:

Haishsha sheamra ten dinar lifloni mattana veetkaddesh ani lecha venatan veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bahanaat mattana zo shennatatti al pich hare zo mekuddeshet. af al pi shello higgia lah kelum hare nehenet birtzonah shennaasa venehena peloni biglalah. vechen im amra lo ten dinar lifloni mattana veetkaddesh lo venatan lo vekiddeshah oto peloni veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bahanaat mattana zo shekkibbalti birtzonech hare zo mekuddeshet:

Amar lah helach dinar ze bemattana vehitkaddeshi lifloni vekiddeshah oto peloni veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bahanaa zo habbaa lich biglali hare zo mekuddeshet af al pi shello natan lah hamekaddesh kelum. amra lo helach dinar ze mattana veetkaddesh lecha ulekacho veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bahanaa zo shekkibbalti mimmech mattana im adam chashuv hu hare zo mekuddeshet shehanaa yesh lah bihyoto nehene mimmenna uvahanaa zo hiknat atzmah lo:

Haomer leishsha hitkaddeshi li bedinar vahare ze hammashkon beyadech ad sheetten haddinar enah mekuddeshet lo. lefi shello higgia haddinar leyadah velo hammashkon natan leheyoto shellah. haya beyado mashkon al chov sheyyesh lo etzel acherim vekiddesh bo ishsha af al pi sheeno shello hare zo mekuddeshet. lefi shebbaal chov yesh lo miktzat kinyan begufo shel mashkon:

Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li bedinar ze al menat shettachazirihu li enah mekuddeshet ben hechezira ben lo hechezira. sheim lo hechezirattu lo nitkayyem hattenay. veim hechezirattu hare lo nehenet velo higgia leyadah kelum:

Natan lah agudda shel hadas vechayyotze bah veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bezo vekibbela oto. veamru lo vahalo en bah sheve peruta veamar titkaddesh bearbaa zuzim hammuchbaim betoch haagudda. im amra hen hare zo mekuddeshet. veim shatka enah mekuddeshet bemaot ellu shehashshetika shelleachar mattan maot enah moelet kelum vetihye mekuddeshet besafek mippene haagudda shemma sheve peruta bemakom acher:

Haomer leishsha hitkaddeshi li bitmara zo hitkaddeshi li bezo hitkaddeshi li bezo im yesh beachat mehen sheve peruta hare zo mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet ella missafek shemma tishve temara achat peruta bemakom acher:

Amar lah hitkaddeshi li bezo uvezo uvezo im yesh bechullam sheve peruta mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet ella missafek. hayta ochelet rishona rishona im yesh baacharona sheve peruta mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet ella missafek. sheotan temarim sheachla hare hen kemilve vehamekaddesh bemilve enah mekuddeshet venimtza sheen hakkiddushin ella bitmara acharona:
Amar lah hare at mekuddeshet li beellu im yesh bechullan sheve peruta m[ku]deshet af al pi shehi ochelet rishona rishona shellah hi ochelet um[ku]deshet:

Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li bechos ze im haya male mayim hare zo mekuddeshet bo uvema shebbetocho. veim haya male yayin hare zo mekuddeshet bo velo bema shebbetocho. veim haya male shemen hare zo mekuddeshet bema shebbetocho velo bo. lefichach im lo haya bashshemen sheve peruta hare zo mekuddeshet besafek. veim haya bashshemen sheve peruta hare zo mekuddeshet vadday veen mashgichin al hakkos:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 6: Hamekadesh al tenay im nitkayyem hattenay mekuddeshet veim lav enah mekuddeshet ben sheyyihye hattenay min haish ben sheyyihye min haishsha. vechol tenay shebbaolam ben bekiddushin ben begerushin ben bemikkach ben bemimkar ben bishar dine mamon tzarich lihyot bitnae arbaa devarim:

Veellu hen had devarim shel kol tenay. sheyyihye kaful. vesheyyihye hen shello kodem lallav. vesheyyihye hattenay kodem lammaase. vesheyyihye hattenay davar sheefshar lekayyemo. veim chaser hattenay echad mehen hare hattenay batel ucheillu en sham tenay kelal ella tihye zo mekuddeshet o megoreshet miyyad veyitkayyem hammikkach o hammattana miyyad ucheillu lo hitna kelal hoil vechaser hattenay echad min haarbaa:

Ketzad. haomer leishsha im titteni li matayim zuz hare at mekuddeshet li bedinar ze veim lo titteni li lo tihyi mekuddeshet veachar shehitna tenay ze natan lah haddinar. hare hattenay kayyam vahare zo mekuddeshet al tenay. veim natna lo matayim zuz tihye mekuddeshet veim lo natna lo enah mekuddeshet:

Aval im amar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bedinar ze venatan haddinar beyadah vehishlim hattenay veamar im titteni li matayim zuz tihyi mekuddeshet veim lo titteni li lo tihyi mekuddeshet hare hattenay batel mippene shehikdim hammaase venatan beyadah veachar kach hitna. veaf al pi shehakkol betoch kede dibbur hare zo mekuddeshet miyyad veenah tzericha litten lo kelum:

Vechen im amar lah im titteni li matayim zuz hare at mekuddeshet li bedinar ze veachar kach natan haddinar beyadah hare hattenay batel mippene shello kafal tenao. shehare lo amar lah veim lo titteni lo tihyi mekuddeshet vahare zo mekuddeshet miyyad veenah tzericha litten lo kelum:

Vechen im amar lah im lo titteni li matayim zuz lo tihyi mekuddeshet li veim titteni li matayim zuz hare at mekuddeshet li bedinar ze veachar kach natan haddinar beyadah hare hattenay batel lefi shehikdim lav lehen vahare zo mekuddeshet miyyad veenah tzericha litten lo kelum:
