Vechen im amar lah im taali larakia o terdi lattehom hare at mekuddeshet li bedinar ze veim lo taali larakia velo terdi lattehom lo tihyi mekuddeshet veachar kach natan haddinar beyadah hare hattenay batel vahare hi mekuddeshet miyyad shehaddavar yadua shei efshar lah lekayyem tenay ze veen ze ella kemafligah bidvarim derech sechok vehittul:

Hare shehitna bedavar sheefshar laasoto ella shehattora asra oto kegon sheamar leishsha im tochli chelev vedam hare at mekuddeshet li bedinar ze veim lo tochli lo tihyi mekuddeshet. im tochli besar chazir hare ze gittech veim lo tochli lo yehe get. veachar shehitna natan haddinar o hagget beyadah hare hattenay kayyam. veim avra veachla tihye mekuddeshet o megoreshet. veim lo achla enah mekuddeshet veenah megoreshet. veen omrim baze hare hitna al ma shekkatuv battora shehare beyadah shello tochal veshello titkaddesh velo titgaresh:

Uvamme amru chachamim kol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel chutz middavar shebbemamon shettenao kayyam. kegon shekkiddesh o geresh o natan o machar al tenay shehu rotze bitnao sheyyezakke atzmo bedavar shello zikketa lo tora umana mimmennu o yiftor atzmo bitnao middavar shechiyyeva oto bo hattora sheomrin lo tenaacha batel uchevar nitkayyemu maasecha veen atta niftar middavar shechiyyeva otcha bo hattora velo tizke bedavar shemmana otcha mimmennu:

Ketzad. kegon shekkiddesh ishsha al tenay sheen lah alav sheer kesut veona. sheomrin lo bichsut usheer shehu tenay shebbemamon tenaacha kayyam aval beona tenaacha batel shehattora chiyyeva otcha beona vahare zo mekuddeshet veatta chayyav beonatah veen beyadcha liftor atzmecha bitnaacha. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen hamekaddesh yefat toar al tenay sheyyitammer bah hare zo mekuddeshet veen lo lehitammer bah shehare hattora mana oto millehishtabed bah achar shennivala. velo mippene tenao yizke bedavar shemmana oto tora ella tenao batel vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hitna al haishsha bishat kiddushin o bishat gerushin shettibbael leaviha uleachiha o livnah vechayyotze baze hare ze kemi shehitna aleha shettaale larakia o shettered lattehom utenao batel sheen beyadah sheyyaavru acherim veyavou al haerva venimtza shehitna immah bedavar sheeno beyadah lekayyemo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Aval im hitna aleha sheyyitten li peloni chatzero o sheyyassi bitto livni vechayyotze baze tenao kayyam shehare efshar beyadah lekayyemo vetitten lifloni mamon rav ad sheyyitten lo chatzero vead sheyyassi bitto livno shehare en kan avera. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Sim kol ellu haddevarim shel tenaim leneged enecha tamid. vechol makom sheatta shomea hamekaddesh al tenay kach vechach o hannoten get al tenay kach vechach o hammocher o hannoten al tenay teda shehattenay yesh bo arbaa devarim ellu shebbearnu kede shello nihye tzerichin lefaresh otan bechol makom. veim chaser echad mehen en kan tenay:

Yesh miktzat geonim acharonim sheamru sheen tzarich adam lichpol tenao ella begittin vekiddushin bilvad aval bedine mamon eno tzarich lichpol. veen rauy lismoch al davar ze shekkefilat hattenay im shear haarbaa devarim mittenay bene gad uvene reuven lamdu otan chachamim <small>(Bamidbar 32 29)</small> "im yaavru bene gad" vegomer <small>(Bamidbar 32 30)</small> "veim lo yaavru" utenay ze lo haya lo begittin velo bekiddushin. vechaze horu gedole haggeonim harishonim vechen rauy laasot:

Hamekaddesh al tenay kesheyyitkayyem hattenay tihye mekuddeshet mishshaa shennitkayyem hattenay lo mishshaa shennitkaddesha. ketzad. haomer leishsha im etten lich matayim zuz beshana zo hare at mekuddeshet li bedinar ze veim lo etten lich lo tihyi mekuddeshet venatan haddinar leyadah benisan venatan lah hammatayim zuz shehitna immah beelul hare zo mekuddeshet meelul. lefichach im kiddeshah acher kodem sheyyitkayyem hattenay shel rishon hare zo mekuddeshet lashsheni. vechen haddin begittin uvemamonot beshaa sheyyitkayyem hattenay hu sheyyihye get o yitkayyem hammikkach o hammattana:

Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya sham tenay velo amar meachshav. aval im amar lah hare at mekuddeshet li meachshav bedinar ze im etten lich matayim zuz uleachar zeman natan lah matayim zuz hare zo mekuddeshet lemafrea mishsheat hakkiddushin af al pi shello naasa tenao ella leachar zeman merubbe. lefichach im kiddeshah hashsheni kodem sheyyaase hattenay enah mekuddeshet. vechen haddin begittin uvemamon:

Kol haomer meachshav lo yitztarech lichpol tenao velo lehakedim hattenay al hammaase ella af al pi shehikdim hammaase tenao kayyam. aval tzarich lehatenot bedavar sheefshar lekayyemo. veim hitna bedavar shei efshar lekayyemo hare ze kemaflig bidvarim veen sham tenay. vechol haomer al menat keomer meachshav veeno tzarich lichpol hattenay velo lehakedimo lammaase:

Ketzad. haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz. hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz. hare chatzer zo netuna lich bemattana al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz. hare tenao kayyam venitkaddesha o nitgarsha vezachta zo bechatzer vehem yittenu hammatayim zuz. veim lo natnu lo tihye zo mekuddeshet velo megoreshet velo tizke zo bechatzer. veaf al pi shello kafal tenao veaf al pi shehikdim hammaase lattenay venatan hakkiddushin o hagget beyadah vehechezika zo bechatzer veachar kach hishlim tenao. shehare kesheyyitkayyem hattenay tizke zo bechatzer vetitkaddesh zo vetitgaresh mishshaa rishona shebbah naasa hammaase keillu lo haya sham tenay kelal:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 7:
Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheyyirtze avi. ratza haav mekuddeshet. lo ratza o sheshshatak o shemmet kodem sheyyishma haddavar enah mekuddeshet. al menat shello yimche avi. shama umicha enah mekuddeshet. lo micha o shemmet hare zo mekuddeshet. met habben veachar kach shama haav melammedin haav sheyyomar eni rotze kede shello yehu kiddushin velo tippol lifne yavam: 
Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li baze al menat sheyyesh li matayim zuz o bet kor afar im yesh sham edim sheyyesh lo hare zo mekuddeshet. veim en lo hare zo mekuddeshet missafek shemma yesh lo vehu omer en li kede lekalkelah: 
Hare at mekuddeshet li baze al menat sheyyesh li matayim zuz o bet kor afar bemakom peloni. im yesh lo beoto makom hare zo mekuddeshet. veim en lo beoto makom sheamar hare zo mekuddeshet missafek shemma yesh lo sham vehu mitkavven lekalkelah: 
Hare at mekuddeshet li baze al menat shearech matayim zuz o bet kor afar hare zo mekuddeshet veyarennah. hera hazzuzim beyad acherim o shehera bet kor afar bisde acherim enah mekuddeshet ad sheyyarennah mishshello. lakach hammaot behalevaa o beshuttafut o shessachar hassade o lekachah baarisut veherah enah mekuddeshet ad sheyyarennah mishshello. shemmashma shearech shearech mishshel atzmi davar ze sheamarti lach: 
Haya lo bet kor afar vehaya bo nekaim amukkim asara tefachim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim. im hayu hannekaim meleim mayim hare hen kislaim veen nimdadin immo mippene sheenan reuyin lizria. veim enan melein mayim nimdadin immo mippene shehen reuyin lizria: 
Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li baze al menat sheen alayich nedarim venimtza aleha echad mishshelosha nedarim ellu shello tochal basar o shello tishte yayin o shello titkashshet bemine tzivonin enah mekuddeshet. nimtza aleha neder chutz meellu af al pi shehu omer makpid ani afillu al ze hare zo mekuddeshet. veim amar lah al menat sheen alayich kol neder afillu nimtzet shennadra shello tochal charuvin enah mekuddeshet: 
Hare at mekuddeshet li baze al menat sheen bach mumin venimtza bah echad min hammumin happoslin bannashim enah mekuddeshet. nimtza bah mum acher chutz meotan hammumin af al pi sheamar makpid ani afillu al ze hare zo mekuddeshet. uma hen hammumin happoslin benashim. kol hammumin happoslin bechohanim poslin benashim. uvehilchot biat mikdash yitbaaru kol mumin shel kohanim. veyoter alehen bannashim. reach ra. vezea. vereach happe. vekol ave. vedadin gassin mechavroteha tefach. vetefach ben dad ledad. uneshichat kelev venaasa hammakom tzalleket. veshuma sheal happaddachat. afillu hayta ketanna beyoter vaafillu kerova lesear roshah veaf al pi sheen bah sear. vezo hi hashshuma sheyyetera ishsha al hakkohanim. aval im hayta shuma sheyyesh bah sear bishar happanim o shuma gedola keisar af al pi sheen bah sear hare ze mum ben bechohanim ben benashim: 
Hamekaddesh ishsha setam venimtza aleha echad min hammumin happoslin bannashim o nimtza aleha echad mishshelosha nedarim hare zo mekuddeshet missafek. kiddeshah al menat sheen aleha nedarim vehayu aleha nedarim vehalcha etzel chacham vehittir lah hare zo mekuddeshet: 
Kiddeshah al menat sheen bah mumin vehayu bah mumin vehalcha etzel rofe verippe otah enah mekuddeshet. aval im hitna haish sheen alav nedarim vesheen bo mumin vehayu alav nedarim vehayu bo mumin vehalach etzel chacham vehittiro, etzel rofe verippeo, hare zo mekuddeshet. sheen genay laish bammumin shekkevar nirpeu vehaishsha enah makpedet al zot: 
Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li baze al menat sheetten lich matayim zuz mikkan vead sheloshim yom. im natan lah betoch sheloshim yom mekuddeshet veim avru sheloshim yom velo natan lah enah mekuddeshet. hare at mekuddeshet li bezuzim ellu leachar sheloshim yom. af al pi shennitakkelu hammaot betoch sheloshim yom hare zo mekuddeshet leachar sheloshim yom. veim chazar bo betoch hashsheloshim o chazra hi enah mekuddeshet: 
Ba sheni vekiddeshah betoch sheloshim yom hare zo mekuddeshet lashsheni leolam. lefi shebbeshaa shekkiddeshah hashsheni lo hayta mekuddeshet vetafsu bah kiddushe sheni venaaset eshet ish uleachar hashsheloshim yom kesheyyavou kiddushe rishon yimtzeu otah eshet ish venimtza harishon kemi shekkiddesh eshet ish sheen hakkiddushin tofsin bah: 
Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li meachshav uleachar sheloshim yom bedinar ze uva acher vekiddeshah betoch hashsheloshim yom hare zo mekuddeshet missafek lishnehem. lefichach shenehem notnin get ben betoch hashsheloshim yom ben leachar hashsheloshim yom. hare at mekuddeshet li meachshav uleachar sheloshim yom. uva acher veamar hare at mekuddeshet li meachshav uleachar esrim yom. uva acher veamar hare at mekuddeshet li meachshav uleachar asara yamim. afillu hen mea al hasseder hazze kiddushe kullan tofsin bah utzericha get mikkol echad veechad mippene shehi safek mekuddeshet lechullan: 
Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li chutz mippeloni kelomar shello teaser alav ella tihye eshet ish al kol haolam velifloni kifnuya hare zo mekuddeshet missafek. aval im amar lah hare at mekuddeshet li al menat shettihyi mutteret lifloni hare zo mekuddeshet vetihye asura alav kishar haam mippene shehitna bedavar shei efshar lekayyemo: 
Hannoten shete perutot leishsha veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet li hayyom beachat uveachat leachar sheagarshech hare zo mekuddeshet. uchesheyyegaresh otah tihye mekuddeshet ad sheyyegaresh otah paam sheniyya min kiddushe peruta sheniyya. aval im amar leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li baze leachar sheetgayyer. leachar shettitgayyeri. leachar sheeshtachrer. leachar shettishtachreri. leachar sheyyamut balech. leachar shettamut achotech. enah mekuddeshet lefi sheeno yachol atta lekaddeshah: 
Haomer livama hare at mekuddeshet li baze leachar sheyyachalotz lich yevamich hare zo mekuddeshet hoil veillu kiddeshah atta hayu kiddushin tofsin bah missafek: 
Haomer lachavero im yalda ishtecha nekeva hare hi mekuddeshet li baze lo amar kelum. veim hayta eshet chavero meubberet vehukkar haebbar hare zo mekuddeshet. veyerae li shetztzarich lachazor ulekaddesh otah achar shetteled al yede aviha kede sheyyachnis otah bekiddushin sheen bahen dofi: 
Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li bemea dinarin venatan lah afillu dinar echad hare zo mekuddeshet mishshellakcha haddinar vehu sheyyashlim lah hashshear. shezze kemi sheamar hare at mekuddeshet li bedinar ze al menat sheashlim lich mea dinarim shehi mekuddeshet lo meachshav. bamme devarim amurim kesheamar lah bemea dinarim setam aval im peresh veamar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bemea dinarin ellu vehitchil limnot letoch yadah enah mekuddeshet ad sheyyashlim [lah mea] vaafillu baddinar haacharon shenehem yecholim lachazor ze baze. vechen im nimtza mane chaser dinar o nimtza mehen dinar nechoshet enah mekuddeshet. nimtza bahem dinar ra im yechola lehotzio al yede haddechak yachalifennu veim lav enah mekuddeshet: 
Amar lah hare at mekuddeshet li bivgadim ellu shehen shavin chamishshim dinarim vehayu shel meshi vechayyotze bahen shehaishsha mitavva lahen im hayu shavin chamishshim hare zo mekuddeshet mishsheat lekicha. veenan tzerichin shuma bashshuk veachar kach tihye mekuddeshet kede shettismoch datah ella hoil vehen shavin kemo sheamar lah hare zo mekuddeshet mishshaa rishona. veim enan shavin enah mekuddeshet: 
Ish veishsha shehayu asukin bedivre erusin hu omer bemea dinarim akaddesh otach vehi omeret eni mitkaddeshet lecha ella bematayim vehalach ze leveto vezo levetah veachar kach tavu ze et ze vekiddeshu setam. im haish tava et haishsha yaasu divre haishsha veim haishsha tava et haish yaasu divre haish: 
Haose shaliach lekaddesh lo ishsha vehalach hashshaliach vekiddeshah al tenay enah mekuddeshet. vechen im amar lo lekaddeshah al tenay vehalach vekiddeshah setam o al tenay acher o sheshshinna et hattenay enah mekuddeshet: 
Amar lo kaddeshah li bemakom peloni vehalach vekiddeshah bemakom acher enah mekuddeshet. kaddeshah li vahare hi bemakom peloni vehalach vekiddeshah bemakom acher hare zo mekuddeshet mippene shemmare makom hu lo. vechen hi sheamra lishluchah kabbel li kiddushay bemakom peloni vekibbelam lah bemakom acher enah mekuddeshet. hare habbaal bemakom peloni vekibbel lah bemakom acher hare zo mekuddeshet mippene shemmara makom hi lo: 
Hamekaddesh et haishsha vechazru bo miyyad hu o hi af al pi shechazru betoch kede dibbur en chazaratam kelum vahare hi mekuddeshet: 
Hamekaddesh al tenay vechazar achar kamma yamim uvittel hattenay af al pi shebbittelo beno levenah shello bifne edim batel hattenay vahare hi mekuddeshet setam. vechen im haya hattenay min haishsha uvittela oto (achar kach) benah uveno batel hattenay. lefichach hamekaddesh al tenay vechanas setam o baal setam hare zo tzericha get af al pi shello nitkayyem hattenay shemma bittel hattenay keshebbaal o keshekkanas. vechen hamekaddesh befachot mishsheve peruta o bemilve vechazar uvaal setam bifne edim tzericha get sheal beila zo samach velo al otan hakkiddushin happesulin. chazaka hi sheen adam miyyisrael hakkesherim ose beilato beilat zenut vahare beyado atta laasotah beilat mitzva:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 8:
Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li bechos ze shel yayin venimtza shel devash. shel devash venimtza shel yayin. bedinar ze shel kesef venimtza shel zahav. shel zahav venimtza shel kesef. al menat sheani kohen venimtza levi. levi venimtza kohen. natin venimtza mamzer. mamzer venimtza natin. ben ir venimtza ben kerach. ben kerach venimtza ben ir. al menat sheani ani venimtza ashir. ashir venimtza ani. al menat shebbeti karov lammerchatz venimtza rachok. rachok venimtza karov. al menat sheyyesh li shifcha o bat godelet o ofa veen lo. al menat sheen lo veyesh lo. al menat sheyyesh li ishsha uvanim veen lo. al menat sheen li veyesh lo. bechol ellu vechol haddome lahen enah mekuddeshet. vechen hi shehitattu: 
Uvechullam af al pi sheamra belibbi haya lehitkaddesh lo af al pi shehitani veen haddavar kemo sheamar. vechen im amar hu belibbi haya lekaddeshah af al pi shehitatni enah mekuddeshet lefi shehaddevarim shebballev enam devarim: 
Hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheani bassam venimtza bassam uvuresay. al menat sheani ben ir venimtza ben ir uven kerach. al menat sheshshemi yosef venimtza shemo yosef veshimon hare zo mekuddeshet. aval im amar lah al menat sheen shemi ella yosef venimtza shemo yosef veshimon. sheeni ella bassam venimtza bassam uvuresay. sheeni ella ben ir venimtza ben kerach uven ir enah mekuddeshet: 
Haomer leishsha hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheani yodea likrot. tzarich sheyyikra hattora vitargem otah targum unkelus hagger. veim amar lah al menat sheani kore tzarich lihyot yodea likrot tora neviim uchetuvim bedikduk yafe. al menat sheani yodea lishnot tzarich lihyot yodea likrot hammishna. veim amar al menat sheani tannaa tzarich lihyot yodea likrot hammishna vesafra vesifri vetosefta shel rabbi chiyya: 
Al menat sheani talmid en omrin keven azay uven zoma ella kol sheshshoalin oto davar echad betalmudo veomro vaafillu behilchot hechag shemmelammedin otan barabbim middevarim hakkallim samuch lechag kede sheyyihyu kol haam bekiin bahen. al menat sheani chacham en omrin kerabbi akiva vachaverav ella kol sheshshoalin oto bechol makom devar chachma veomer. al menat sheani gibbor en omrin keavner ben ner ucheyoav ella kol shechaverav mityarim mimmennu mippene gevurato. al menat sheani ashir en omrin [kerabbi elazar ben charsom] ucherabbi elazar ben azarya ella kol shebbene iro mechabbedin oto mippene ashro. al menat sheani tzaddik afillu rasha gamur hare zo mekuddeshet missafek shemma hirher teshuva belibbo. al menat sheani rasha afillu tzaddik gamur hare zo mekuddeshet missafek shemma hirher beakkum belibbo sheavon akkum gadol hu umishsheyyeharher laavod belibbo naase rasha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 11 16)</small> "pen yifte levavchem". vechatuv <small>(Yechezkel 14 5)</small> "lemaan tefosho et bet yisrael belibbam": 
Hamekaddesh et haishsha veamar hayiti savur shehi kohenet vahare hi leviyya. leviyya vahare hi kohenet. aniyya vahare hi ashira. ashira vahare hi aniyya. hare zo mekuddeshet mippene shello hitattu. vechen hi sheamra sevura hayiti shehu kohen vahare hu levi. levi vahare hu kohen. ashir vahare hu ani. ani vahare hu ashir. hare zo mekuddeshet mippene shello hita otah:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 9: Ham [ka] desh shete nashim sheasur lissa shetehen mishshum erva keachat enan mekuddashot. ketzad. kegon shekkiddesh ishsha uvittah o shete achayot keachat en achat mehen mekuddeshet:

Kiddesh nashim rabbot keachat veamar hare kullechem mekuddashot li vehayu bahen shete achayot o ishsha uvittah vechayyotze bahen en achat mikkullan mekuddeshet. veim amar lahen haruya mikkem li levia mekuddeshet li hare kullan mekuddashot lo chutz meachayot o ishsha uvittah vechayyotze bahen. vechen im amar lahen hare kullechem mekuddashot li vehayta bahen shifcha o akkum o ishsha achat erva kegon eshet ish o bitto o achoto vechayyotze bahen en achat mikkullam mekuddeshet. veim amar haruya mikkem li levia tihye mekuddeshet li hare kullan mekuddashot lo chutz meotah ishsha sheen kiddushin tofsin bah:

Amar lishte achayot hare achat mikkem mekuddeshet li baze venatan lahen peruta o shekkibbaltah achat al yad chavertah. vechen haomer laav achat mibbenotecha mekuddeshet li vekibbel haav kiddusheha kullan tzerichot get mimmennu. veasur lo lavo al achat mehen mippene shehakkiddushin tofsin bahen af al pi shei efshar lavo al achat mehen:

Haose shaliach lekaddesh lo ishsha pelonit vehalach vekiddeshah lo vekiddesh hameshalleach beatzmo leimmah o levittah o laachotah veen yadua e zo mehen nitkaddesha rishona shetehen tzerichot get vaasurot alav. vechen ishsha sheasta shaliach lekaddeshah vehalach vekiddeshah vehalcha vekiddesha hi atzmah leacher veen yadua e zo mehen kodem shenehen notnin lah get. veim ratzu echad noten get veechad kones:
Bamme devarim amurim birchokin aval (bikrovim) im kiddeshah hashshaliach laav vekiddesha hi atzmah labben o laach vechayyotze bahen shenehem notnin get vehi asura lishnehem:

Haomer lishlucho tze vekaddesh li ishsha umet hashshaliach veeno yodea im kiddesh im lo kiddesh lo ishsha hare ze bechezkat shekkiddesh shechezkat shaliach laasot shelichuto. vehoil veen yadua e zo ishsha kiddesh lo hare ze asur bechol ishsha sheyyesh lah kerovot shehen erva immah. kegon ishsha sheyyesh lah bat o em o achot vechayyotze bahen. sheim tomar yissa zo shemma immah kiddesh lo shelucho o achotah o bittah. umuttar beishsha sheen lah kerovot kegon ellu. hayta lah kerova kegon em o achot vechayyotze bahen vehayta hakkerova eshet ish beshaa sheasa hu shaliach af al pi shennitgarsha kodem sheyyamut hashshaliach hare ze muttar bah. veen omrim shemma kiddesh hashshaliach at kerovatah achar shennitgarsha. mippene shello hayta reuya beshaa sheasa hashshaliach veen adam ose shaliach lekaddesh lo ella ishsha sheyyachol hu lekaddeshah bishat hashshelichut:

Mi shehayu lo chamishsha banim veasu kullan shaliach et avihem lekaddesh lahem ishsha. veamar avi habbanim leish sheyyesh lo chamesh banot achat mibbenotecha mekuddeshet leechad mibbanay vekibbel haav hakkiddushin. kol achat mehen tzericha chamishsha gittin mikkol haachin. hoil vechullan natnu reshut laav lekaddesh lahen ishsha. met echad mehem kol achat mehen tzericha arbaa gittin vachalitza meechad mehem:

Haav shehayta lo bat ketanna o naara shehi birshuto uvat bogeret venatna lo habbogeret reshut lekaddeshah vekiddesh bitto setam leechad. en habbogeret bichlal ad sheyyefaresh veyomar bitti habbogeret sheasat oti shaliach. lefichach en habbogeret mekuddeshet (vaachotah mekuddeshet):

Mi sheyyesh lo shete kitte banot mishshete nashim vechullan birshuto vekiddesh achat mehen uvishat hakkiddushin amar labbaal kiddashti lecha et bitti haggedola. af al pi sheyyesh lomar shemma gedola shebbaggedolot kiddesh lo o gedola shebbakketannot o ketanna shebbaggedolot shehi gedola min haggedola shebbakketannot. hare kullan muttarot chutz min haggedola shebbaggedolot shehi levaddah hamekuddeshet. vechen im kiddesh bitto hakketanna af al pi sheyyesh lomar shemma ketanna shebbakketannot o ketanna shebbaggedolot o gedola shebbakketannot shehi ketanna min hakketanna shebbaggedolot hare kullan muttarot chutz min hakketanna shebbakketannot vehi levaddah hamekuddeshet. shemmashma bitto haggedola sheen bivnotav gedola mimmenna umashma bitto hakketanna sheen bahen ketanna mimmenna:
Neeman haav lomar al bitto kodem shettivgor shehi mekuddeshet veosrah al hakkol:

Haav sheamar kiddashti et bitti veeni yodea lemi kiddashtiha hare zo asura leolam al kol adam ad sheyyomar haav noda li shellifloni kiddashtiha vetihye tzericha mimmennu get bilvad. veaf al pi shennoda lo achar shebbagra:
Amar haav eni yodea lemi kiddashtiha uva echad veamar ani hu shekkiddashtiha neeman af lichnos veeno tzarich kiddushin acherim:

Bau shenayim ze omer ani kiddashtiha veze omer ani kiddashtiha. shenehen notnin get veim ratzu echad noten get veechad kones. kenasah veachar kach ba acher veamar ani hu shekkiddashtiha eno neeman veeno osrah al balah:

Haishsha sheamra nitkaddashti veeni yodaat lemi nitkaddashti uva echad veamar ani hu shekkiddashtich neeman litten get vetihye mutteret lechol adam chutz mimmennu. aval eno neeman lichnos shemma yitzro tokfo vehi targil lo kede lehattirah:

Haomer leishsha kiddashtich vehi omeret lo kiddashtani hu asur bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav. kiddashtani vehu omer lo kiddashtich hu muttar bikrovoteha vehi asura bikrovav. kiddashtich vehi omeret lo kiddashta ella bitti hu asur bikrovot gedola ugedola mutteret bikrovav. umuttar bikrovot habbat vehabbat mutteret bikrovav. kiddashti et bittech vehi omeret lo kiddashta ella oti hu asur bikrovot habbat vehabbat mutteret bikrovav. umuttar bikrovot haem vehaem asura al kerovav:

Vechol ellu shettoanin hakkiddushin beshettaan hattoen shehayu sham kiddushin bifne edim vehalchu limdina acheret o metu. aval im hodu shehayu hakkiddushin belo edim en kan kiddushin kemo shebbearnu. vechol makom shettomar ishsha leish kiddashtani vehu omer lo kiddashtich mevakkeshim mimmennu sheyyichtov lah get lehattirah lishar haam sheen lo baze hefsed. veim natan lah get meatzmo kofin oto litten ketubba:
Haose shaliach lekaddesh lo ishsha vehalach vekiddeshah leatzmo hare zo mekuddeshet lashshaliach. veasur laasot ken. vechol haose davar ze vechayyotze bo bishar divre mikkach umimkar nikra rasha:

Haose shaliach lekaddesh lo ishsha vehalach vekiddeshah hashshaliach omer leatzmi kiddashtiha vehaishsha omeret larishon sheshshelacho nitkaddashti. im lo asa hashshaliach beedim hare hashshaliach asur bikrovoteha vehi mutteret bikrovav. vehaishsha asura bikrove hameshalleach vehameshalleach muttar bikrovoteha. veim huchzak hashshaliach beedim hare zo mekuddeshet larishon:

Amra eni yodaat lemi nitkaddashti im lashsholeach o lishlucho. im lo huchzak hashshaliach beedim hare zo mekuddeshet lashsheni. veim huchzak shehu shelucho shenehen notnin get. veim ratzu echad noten get veechad kones:

Haishsha sheasta shaliach lekaddeshah vehalach vekiddeshah uveet halichato bittela hashshelichut vechazra bah veen yadua im kodem shekkibbel lah hakkiddushin chazra o achar hakkiddushin hare zo mekuddeshet missafek. vechen haish sheasa shaliach vechazar bo:

Hamekaddesh achat mechamesh nashim veeno yodea e zo mehen kiddesh vechol achat veachat omeret oti kiddesh asur bikrovot kullan. venoten get lechol achat veachat umanniach ketubba achat benehen umistallek. veim kiddesh bevia kansu oto chachamim sheyyitten ketubba lechol achat veachat. vehaddavar yadua shehakketubba shekkatav leachat mehen avda vechol achat veachat omeret ani hi shekkiddashtani vechatavta li ketubba veavda ketubbati:

Haishsha sheyyatza aleha kol shehi mekuddeshet lifloni hare zo bechezkat mekuddeshet af al pi sheen sham reaya berura. vechol kol shello huchzak bevet din en choshshin lo. vechetzad hu hakkol shettuchzak zo bo shehi mekuddeshet. kegon shebbau shenayim veheidu sherau hannerot dolkot umittot mutzaot uvene adam nichnasin veyotzin venashim semechot lah veomrot nitkaddesha pelonit hayyom. shamu otan omrot pelonit titkaddesh hayyom en choshshin lah shemma nizdammenu lekaddesh velo nitkaddesha ad sheyyishmeu shennitkaddesha. vechen im bau shenayim veamru rainu kemo simchat erusin veshamanu kol havara veshamanu mippeloni sheshshama mippeloni shennitkaddesha pelonit bifne peloni ufeloni vehalchu lahem haedim limdina acheret o metu hare ze kol shemmachazik otah mekuddeshet:

Bamme devarim amurim shello hayta sham amatla aval im hayta sham amatla veshamu haamatla kesheshshamu shennitkaddesha lo huchzeka mekuddeshet. ketzad hi haamatla. pelonit nitkaddesha al tenay o kiddushe safek lo huchzeka. ella shoalin otah vesomchin al devareha hoil veen sham reaya berura velo kol chazak:

Yatza aleha kol shennitkaddesha lifloni uleachar yamim amru amatla. im nirin haddevarim levet din shehu ken somchin al haamatla velo tuchzak mekuddeshet. veim lav hoil velo nishmea haamatla beet shennishmeu hakkiddushin en choshshin laamatla:

Maase beachat sheyyatza aleha kol shennitkaddesha livno shel peloni uleachar zeman shaalu leaviv veamar al tenay kach nitkaddesha lo velo nitkayyem hattenay velo samchu chachamim al devarav ella amru hare zo safek mekuddeshet ucheillu en sham amatla:

Yatza aleha kol shehi mekuddeshet lifloni uva sheni vekiddeshah befanenu bodkin al kiddushe rishon shehen bekol. im bau edim biraya berura shehi mekuddeshet larishon en kiddushe sheni kelum. veim lav megaresh rishon shekkiddushav bekol venose hashsheni shekkiddushav vadday. veim geresh hashsheni lo yichnos harishon shemma yomru hechezir gerushato min haerusin achar shennitarsa leacher:
Yatza aleha kol shehi mekuddeshet lifloni veyatza kol acher kemoto shehi mekuddeshet leacher. echad kotev get veechad kones ben rishon ben acharon:

Makom shennahagu lishloach sivlonot laarusa achar shettitares uvau edim sherau sivlonot shehuvelu lah choshshin lah shemma nitkaddesha utzericha get missafek af al pi sherov anshe hair en meshallechin sivlonot ella kodem haerusin. umakom shennahagu kullan lishloach sivlonot battechilla veachar kach mekaddeshin verau sivlonot en choshshin lah:

Huchzak shetar ketubbatah. im derech miktzat anshe hammakom shemmekaddeshin veachar kach kotvin choshshin lah. veaf al pi sheen sham sofer en omrin shemma mippene hassofer shemmatza hikdim vechatav. veim derech kol anshe hammakom shekkotvin hakketubba kodem hakkiddushin en choshshin lah:

Shenayim omrin reinuha shennitkaddesha beyom peloni ushenayim omrin lo reinuha af al pi shekkullam shechenim bechatzer achat hare zo mekuddeshet sheen [taanat] lo reinuha reaya shedderech haam lekaddesh betzina:

Amar ed echad mekuddeshet hi zo vehi omeret lo nitkaddashti hare zo mutteret. echad omer mekuddeshet veechad omer enah mekuddeshet lo tinnase veim nisset lo tetze shehare hi omeret lo nitkaddashti. amra mekuddeshet ani uleachar zeman amda vekiddesha atzmah im natna amatla lidvareha veamra mippene kach vechach amarti battechilla sheani mekuddeshet verainu bidvareha mammash hare zo mutteret lashsheni. veim lo natna amatla o shennatna veen bahen mammash hare zo asura vekiddushe sheni kiddushe safek. lefichach noten lah get vetihye asura alav veal hakkol ad sheyyavo arusah. vechen haishsha shebbat veamra eshet ish ani vechazra veamra penuya ani im natna amatla lidvareha veyesh bidvareha mammash hare zo neemenet:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 10:
Haarusa asura levalah middivre sofrim kol zeman shehi bevet aviha. vehabba al arusato bevet chamiv makkin oto makkat mardut. vaafillu im kiddeshah bevia asur lo lavo aleha bia sheniyya bevet aviha ad sheyyavi otah letoch beto veyityached immah veyafrishennah lo. veyichud ze hu hannikra kenisa lachuppa vehu hannikra nissuin bechol makom. vehabba al arusato leshem nissuin achar shekkiddeshah mishsheyyeare bah kenaah venaaset nesua vahare hi ishto lechol davar: 
Kevan shennichnesa haarusa lachuppa hare zo mutteret lavo aleha bechol et sheyyirtze vahare hi ishto gemura lechol davar. umishshettikkanes lachuppa nikret nesua af al pi shello nivala vehu shettihye reuya livila. aval im hayta nidda af al pi shennichnesa lachuppa venityached immah lo gamru hannissuin vahare hi kaarusa adayin: 
Vetzarich levarech birkat chatanim bevet hechatan kodem hannissuin vehen shesh berachot veellu hen. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shehakkol bara lichvodo. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam yotzer haadam. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher yatzar et haadam betzalmo betzelem demut tavnito vehitkin lo mimmennu binyan ade ad baruch atta Adonai yotzer haadam. sos tasis vetagel akara bekibbutz baneha letochah besimcha baruch atta Adonai mesammeach tziyyon bevaneha. sammeach tesammach reim haahuvim kesammechacha yetzircha began eden mikkedem baruch atta Adonai mesammeach chatan vechalla. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bara sason vesimcha chatan vechalla gila rinna ditza vechedva ahava achava shalom vereut mehera Adonai elohenu yishshama beare yehuda uvechutzot yerushalayim kol sason kol simcha kol chatan kol kalla kol mitzhalot chatanim mechuppatam unearim mimmishte manginatam baruch atta Adonai mesammeach hechatan im hakkalla: 
Veim haya sham yayin mevi kos shel yayin umevarech al hayyayin techilla umesadder et kullan al hakkos venimtza mevarech sheva berachot. veyesh mekomot shennahagu lehavi hadas im hayyayin umevarech al hahadas achar hayyayin veachar kach mevarech hashshesh: 
Veen mevarchin birkat chatanim ella baasara gedolim uvene chorin vechatan min hamminyan: 
Hameares et haishsha uverech birkat chatanim velo nityached immah beveto adayin arusa hi sheen birkat chatanim osa hannissuin ella kenisa lachuppa. eres vechanas lachuppa velo berech birkat chatanim hare zo nesua gemura vechozer umevarech afillu achar kamma yamim. velo tinnase nidda ad shettithar. veen mevarchin lah birkat chatanim ad shettithar. veim avar venasa uverech eno chozer umevarech: 
Vetzarich lichtov ketubba kodem kenisa lachuppa veachar kach yihye muttar beishto vehechatan noten sechar hassofer. vechamma hu kotev lah. im hayta betula en kotvin lah pachot mimmatayim dinarim veim beula en kotvin lah pachot mimmea dinarim [4.] veze hu hannikra ikkar ketubba. veim ratza lehosif lah afillu kikkar zahav mosif. vedin hattosefet vedin haikkar echad hu lerov haddevarim. lefichach kol makom shenneemar bo ketubba setam hu haikkar vehattosefet keechad. vachachamim hem shettikkenu ketubba laishsha kede shello tihye kalla beenav lehotziah: 
Dinarim ellu lo tikkenu otam min hakkesef hattahor ella mimmatbea shehaya beotan hayyamim shehaya shiva chalakim nechoshet veechad kesef ad sheyyihye bassela chatzi zuz kesef. venimtza matayim dinarim shel betula chamishsha veesrim zuzin shel kesef tahor umea dinarim shel beula shenem asar zuzim umechetza. umishkal kol zuz shesh vetishim seorot kemo shebbearnu bitchillat eruvin. vehaddinar hu hannikra zuz bechol makom ben sheyyihye min hakkesef hattahor ben sheyyihye mimmatbea otan hayyamim: 
En pochatin livtula mimmatayim velivula mimmea. vechol happochet beilato beilat zenut. echad hakkotev et hakketubba bishtar veechad sheheidu alav edim vekanu miyyado shehu chayyav lah mea o matayim hare ze muttar. vechen im natan lah mittaltelin keneged ketubbatah hare ze muttar livol ad sheyyihye lo penay lichtov: 
Hakkones et haishsha velo katav lah ketubba. o shekkatav veavad shetar hakketubba. o shemmachala ketubbatah levalah. o shemmachra lo ketubbatah. chozer vechotev lah ikkar ketubba im ratza lekayyemah. lefi sheasur lo leadam lishhot im ishto afillu shaa achat belo ketubba. aval hammocheret ketubbatah laacherim betovat hanaa eno tzarich lichtov lah ketubba acheret. shello tikkenu ketubba ella kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah. veim hotzi ze meshallem ketubbatah lallokeach kederech shehaya meshallem lah im lo machra: 
Hameares et haishsha vechatav lah ketubba velo nichnesa lachuppa adayin arusa hi veenah nesua sheen hakketubba osa nissuin. veim met o gershah gova ikkar ketubbatah mibbene chorin veenah gova tosefet kelal hoil velo kenasah. aval im eres ishsha velo katav lah ketubba vamet o gershah vehi arusa en lah kelum vaafillu haikkar shello tikkenu lah ikkar ketubba ad shettinnase o ad sheyyichtov. vehameares et bitto vechatav lah ketubba vamet o gershah keshehayta naara ketubbatah leaviha kemo shebbearnu [lemala beferek shelishi]: 
Vechen tikkenu chachamim shekkol hannose betula yihye sameach immah shivat yamim. eno osek bimlachto velo nose venoten bashshuk ella ochel veshote vesameach. ben shehaya bachur ben shehaya almon. veim hayta beula en pachot mishshelosha yamim. shettakkanat chachamim hi livnot yisrael sheyyihye sameach im habbeula shelosha yamim ben bachur ben almon: 
Yesh lo leadam lissa nashim rabbot keachat beyom echad umevarech birkat chatanim lechullan keachat. aval lesimcha tzarich lismoach im kol achat simcha haruya lah. im betula shiva. im beula shelosha. veen mearvin simcha besimcha: 
Muttar leares bechol yom chol afillu betisha beav ben bayyom ben ballayla. aval en nosin nashim lo beerev shabbat velo beechad beshabbat gezera shemma yavo lide chillul shabbat betikkun hasseedda shehechatan tarud basseudda. veen tzarich lomar sheasur lissa ishsha beshabbat. vaafillu bechullo shel moed en nosin nashim kemo shebbearnu lefi sheen mearvin simcha besimcha shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 29 27)</small> "malle shevua zot venittena lecha gam et zot". ushear hayyamim muttar lissa ishsha bechol yom sheyyirtze vehu sheyyitrach bisuddat nissuin shelosha yamim kodem hannissuin: 
Makom sheen bet din yoshvin bo ella besheni uvachamishi bilvad betula nisset beyom revii sheim hayta lo taanat betulim yashkim levet din. uminhag chachamim shehannose et habbeula yissaenna bachamishi kede sheyyihye sameach immah chamishi veerev shabbat veshabbat veyotze limlachto yom rishon: 
Hameares et bitto ketanna utevaah habbaal lenissuin. ben hi ben aviha yecholin leakkev shello tinnase ad shettagdil vetease naara veim ratza lechansah kones. veen rauy laasot ken: 
Ersah veshaha kamma shanim utevaah lenissuin vahare hi naara notnin lah 12 chodesh miyyom hattevia lefarnes et atzmah uletakken ma shehi tzericha lah veachar kach tinnase. tevaah achar shebbagra notnin lah 12 chodesh miyyom habbeger. vechen im kiddeshah beyom habbeger notnin lah 12 chodesh miyyom hakkiddushin shehu yom habbeger. kiddeshah achar shebbagra im avru aleha 12 chodesh bevagrutah uleachar kach nitkaddesha en notnin lah ella sheloshim yom miyyom hattevia. vechen hameares et habbeula notnin lah sheloshim yom miyyom hattevia: 
Keshem shennotnin zeman laishsha mishshettevaah habbaal lefarnes et atzmah veachar kach tinnase kach notnin zeman laish lefarnes et atzmo mishshettava haishsha oto. vechamma notnin lo kemo shennotnin lah im 12 chodesh 12 chodesh veim sheloshim yom sheloshim yom: 
Higgia zeman shennatnu laish velo nesaah nitchayyev bimzonoteha af al pi shello kanas. veim higgia hazzeman beechad beshabbat o beerev shabbat eno maale lah mezonot beoto hayyom mippene sheeno yachol lichnos. vechen im chala hu o hi o sheppersa nidda keshehiggia hazzeman eno maale lah mezonot shehare enah reuya lehinnase ad shettithar o ad shettavri. vechen hu eno yachol lissa ishsha ad sheyyavri:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 11: Hannose betula shennitalmina o shennitgarsha o nechletza. im min haerusin nitalmena o nitgarsha o nechletza ketubbatah matayim. veim min hannissuin ketubbatah mea. shemmishshennisset hare hi kivula. vechen hannose betula meshuchreret o giyyoret o shevuya im nishtachrera hashshifcha venitgayyera hakkutit venifdet hashshevuya vehen pechutot mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad ketubbatan matayim. veim hayu benot shalosh shanim veyom echad vamala ketubbatan mea:

Umippene ma tikkenu chachamim leellu ketubba mea veaf al pi shehen betulot. hoil vechezkat hannesua shettibbael vechezkat hashshifcha vehakkutit vehashshevuya shettibbael tikkenu leellu mea ben nivalu ben lo nivalu vahare hen kivulot lechol davar:

Mukkat etz ketubbatah mea afillu nisset al menat shehi betula shelema venimtzet mukkat etz ketubbatah mea. ketanna mibbat shalosh shanim ulematta shennivala afillu ba aleha adam gadol ketubbatah matayim, sofah shettachazor betula kishar habbetulot. vechen gedola shebba aleha katan mibben tesha shanim ulematta ketubbatah matayim keillu lo nivala kelal. shebbiat ben tesha shanim veyom echad biato bia, pachot mizze en biato bia:

Betula shehi bogeret o suma o aylonit ketubbatan matayim. aval hachereshet vehashshota lo tikkenu lahen ketubba. hashshota lo tikkenu lah nissuin kelal. vehachereshet af al pi sheyyesh lah nissuin middivrehem lo tikkenu lah ketubba kede shello yimmanu millaset otah. ucheshem sheen lah ketubba kach en lah mezonot velo tenay mittenae ketubba. veim kanas hachereshet venitpakkecha yesh lah ketubba utenay ketubba uchetubbatah mea:
Nasa chereshet o shota vechatav lahen mea mane ketubbatan kayyemet mippene sheratza lehazzik nechasav:

Cheresh o shote shennasu nashim pikchot af al pi shennitpakkeach hacheresh venishtappa hashshote en linshehem alehem kelum. ratzu lekayyeman achar shehivriu yesh lahen ketubba uchetubbatan mea. veim bet din hem shehissiu hacheresh vechatvu lah ketubbatah al nechasav notelet kol ma shekkatvu lah bet din. aval hashshote en bet din massiin oto bechol makom. umippene sheen takkanat chachamim omedet bo lo tikkenu lo nissuin. vechen hakkatan lo tikkenu lo chachamim nissuin hoil vesofo lavo lide nissuin gemurin. umippene ma tikkenu nissuin liktanna veaf al pi shehi baa lide nissuin gemurin. kede shello yinhagu bah minhag hefker. veen massiin et hakkatan ad shebbodkin oto veyodim shehevi simanin:

Katan afillu ben tesha shanim veyom echad shennasa ishsha en lah ketubba. veim higdil vekiyyemah achar shehigdil yesh lah ikkar ketubba. vechen ger shennitgayyer hu veishto ketubbatah mane sheal menat ken kiyyemah:

Kol betula shekketubbatah matayim yesh lah taanat betulim. vechol shekketubbatah mea o shello tikkenu lah chachamim ketubba en lah taanat betulim. vehammityached im arusato kodem nissuin en lah taanat betulim:

Uma hi taanat betulim. ze shennasa ishsha shechezkatah shehi betula vetoen veomer lo metzatiha betula. ushene simanin hen livtula. haechad damim sheshottin mimmenna besof bia rishona. vehashsheni haddochak sheyyimmatze bah bevia rishona bishat tashmish:

Hannose et habbetula shekketubbatah matayim vetaan veamar lo metzatiha betula. shoalin otah im amra emet hu lo metzaani betula mippene shennafalti vehikkani etz o karka vehalchu betulay hare zo neemenet vetachazor ketubbatah lemane. af al pi shehu toen omer shemma ish ba alayich veen lach kelum en mashgichin betaanato. veyesh lo lehacharim setam shello ba aleha ish sheen haddavar vadday lo:

Amra hi emet amar shello metzaani betula veish ba alay beones achar shennitarasti lo. hare zo neemenet uchetubbatah matayim kemo shehayta. veim taan veamar shemma ad shello erastich neenast umikkachi mikkach taut o achar sheerastich nivalt birtzonech. hare ze macharim setam al mi shettoen sheker kede lechayyeveni mamon sheeni chayyav bo:

Taan veamar lo metzatiha betula vehi omeret lo ba alay vaadayin ani betula. bodkin otah o chozer uvoel bifne edim. amra ba alay uvetula metzaani kechol habbetulot vesheker hu toen. shoalin oto veomrin lo me haya haddavar ad sheamarta sheenah betula. im amar mippene shello matzati lah dam bodkin bemishpachtah shemma en lahem dam kelal lo dam nidda velo dam betulim im nimtzeu kullan ken hare zo bechezkatah. lo nimtzeu benot mishpachtah ken bodkin otah shemma choli gadol yesh bah sheyyavash lachluchit haevarim o shehayta mitannet baraav. martivin otah umaachilin otah umashkin otah ad shettavri vetibbael shenit venire im totzi dam im lav. veim en sham choli velo raav velo kayyotze bo hare zo taanat betulim. veaf al pi shemmatza dochak beet tashmish hoil velo yatza dam en kan betulim. shekkol betula yesh lah dam ben ketanna ben gedola ben naara ben bogeret ella mippene hacholi kemo shebbearnu. veim amar mippene shello matzati dochak ella petach patuach matzati shoalin al shenoteha shemma bogeret hi sherov habbogrot en lahen dochak shemmargishin bo harebe shehare gadla venitrappu evareha vechalu betuleha. veim lo bagra adayin omrin lo shemma hitteta o baalta benachat ulefichach lo hirgashta baddochak. im amar lo ki ella vadday petach patuach haya hare zo taanat betulim lechol betula shello bagra ben ketanna ben naara ben beria ben chola shekkol naara betula pitchah satum hu. veaf al pi sheyyatza haddam hoil umatza petach patuach en kan betulim:

Yesh geonim shehoru shehabbogeret en lah taanat damim veyesh lah taanat petach patuach. veen derech haggemara mara davar ze vetaut haya bannuschaot shellahem. uchevar badakti al sefarim rabbim vekadmonim umatzati shehaddavar kemo shebbearnu sheen levogeret ella taanat damim bilvad:

Chachamim hem shettikkenu ikkar ketubba leishsha vehem hitkinu veamru shekkol hattoen taanat betulim vehaishsha machcheshet oto neeman vealeha lehavi reaya lo al haish. shechazaka hi sheen adam toreach bisudda umafsidah vehofech simchato evel:
Vead matay yesh lo liton taanat betulim. im nistera miyyad. veim lo nistera afillu leachar sheloshim yom:

Horu kol haggeonim shezze sheamru chachamim shehu neeman im hichchishato ishto. lehafesidah ikkar hakketubba. aval hattosefet yesh lah. ella im ken noda biraya berura shehayta beula o shehodta lo shehi beula kodem shettitares vehitattu. lefichach yesh lo lehashebiah binkitat chefetz kedin kol hannishbain venotlin veachar kach tigbe hattosefet. veen lah lehashebio shello metzaah betula veachar kach tafsid ikkar ketubba shechazaka hi sheen adam toreach bisudda umafsidah. veyesh lah lehacharim setam al mi shettaan aleha sheker:
Hare sheratza lekayyemah achar shehifsida ikkar hakketubba chozer vechotev lah mea. lefi sheasur laadam lishhot im ishto shaa achat belo ketubba kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 12: Keshennose adam ishsha ben betula ben beula ben gedola ben ketanna achat bat yisrael veachat haggiyyoret o hameshuchreret yitchayyev lah baasara devarim veyizke bearbaa devarim:

Vehaasara shelosha mehen min hattora veellu hen. <small>(Shemot 21 10)</small> "sheerah. kesutah. veonatah". sheerah ellu mezonoteha. kesutah kemashmao. onatah lavo aleha kederech kol haaretz. vehashshiva middivre sofrim vechullan tenay bet din hem. haechad mehem ikkar ketubba. vehashshear hem hannikrain tenae ketubba veellu hen. lerappotah im chalta. velifdotah im nishbet. lekavrah im meta. velihyot nizzonet min nechasav. veyoshevet beveto achar moto kol zeman almenutah. velihyot benoteha mimmennu nizzonot minnechasav achare moto ad shettitaresna. velihyot baneha hazzecharim mimmennu yorshin ketubbatah yoter al chelkam bayrushsha sheim achehem:

Vehaarbaa shezzocha bahen kullam middivre sofrim veellu hen. lihyot maase yadeha shello. velihyot metziatah shello. vesheyyihye ochel kol perot nechaseha bechayyeha. veim meta bechayyav yirashenna. vehu kodem lechol adam bayrushsha:

Veod tikkenu chachamim sheyyihyu maase yede haishsha keneged mezonoteha. ufidyonah keneged achilat perot nechaseha. ukevuratah keneged yerushshato lichtubbatah. lefichach im amra haishsha eni nizzonit veeni osa shomin lah veen kofin otah. aval im amar habbaal eni zanech veeni notel kelum mimmaase yadayich en shomin lo shemma lo yesappeku lah maase yadeha bimzonoteha. umippene takkana zo yechashvu hammezonot mittenae hakketubba:

Kol haddevarim haellu af al pi shello nichtevu bishtar hakketubba vaafillu lo katvu ketubba ella nasa setam kevan shennesaah zacha bearbaa devarim shello vezachta haishsha baasara devarim shellah veenan tzerichin lefaresh:

Hitna habbaal shello yitchayyev beechad min haddevarim shehu chayyav bahen. o shehitnat haishsha shello yizke habbaal beechad min haddevarim shehu zoche bahem hattenay kayyam chutz mishshelosha devarim sheen hattenay moil bahen. vechol hammatne alehen tenao batel. veellu hen. onatah. veikkar ketubbatah. virushshatah:
Ketzad. hitna im haishsha sheen lah alav ona tenao batel vechayyav beonatah. shehare hitna al ma shekkatuv battora veeno tenay mamon:

Hitna immah lifchot meikkar ketubba o shekkatav lah matayim o mea ikkar ketubba vechatva lo shennitkabbela mehen kach vechach vehi lo nitkabbela tenao batel shekkol happochet livtula mimmatayim ulealmana mimmea hare beilato beilat zenut:

Hitna immah achar shennesaah shello yirashenna tenao batel veaf al pi sheyyerushshat habbaal middivre sofrim asu chizzuk ledivrehem keshel tora. vechol tenay shebbayrushsha batel veaf al pi shehu mamon shenneemar bah <small>(Bamidbar 27 11)</small> "lechukkat mishpat". uvishar haddevarim tenao kayyam, kegon shehitna immah sheen lah sheer uchesut, al menat shello yochal perot nechaseha, vechol kayyotze baze, tenao kayyam:

Kamma mezonot poskin laishsha. poskin lah lechem shete seuddot bechol yom seudda benonit shel kol adam beotah hair keadam sheeno lo chole velo gargeran umeoto maachol shel anshe otah hair. im chittim chittim veim seorim seorim. vechen orez vedochan o mishshear minin shennahagu bahen. ufoskin lah parperet leechol bah et happat kegon kitnit o yerakot vechayyotze bahen. veshemen laachila veshemen lehadelakat hanner uferot umeat yayin lishtot im haya minhag hammakom sheyyishtu hannashim yayin. ufoskin lah shalosh seuddot beshabbat uvasar o dagim keminhag hammakom. venoten lah bechol shabbat veshabbat maa kesef litzracheha kegon peruta lechibbus o lemerchatz vechayyotze bahen:

Bamme devarim amurim beani shebbeyisrael aval im haya ashir hakkol lefi ashro. afillu haya mamono rauy laasot lah kamma tavshile basar bechol yom kofin oto ufoskin lah mezonot kefi mamono. veim haya ani beyoter veeno yachol litten lah afillu lechem shehi tzericha lo kofin oto lehotzi vetihye ketubbatah chov alav ad shettimtza yado veyitten:
Baal sheratza litten leishto mezonoteha haruyot lah vetihye ochelet veshota leatzmah vehu shote veochel leatzmo harshut beyado uvilvad sheyyochal immah millele shabbat lelele shabbat:

Haishsha sheppasku lah mezonot vehotiru hammotar labbaal. haya balah kohen eno noten lah kol mezonoteha teruma mippene shettorach gadol hu lah leshamran middevarim hametammein uleachlan betohora ella noten lah mechetza chullin umechetza teruma:

Keshem sheadam chayyav bimzonot ishto kach hu chayyav bimzonot banav uvenotav hakketannim ad sheyyihyu bene shesh shanim. mikkan veelach maachilan ad sheyyigdelu ketakkanat chachamim. veim lo ratza goarin bo umachlimin oto ufotzrin bo. veim lo ratza machrizin alav batztzibbur veomrim peloni achzari hu veeno rotze lazun banav vahare pachut hu meof tame shehu zan et efrochav. veen kofin oto lezunam achar shesh:

Bamme devarim amurim beish sheeno amud veen yadua im rauy litten tzedaka o eno rauy aval im haya amud sheyyesh lo mamon harauy litten mimmennu tzedaka hammaspeket lahen motziin mimmennu baal karcho mishshum tzedaka vezanin otan ad sheyyigdelu:

Mi shehalach limdina acheret uvaa ishto levet din litboa mezonot. shelosha chodashim harishonim miyyom halichato en poskin lah bahen mezonot shechazaka sheen adam manniach beto rekan. mikkan veelach poskin lah mezonot. veim hayu lo nechasim bet din yordin linchasav umochrin limzonoteha. veen mechashshevin immah al maase yadeha ad sheyyavo balah, im matza sheasta hare ellu shello. vechen im lo amda baddin ella machra leatzmah limzonot michrah kayyam veenah tzericha hacheraza velo shevua ad sheyyavo balah veyiton o ad shettavo ligbot ketubbatah achar moto megalgelin aleha shello machra ella limzonot shehi tzericha lahen:

Ucheshem shebbet din mochrin limzon haishsha shehalach balah kach mochrin limzon banav uvenotav keshehen bene shesh shanim o pachot. aval yeter al shesh enan zanin otan minnechasav shello befanav af al pi shehu amud. vechen mi shennishtatta bet din yordin linchasav umochrim vezanin ishto uvanav uvenotav shehen bene shesh shanim o pachot umefarnesin otan:

Yesh min haggeonim shehora sheen poskin mezonot leishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam o shemmet balah ad sheyyehe shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah. veim lo totzi shetar ketubba en lah mezonot shemma natla ketubbatah mibbalah o machala lo ketubbatah sheen lah mezonot kemo sheyyitbaer. veyesh mi shehora shepposkin lah mezonot bechezkat shello natla velo machala veen matzrichin otah lehavi ketubba. vedati nota laze bemi shehalach balah hoil veyesh lah mezonot min hattora. aval im met balah en lah mezonot ad shettavi ketubba. mippene shehi ochelet betakkanat chachamim veod shennizzonet minnichse yorshim uleolam toanin leyoresh:

Halach balah velavta veachla kesheyyavo chayyav leshallem. amad echad middaat atzmo vezanah mishshello im yavo habbaal eno chayyav leshallem lo vahare ze ibbed et meotav mippene shello tzivvahu lezunah vehi lo lavta mimmennu:
Habbaal sheamar leishto beshaa shehalach teli maase yadayich bimzonotayich en lah mezonot sheillu lo ratzta bedavar ze velo samcha datah haya lah letavo o lomar lo en maase yaday maspikin li:

Hare sheamda baddin ufasku lah mezonot umachru ben din venatnu lah. o shemmachra hi leatzmah uva habbaal veamar hinnachti lah mezonot. hare zo nishbaat binkitat chefetz shello hinniach lah. lo tava velo machra ella shahata ad shebba hu omer hinnachti vehi omeret lo hinnachta ella laviti mizze venitparnasti. nishba shevuat hesset shehinniach lah veniftar veyishshaer hachov aleha:

Machra mittaltelin veamra limzonot macharti vehu toen veomer mezonotayich hinnachti nishbaat shevuat hesset shello hinniach. hare shello tava velo lavta velo machra ella dachaka atzmah bayyom uvallayla veasta veachla en lah kelum:

Hammaddir et ishto millehanot lo ben shepperesh ad zeman peloni ben shello peresh ella setam mamtinin lo sheloshim yom. im tammu yeme nidro o shello tammu vehittir nidro hare ze mutav veim lav yotzi veyitten ketubba. uveotan hashsheloshim yom tihye hi osa veochelet veyihye echad mechaverav mefarnes otah devarim shehi tzericha lahen yeter al maase yadeha im en maase yadeha maspikin lakkol:

Hammaddir et ishto shello titom echad mikkol happerot mamtinin lo ad sheloshim yom. yeter al ken yotzi veyitten ketubba. afillu hiddirah shello tochal maachol ra. afillu hiddirah mimmin shello achla oto miyyameha. yotzi achar sheloshim yom veyitten ketubba. nadra hi shello tochal echad mikkol happerot vekiyyem lah hu et nidrah o nadra benazir velo hefer lah. im ratza shetteshev tachtav velo tochal perot o tihye nezira teshev. veim amar eni rotze beishsha nadranit yotzi veyitten ketubba shehare haya beyado lehafer vehu kiyyem lah birtzono:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 13: Kamma hakkesut shehu chayyav litten lah. begadoym shel chamishshim zuz mishshana leshana mimmatbea otan hayyamim shennimtzeu hachamishshim shishsha dinarin urevia dinar kesef. notnin lah chadashim bimot haggeshamim veloveshet belaotehen bimot hachamma. vehashshechakim vehem motar hakkesut hare hen shellah kede shettitkasse bahem bime niddatah. venotnin lah chagora lematneha vechippa leroshah uminal mimmoed lemoed:

Bamme devarim amurim beotan hayyamim uveeretz yisrael aval bishar zemannim ushear hammekomot en haddamim ikkar. yesh mekomot sheyyihyu sham habbegadim beyoker harebe o bezol harebe. ella haikkar shessomchin alav shemmechayyevin oto litten lah begadim haruyim bimot haggeshamim uvimot hachamma befachot shelloveshet kol ishsha baalat bayit shebbeotah hammedina:

Uvichlal hakkesut shehu chayyav litten lah kele bayit umador sheyyoshevet bo. uma hen kele bayit mitta mutztzaat umappatz o machtzelet leshev aleha. uchele achila ushetiyya kegon kedera ukeara vechos uvakbuk vechayyotze bahen. vehammador shessocher lah bayit shel arba ammot al arba ammot vetihye rechava chutza lo kede lehishtammesh bah. veyihye lo bet hakkisse chutz mimmennu:
Vechen mechayyevin oto litten lah tachshitim kegon bigde tzivonin lehakkif al roshah ufaddachtah ufuch vesarak vechayyotze bah kede shello titganne alav:

Bamme devarim amurim beani shebbeyisrael aval beashir hakkol lefi ashro. vaafillu haya rauy liknot lah kele meshi verikma uchele zahav kofin oto venoten. vechen hammador lefi ashro vehattachshit uchele habbayit hakkol lefi ashro. veim katzra yado litten lah afillu keani shebbeyisrael kofin oto lehotzi vetihye hakketubba alav chov ad sheyyaashir:

Velo haishsha bilvad ella banav uvenotav hakketannim bene shesh o pachot chayyav litten lahem kesut hammaspeket lahem uchele tashmish umador lishkon bo. veeno noten lahem lefi ashro ella kefi tzarkan bilvad. ze hakkelal kol mi sheyyesh lo alav mezonot ben bechayyav ben achar moto yesh lo kesut uchele bet umador. vechol shebbet din mochrin limzonotav kach mochrin lichsuto uchele beto umedoro:

Haishsha shehalach balah ufasku lah bet din mezonot uchesut uchele bayit usechar mador en poskin lah tachshit shehare en lah baal shettitkashshet lo. aval mi shennishtatta balah o shennitcharesh poskin lah tachshit. vedin habbaal im ishto betaanat hakkesut vehakkelim usechar hammador kedinam betaanat hammezonot im amar hu natatti vehi omeret lo natatta din echad lakkol:

Hammaddir et ishto shello titkashshet beechad mikkol hamminin. baaniyyot shana achat yekayyem. yeter al ken o yattir et nidro o yotzi veyitten ketubba. uvaashirot sheloshim yom yekayyem. yeter al ken yattir et nidro o yotzi veyitten chetuva:

Hiddirah shello telech lemerchatz. bichrakkim shabbat achat bichfarim shete shabbatot. shello tinol minal. bichfarim shelosha yamim uvichrakkim meet leet. yeter al ze yattir et nidro o yotzi veyitten ketubba:

Hiddirah shello tishal velo tashil mikkele habbayit shedderech kol hashshechenot lishl otan ulehashilan kegon nafa uchevara rechayim vetannur vechayyotze bahem. yattir et nidro o yotzi veyitten ketubba mippene shemmashshiah shem ra bishchenoteha. vechen hi shennadra shello tishal velo tashil nafa uchevara verechayim vetannur vechayyotze bahem veshello teerog begadim naim levanim bemakom sheddarkan leerog otam levanim tetze belo ketubba mippene shemmashshiato shem ra bishchunato shehu kilay:

Makom sheddarkan shello tetze ishsha lashshuk bechippa sheal roshah bilvad ad sheyyihye aleha redid hachofe et kol gufah kemo tallit noten lah bichlal hakkesut redid happachut mikkol hardidin. veim haya ashir noten lah lefi ashro kede shettetze bo levet aviha o levayit haavel o levet hammishte. lefi shekkol ishsha yesh lah latzet velelech levet aviha levakkero ulevet haavel ulevet hammishte ligmol chesed lereoteha o likrovoteha kede sheyyavou hem lah. sheenah bevet hassohar ad shello tetze velo tavo. aval genay hu leishsha shettihye yotza tamid paam bachutz paam barchovot. veyesh labbaal limnoa ishto mizze velo yenichennah latzet ella kemo paam achat bechodesh o kemo paamayim bechodesh lefi hatztzorech. sheen yofi laishsha ella leshev bezavit betah shekkach katuv <small>(Tehillim 45 14)</small> "kol kevudda vat melech penima:"

Hammaddir et ishto shello telech levet aviha. bizman shehu immah bair chodesh echad mamtinin lo shenayim yotzi veyitten ketubba. uvizman shehu beir acheret regel echad mamtinin lo shenayim yotzi veyitten ketubba:

Hammaddir et ishto shello telech levayit haavel o levet hammishte. o yattir et nidro o yotzi veyitten ketubba shezze kemi sheasarah bevet hassohar venaal befaneha. veim haya toen mippene bene adam perutzim sheyyesh beoto bet haavel o bevet hammishte vehuchzeku sham perutzim shomin lo:

Haomer leishto en retzoni sheyyavou leveti avich veimmech achayich veachyotayich shomin lo vetihye hi holechet lahem kesheyyeera lahem davar. vetelech levet aviha paam bechodesh uvechol regel veregel. velo yikkansu hem lah ella im era lah davar kegon choli o leda. sheen kofin et haadam sheyyikkansu acherim birshuto. vechen hi sheamra en retzoni sheyyikkansu etzli immecha veachyotecha veeni shochenet immahem bechatzer achat mippene shemmerein li umetzerin li shomin lah. sheen kofin et haadam sheyyeshvu acherim immo birshuto:

Haish sheamar eni dar bemador ze mippene shebbene adam raim o perutzim o akkum bishchunati vaani mityare mehem shomim lo. veaf al pi shello huchzeku bifritzut shekkach tziuu chachamim harechek mishshachen ra. vaafillu haya hammador shellah motziin otah mimmennu veshochen ben bene adam kesherim. vechach hi sheamra ken af al pi shehu omer ani eni makpid alehem shomin lah mippene shehi omeret en retzoni sheyyetze alay shum ra bishchenut ellu:

Kol hayyishshuv aratzot aratzot hu. kegon eretz kenaan veeretz mitzrayim veeretz teman veeretz kush veeretz shinar vechayyotze bahen. vechol eretz veeretz mimmedinot uchefarim. veare yisrael leinyan nissuin shalosh aratzot hayu. yehuda veever hayyarden vehaggalil:

Ish shehaya meeretz min haaratzot venasa ishsha beeretz acheret kofin otah veyotza immo leartzo o tetze belo ketubba sheal menat ken nissea af al pi shello peresh. aval hannose ishsha beachat min haaratzot vehi meanshe otah haaretz eno yachol lehotziah leeretz acheret. aval motziah mimmedina limdina umikkefar lichfar beotah haaretz. veeno yachol lehotziah mimmedina lichfar velo mikkefar limdina sheyyesh devarim sheyyeshivat hammedina tova lahem veyesh devarim sheyyeshivat hakkefarim tova lahem:

Ucheshemmotziah mimmedina limdina umikkefar lichfar beotah haaretz eno yachol lehotziah minnave hayyafe lannave hara velo mera leyafe. mippene shehi tzericha lehittafel velivdok atzmah bannave hayyafe kede shello tihye bo kalla ucheura. vechen lo yotziah mimmakom sherubbo yisrael lemakom sherubbo akkum. uvechol makom motziin mimmakom sherubbo akkum lemakom sherubbo yisrael:

Bamme devarim amurim michutza laaretz lechutza laaretz o meeretz yisrael leeretz yisrael aval michutza laaretz leeretz yisrael kofin otah laalot afillu minnave hayyafe lannave hara vaafillu mimmakom sherubbo yisrael lemakom sherubbo akkum maalin. veen motziin meeretz yisrael lechutza laaretz vaafillu minnave hara lannave hayyafe [vaafillu mimmakom] sherubbo akkum lemakom sherubbo yisrael:

Amar haish laalot leeretz yisrael vehi enah rotza tetze belo ketubba. amra hi laalot vehu eno rotze yotzi veyitten ketubba. vehu haddin lechol makom meeretz yisrael im yerushalayim. shehakkol maalin leeretz yisrael veen hakkol motziin mishsham. hakkol maalin lirushalayim veen hakkol motziin mishsham:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 14:
Onna haamura battora. lechol ish veish kefi kocho uchefi melachto. ketzad. bene adam habberiim veharakkim vehaanuggim sheen lahem melacha shemmachshelet kochan ella ochlin veshotin veyoshvin bevattehen onatan bechol layla. happoalin kegon hachayyatin vehaorgin vehabbonim vechayyotze bahen. im hayta melachtan bair onatan paamayim beshabbat. veim hayta melachtan beir acheret onatan paam achat beshabbat. hachammarim paam achat beshabbat. vehaggammalim achat lishloshim yom. vehammallachin achat leshishsha chodashim. talmide chachamim onatan paam achat beshabbat mippene shettalmud tora mattish kochan vederech talmide chachamim leshammesh mittatan millele shabbat lelele shabbat: 
Yesh leishsha leakkev al balah shello yetze lischora ella lemakom karov shello yimmana meonatah velo yetze ella birshutah. vechen yesh lah lemano latzet mimmelacha sheonatah kerova limlacha sheonatah rechoka. kegon chammar shebbikkesh leheasot gammal o gammal leheasot mallach. vetalmide chachamim yotzin letalmud tora shello birshut neshotehen shetayim veshalosh shanim. vechen rach veanog shennaasa talmid chacham en ishto yechola leakkev: 
Nose adam kamma nashim afillu mea ben bevat achat ben bazo achar zo veen ishto yechola leakkev. vehu sheyyihye yachol litten sheer kesut veona karauy lechol achat veachat. veeno yachol lachof otan lishkon bechatzer achat. ella kol achat veachat leatzmah: 
Vechamma hi onatan. lefi minyan. ketzad. poel shehayu lo shete nashim yesh lazo ona achat beshabbat veyesh lazo ona achat beshabbat. hayu lo arba nashim nimtza onat kol achat mehen paam achat bishte shabbatot. vechen im haya mallach veyesh lo arba nashim tihye onat kol achat mehen paam achat bishte shanim. lefichach tziuu chachamim shello yissa adam yoter al arba nashim af al pi sheyyesh lo mamon harebe kede shettaggia lahen ona paam achat bechodesh: 
Hammaddir et ishto shettomar laacherim ma sheamar lah o ma sheamra lo middivre sechok vekallut rosh shemmedabber adam im ishto al iske tashmish hare ze yotzi veyitten ketubba sheen zo yechola lehaez paneha velomar laacherim divre kalon. vechen im hiddirah shettihye poelet beet tashmish shello titabber. o shehiddirah shettaase maase shotim udevarim sheen bahen mammash ella kishtut. hare ze yotzi veyitten ketubba: 
Hammaddir et ishto mittashmish hammitta shabbat achat mamtinin lo. yeter al ken yotzi veyitten ketubba o yafer nidro. afillu haya mallach sheonato leshishsha chodashim. shekkevan shennadar hare tziarah venityaasha. vechetzad maddirah. im amar lah tashmishi asur alayich o shennishba shello yeshammesh mittato lo nadar kelum. veim nishba nishba lashshav mippene shehu meshubad lah. amar lah hanaat tashmishech asura alay hare ze neder veasur leshammesh sheen maachilin laadam davar haasur lo: 
Asur laadam limnoa ishto meonatah veim avar umana kede letzaarah avar belo taase shebbattora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 10)</small> "sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra". veim chala o tashash kocho veeno yachol livol yamtin shishsha chodashim shemma yavri sheen lecha ona gedola mizzo. veachar kach o yittol mimmenna reshut o yotzi veyitten ketubba: 
Haishsha shemmana balah mittashmish hammitta hi hannikret moredet veshoalin otah mippene ma marda. im amra meastihu veeni yechola lehibbael lo middati kofin oto lishato legarshah lefi sheenah kishvuya shettibbael lesanu lah vetetze belo ketubba kelal vetittol belaoteha hakkayyamin ben minnechasim shehichnisa levalah venitchayyev beachrayutan ben minnichse melog shello nitchayyev beachrayutan. veenah notelet beshel baal kelum vaafillu minal shebberagleha umitpachat shebberoshah shellekachan lah poshetet venotenet lo vechol ma shennatan lah mattana mechazzeret oto. shello natan lah al menat shettittol vetetze: 
Veim marda mittachat balah kede letzaaro veamra hareni metzaeret oto bechach mippene sheasa li kach vechach o mippene shekkillelani o mippene sheasa immi meriva vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. sholchim lah mibbet din veomrin lah heve yodaat sheim at omedet bemirdech afillu ketubbatech mea mane hifsadt otah. veachar kach machrizin aleha bevatte kenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot bechol yom arba shabbatot zo achar zo veomrim pelonit marda al balah: 
Veachar hahachraza sholchin lah bet din paam sheniyya veomrim lah im at omedet bemirdech hifsadt ketubbatech. im amda bemirdah velo chazra nimlachin bah uteabbed ketubbatah velo yihye lah ketubba kelal. veen notnin lah get ad 12 chodesh veen lah mezonot kol 12 chodesh. veim meta kodem hagget balah yorshah: 
Kasseder hazze osin lah im marda kede letzaaro. vaafillu hayta nidda o chola sheenah reuya letashmish vaafillu haya balah mallach sheonato leshishsha chodashim vaafillu yesh lo ishsha acheret: 
Vechen arusa shehiggia zemanna lehinnase umarda kede letzaaro velo nisset hare zo moredet mittashmish. vechen yevama shello ratzta lehityabbem kede letzaaro kasseder hazze osin lah: 
Hammoredet hazzot keshehi yotzet achar 12 chodesh belo ketubba tachazir kol davar shehu shel baal. aval nechasim shehichnisa lo uvelaotehen kayyamim im tafsa en motziim miyyadah veim tefasan habbaal en motziin miyyado. vechen kol ma sheavad minnechaseha shekkibbel habbaal acharayutan alav eno meshallem lah kelum. ze hu din haggemara bemoredet: 
Veamru haggeonim sheyyesh lahem bevavel minhagot acherot bemoredet. velo pashtu otan hamminhagot berov yisrael verabbim ugedolim cholkin alehem berov hammekomot uchedin haggemara rauy litpos veladun: 
Hammored al ishto veamar hareni zan umefarnes otah aval eni ba aleha mippene shessenetiha mosifin lah al ketubbatah mishkal shesh usheloshim seorot shel kesef bechol shabbat veshabbat. veyeshev velo yeshammesh kol zeman shettirtze hi leshev. veaf al pi shekketubbatah holechet venosefet hare hu over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 10)</small> "lo yigra". sheim seneah yeshallechah aval leannot asur. velamma lo yilke al lav ze mippene sheen bo maase: 
Ish veishto shebbau levet din hu omer zo moredet mittashmish vehi omeret lo ki ella kederech kol haaretz ani immo. vechen im taana hi veamra shehu mored mittashmish vehu omer lo ki ella kederech kol haaretz ani immah. machrimin battechilla al mi shehu mored velo yode bevet din. veachar kach im lo hodu omrin lahem hityachadu bifne edim. nityachadu vaadayin hem toanin mevakkeshin min hannitan veosin peshara kefi koach haddayyan. aval livol bifne bene adam i efshar lefi sheasur livol bifne kol beriyya: 
Haishsha shechalta chayyav lerappeot otah ad shettavri. raa shehacholi aroch veyafsid mamon harebe lirfua veamar lah hare ketubbatech munnachat o rappei atzmech mikketubbatech o hareni megarshech venoten ketubba veholech shomin lo. veen rauy laasot ken mippene derech eretz: 
Nishbet chayyav lifdotah. veim haya kohen shekkevar neesra alav pode otah umachazirah levet aviha. afillu haya beir acheret metappel lah ad shemmachazirah limdinatah umegarshah venoten lah kol ketubbatah. haya balah yisrael shehashshevuya mutteret lo machazirah lo leishsha kemo shehayta veim ratza achar kach megarshah venoten lah ketubbatah: 
En mechayyevin et habbaal lifdot et ishto yoter al dameha ella kamma shehi shava kishar hashshevuyot. hayu dameha yoter al kede ketubbatah veamar hareni megarshah vezo ketubbatah vetelech vetifde et atzmah en shomin lo ella kofin oto ufode otah afillu hayu dameha ad asara bichtubbatah vaafillu en lo ella kede pidyonah. bamme devarim amurim befaam rishona aval im pedaah venishbet paam sheniyya veratza legarshah hare ze megarshah venoten ketubba vehi tifde et atzmah: 
Mi shennishbet ishto vehu bimdinat hayyam bet din yordin linchasav umochrin behacheraza ufodin otah kederech shehabbaal pode: 
Hammaddir et ishto neder shehu chayyav biglalo legarshah velitten ketubba venishbet achar shehiddirah eno chayyav lifdotah. shemmishshaa shehiddirah nitchayyev legarshah velitten lah ketubba: 
Haishsha shehayta asura al balah meissure lavin venishbet eno chayyav lifdotah ella noten lah ketubbatah vehi tifde et atzmah. vahalo hashshevuya asura lechohen vahare hu pode otah mippene shello hayta asura mikkodem veissur hashsheviyya hu sheggaram lah: 
Meta ishto chayyav bikvuratah velaasot lah misped vekinim kederech kol hammedina. vaafillu ani shebbeyisrael lo yifchatu lo mishshene chalilin umekonenet. im haya ashir hakkol lefi kevodo. veim haya kevodah yoter mikkevodo kovrin otah lefi kevodah shehaishsha ola im balah veenah yoredet afillu leachar mita: 
Lo ratza likbor et ishto veamad echad middaat atzmo ukevarah motziin mibbalah al karcho venotnin laze kede shello tihye zo mushlechet lakkelavim. haya bimdina acheret keshemmeta ishto bet din yordin linchasav umochrin belo hacheraza vekovrin otah lefi mamon habbaal ulefi kevodo o lefi kevodah:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 15:
Haisha shehirshat et bailah achar hannissuin sheyyimna onatah hare ze muttar. bamme devarim amurim beshehayu lo banim shekkevar kiyyem mitzvat periyya ureviyya aval lo kiyyem chayyav livol bechol ona ad sheyyihyu lo banim. mippene shehi mitzvat ase shel tora shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 1 22)</small> "peru urevu": 
Haish metzuvve al periyya ureviyya aval lo haishsha. veematay haish nitchayyev bemitzva zo mibben sheva esre. vechevan sheavru esrim shana velo nasa ishsha hare ze over umevattel mitzvat ase. veim haya osek battora vetarud bah vehaya mityare millissa ishsha kede shello yitrach bimzonot baavur ishto veyibbatel min hattora hare ze muttar lehitacher. shehaosek bemitzva patur min hammitzva vechol shekken betalmud tora: 
Mi shechashka nafsho battora tamid veshoge bah keven azay vedavek bah kol yamav velo nasa ishsha en beyado avon. vehu shello yihye yitzro mitgabber alav. aval im haya yitzro mitgabber alav chayyav lissa ishsha vaafillu hayu lo banim shemma yavo lide hirhur: 
Kamma banim yihyu leish vetitkayyem mitzva zo beyado. zachar unekeva. shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 5 2)</small> "zachar unekeva beraam". haya habben saris o shehayta habbat aylonit lo kiyyem mitzva zo: 
Noldu lo umetu vehinnichu banim hare ze kiyyem mitzvat periyya ureviyya. bene banim hare hem kevanim. bamme devarim amurim beshehayu bene habbanim zachar unekeva vehayu baim mizzachar unekeva af al pi shehazzachar ben bitto vehannekeva bat beno hoil vehem mishshene banav hen baim hare kiyyem mitzvat periyya ureviyya. aval im hayu lo ben uvat umetu vehinniach echad mehen zachar unekeva adayin lo kiyyem hammitzva: 
Hayu lo banim begeuto venitgayyer hu vehem hare ze kiyyem mitzva zo. hayu lo banim vehu eved venishtachrer hu vehem lo kiyyem mitzvat periyya ureviyya ad sheyyivvaled achar shennishtachrer shehaeved en lo yichus: 
Lo yissa adam akara uzekena veaylonit uketanna sheenah reuya leled ella im ken kiyyem mitzvat periyya ureviyya o shehayta lo ishsha acheret lifrot velirbot mimmenna. nasa ishsha veshahata immo eser shanim velo yalda hare ze yotzi veyitten ketubba o yissa ishsha haruya leled. veim lo ratza lehotzi kofin oto umakkin oto beshot ad sheyyotzi. veim amar eni boalah vahareni shochen immah bifne edim kede shello etyached immah ben sheamra hi ben sheamar hu en shomin ella yotzi o yissa ishsha haruya leled: 
Shahata eser shanim velo yalda vahare hu yore kechetz shichvat zera. chezkat hacholi mimmenna vetetze shello bichtubba veyesh lah tosefet. lo tihye zo pechuta meaylonit shello hikkir bah sheyyesh lah tosefet kemo sheyyitbaer. veim eno yore kechetz chezkat hacholi mimmennu bilvad veyotzi veyitten hakketubba kullah ikkar vetosefet: 
Hu omer mimmenna nimna holada vehi omeret mimmennu nimna mippene sheeno yore kechetz neemenet. veyesh lo lehacharim setam al mi shettoenet davar sheenah yodaat bo bevadday veachar kach yitten ketubba. veim amra eni yodaat im mimmenni im mimmennu en lah ikkar ketubba kemo sheamarnu haamed mamon bechezkat bealav ad shettiton bevadday sheeno yore kechetz. velamma neemenet hi betaana zo mippene shehi margeshet im yore kechetz im lo yore kechetz vehu eno margish: 
Haishsha shebbaa litboa mibbalah legarshah achar eser shanim mippene shello yalda vehi omeret sheeno yore kechetz shomin lah. af al pi sheenah metzuvva al periyya ureviyya tzericha hi levanim leziknutah. vechofin oto lehotzi veyitten ikkar ketubba bilvad shello katav lah hattosefet al menat shettetze lirtzonah vetittol: 
Halach bischora betoch eser shanim o shehaya habbaal chole o shehayta hi chola o shehayu chavushin bevet haasurin en ole lahen oto zeman min hamminyan: 
Hippila mona miyyom shehippila. im hippila vechazra vehippila shalosh peamim huchzeka linfalim veshemma lo zacha lehibbanot mimmenna veyotzi veyitten ketubba: 
Hu omer hippila betoch eser kede sheyyishhe immah vehi omeret lo hippalti neemenet sheenah machzeket atzmah baakarut. hu omer hippila shenayim vehi omeret hippalti shelosha neemenet sheenah machzeket atzmah bemappelet veyotzi veyitten ketubba. uvechol ze mashbiah shevuat hesset shello hippila o shehippila shelosha shebbetaana zo yitchayyev litten ketubba: 
Nisset larishon veshahata immo eser shanim velo yalda vehotziah mutteret lehinnase lesheni. shahata im hashsheni eser shanim velo yalda lo tinnase lishlishi. veim nisset lishlishi tetze shello bichtubba ella im ken yesh lo ishsha acheret o shekkiyyem mitzvat periyya ureviyya: 
Haishsha shebbaa levet din veamra bali eno yachol leshammesh kederech kol haaretz shimmush shemmolid o sheeno yore kechetz yaasu haddayyanin peshara veomrim lah rauy lich shettinhagi im balech ad shettishhi eser shanim velo tolidi veachar kach titbei. umegalgelin immah bedavar ze veen kofin otah leshev velo danin otah kedin hammoredet ella maarichin bedavar ze ad sheyyaasu peshara: 
Af al pi shekkiyyem adam mitzvat periyya ureviyya hare hu metzuvve middivre sofrim shello yibbatel millifrot velirbot kol zeman sheyyesh bo koach. shekkol hammosif nefesh achat beyisrael keillu bana olam. vechen mitzvat chachamim hi shello yeshev adam belo ishsha shello yavo lide hirhur. velo teshev ishsha belo ish shello techashed: 
Vechova al kol ish lekanneot leishto. amru chachamim en adam mekanne leishto ella im ken nichnesa bo ruach tohora. velo yekanne lah beyoter midday velo yeenos otah veyivol beal karchah ella bedatah umittoch sicha vesimcha: 
Vechen tziuu chachamim al haishsha shettihye tzenua betoch betah. velo tarbe sechok vekallut rosh bifne balah. velo titba tashmish hammitta befiha. velo tihye medabberet beesek ze. velo timna mibbalah kede letzaaro ad sheyyosif beahavatah ella nishmaat lo bechol et sheyyirtze. vetizzaher mikkerovav uvene beto kede shello yaavor alav ruach kina. vetitrachek min hakkiur umin haddome lechiur: 
Vechen tziuu chachamim sheyyihye adam mechabbed et ishto yoter miggufo veohavah kegufo. veim yesh lo mamon marbe betovatah kefi mamono. velo yattil aleha ema yetera. veyihye dibburo immah benachat. velo yihye atzev velo ragzan: 
Vechen tziuu al haishsha shettihye mechabbedet et balah beyoter midday veyihye aleha mora mimmennu vetaase kol maaseha al piv. veyihye beeneha kemo sar o melech. mehallechet betaavat libbo umarcheket kol ma sheyyisna. veze derech benot yisrael uvene yisrael hakkedoshim vehattehorim beziuugan. uvidrachim ellu yihye yishshuvan nae umeshubbach:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 16:
Hannechasim shemmachneset haishsha levalah ben korka ben mittaltelin ben avadim af al pi shehen nichtavin bishtar hakketubba enan nikrain ketubba ella neduneya shemam. veim kibbel habbaal acharayut hanneduneya alav venaaset birshuto im pachata pachata lo veim hotira hotira lo hare zo nikret nichse tzon barzel. veim lo kibbel acharayut hanneduneya alav ella hare hi birshut haishsha im pachata pachata lah veim hotira hotira lah hare zo nikret nichse melog: 
Vechen kol nechasim sheyyesh laishsha shello hichnisa otan levalah velo katvu otan bakketubba ella nisharu leatzmah. o naflu lah bayrushsha achar shennitarsa o nittenu lah bemattana. hakkol nikrain nichse melog shekkullan birshutah hen. veen nikrain ketubba ella ikkar ketubba shehu mea o matayim im hattosefet bilvad: 
Kevar hodanu shechachamim tikkenu ketubba laishsha vedin hattosefet kedin haikkar. velo tikkenu ligbotah kol zeman shettirtze ella hare hi kechov sheyyesh lo zeman veen hakketubba nigbet ella leachar mitat habbaal o im gershah. vechen hitkinu sheim hayu labbaal sadot tovot veraot uvenoniyyot uvaa haishsha ligbot ketubbatah mimmennu shello tigbe ella min haraa shebbinchasav vehi hannikret zibburit: 
Vechen hitkinu shekkeshettavo ligbot ketubbatah achar moto lo tigbe ad shettishshava binkitat chefetz shello hinniach etzlah kelum velo machra lo ketubbatah velo machala otah. veshamin lah kol ma shealeha ufochatin oto mikketubbatah. aval im gershah lirtzono gova belo shevua veen shamin kesut shealeha shehare lekachan lah vezachta bahen vehu rotze lehotziah lo hi: 
Vechen hitkinu shello tigbe haalmana ketubbatah ella min hakkarka. veenah gova mishshevach sheshshavchu nechasim leachar mitat habbaal. veen habbanot nizzonot leachar mitat avihen mishshevach sheshshavchu nechasim leachar mitato. veenah torefet bichtubbatah beshevach shehishbiach hallokeach af al pi shebbaal chov gove et hashshevach. udevarim ellu mikkulle ketubba hem: 
Vechen mikkulle ketubba shettittol haishsha bichtubbatah min happachut shebbammatbeot. ketzad. nasa ishsha bemakom echad vegershah bemakom acher. im hayu meot mekom hannissuin tovim mimmeot mekom haggerushin noten lah mimmeot mekom haggerushin. veim hayu meot mekom haggerushin tovim mimmeot mekom hannissuin noten lah mimmeot mekom hannissuin. bamme devarim amurim beshehaya bichtubbatah maot setam. aval im peresh bah matbea yadua ben baikkar ben battosefet hare hi kedin hammalve et chavero matbea yadua shennoten lo kamma shehillevahu kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot halevaa: 
Tikkenu haggeonim bechol hayeshivot shettihye haishsha gova ketubbatah achare mot balah af min hammittaltelin kederech shehitkinu levaal chov ligbot min hammittaltelin. ufashta takkana zo berov yisrael. vechen shear tenae ketubba kullan kichtubba hen veyeshnan bemittaltelin kevakkarka. chutz mikketubbat benin dichrin shello matzanu minhag yerushshatan pashut bechol hayeshivot. lefichach ani omer maamidin otah al din haggemara sheen yorshin ketubbat imman ella min hakkarka: 
Kevar nahagu bechol hammekomot sheyyadanu vesheshshamanu shiman sheyyichtevu bakketubba ben mimmekarkee ben mimmittaltele. vedavar ze tikkun gadol hu vaanashim gedolim unevonim hinhigu davar ze shehare ze tenay shebbemamon venimtza haalmana gova min hammittaltelin bitnay ze lo betakkanat acharonim: 
Hare shello katav kach bishtar hakketubba ella nasa setam. im haya yodea betakkana zo shel geonim gova. veim lav o shennistappek lanu haddavar mityashshevin baddavar harebe sheen koach betakkanat haggeonim ladun bah af al pi shello nitparsha kedin tenae ketubba shehem takkanat hassanhedrin haggedola ad shennotzi bah mamon min hayyorshim: 
Veod tikkenu chachamim sheyyihyu kol nichse habbaal achrain vearvain lichtubba afillu ketubbatah mane veyesh lo karka bealpayim zehuvim hakkol tachat shibud hakketubba. vechol sheyyimkor achar hannissuin minnechasav af al pi shemmimkaro kayyam veyesh lo limkor kol nechasav im yirtze yesh lah litrof otan bichtubbatah kesheyyegarshenna o kesheyyamut im lo timtza nechasim bene chorin. ucheshettitrof lo titrof ella bishvua binkitat chefetz kedin kol baale chovot. vetakkana zo kede shello tihye ketubba kalla beenav: 
Keshemmashbiin bet din o hayyorshin et haalmana keshettavo ligbot ketubbatah en mashbiin otah ella chutz levet din. mippene shebbatte dinin hayu nimnain millehashbiah shechoshshin lah shemma lo tedakdek al atzmah bishvua. veim ratzu hayetomim lehaddirah noderet lahen kol ma sheyyirtzu umaddirin otah bevet din veachar kach notelet ketubbatah: 
Meta haalmana kodem shettishshava en yorsheha yorshin mikketubbatah kelum sheen lah ketubba ad shettishshava. veim nisset kodem shettishshava hare zo nishbaat achar hannissuin venotelet kol zeman shettirtze. aval enah noderet venotelet shemma yafer lah habbaal: 
Yiched lah karka bichtubbatah ben sheyyiched bearbaat hammetzarim ben bemetzar echad gova et ketubbatah mimmenna belo shevua. vechen im katav lah mittaltelin vehen atzman kayyamin notelet otan belo shevua. vechen im nimkeru venilkach bahen mittaltelin acherim venoda sheellu hashsheniyyim middeme hammittaltelin harishonim notaltan belo shevua: 
Happogemet ketubbatah lo tippara ella bishvua. ketzad. hotzia shetar ketubba sheyyesh bo elef zuz habbaal omer nitkabbalt hakkol vehi omeret lo nitkabbalti ella kach vechach. vaafillu yesh aleha edim bammiktzat shennatla vaafillu dikdeka atzmah becheshbon ma shennatla bachatzi peruta lo tittol hashshear ella bishvua: 
Amar habbaal nitkabbalt hakkol vehi omeret lo nitkabbalti kelum vead echad meid aleha shennitkabbela hakkol o miktzat lo tippara kol hakketubba ella bishvua:
