Hannifraat shello befanav lo tippara ella bishvua. ketzad. hare sheggeresh et ishto vehalach lo. bet din yordin linchasav achar shettishshava umagbin otah ketubbatah. vehu sheyyihye bemakom rachok sheyyesh lahen torach lehodio. aval im haya bemakom karov lehodio sholchin lo umodiin oto. veim lo yavo tishshava vetittol: 
Happochetet ketubbatah nifraat shello bishvua. ketzad. hotzia shetar ketubba beelef zuz hu omer nitkabbalt hakkol vehi omeret lo nitkabbalti kelum veen li ella chamesh meot zuz veze shekkatav li elef amana hayta beni leveno hare zo nifraat shello bishvua. aval im amra en bishtar ketubbati ella chamesh meot enah nifraat bishtar ze sheyyesh bo elef zuz kelum shehare bittela oto ucheillu hodet shehu sheker. lefichach nishba shevuat hesset veniftar: 
Kol makom sheamarnu lo tippara ella bishvua omrim lah bet din hishshavi uteli. umakom sheamarnu tippara shello bishvua omrim labbaal amod veten lah veen atta neeman betaana zo ad shettavi reaya lidvarecha: 
Amar habbaal meatzmo tishshava li al taanati omrin lah hishshavi uteli vetishshava binkitat chefetz. hitnet immo shettigbe ketubbatah shello bishvua o shettehe neemenet bechol ma shettiton gova mimmennu belo shevua kelal. aval im baa ligbot miyyorshav tishshava veachar kach tittol: 
Hitnet immo shettigbe ketubbatah miyyorshav belo shevua o shettihye neemenet bechol ma shettiton al yorshav hare zo notelet mehen belo shevua. aval im baa litrof minnechasim meshubadim lo titrof ella bishvua. veaf al pi sheheeminah habbaal. sheen tenay habbaal moil ella alav veal yorshav aval lehafesid mamon acherim eno moil: 
Almana shehaya shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah nishbaat vegova ketubbatah leolam afillu achar mea shana. ben shehayta bevet balah ben shehayta bevet aviha. veim en shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah en lah kelum vaafillu ikkar ketubba vaafillu tava beyom mitat balah. vechen haggerusha afillu ikkar ketubba en lah ad shettotzi shetar ketubba: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemakom sheddarkan lichtov ketubba. aval bemakom sheen darkan lichtov ketubba ella somchin al tenay bet din hare zo gova ikkar ketubba af al pi sheen beyadah shetar ketubba ben nitgarsha ben nitalmena ben shehayta bevet balah ben shehayta bevet aviha. aval tosefet en lah bechol makom ella biraya berura: 
Vead kamma tigbe haalmana haikkar bemakom sheen kotvin ketubba. im hayta bevet balah gova leolam. veim hayta bevet aviha ad esrim vechamesh shana. veim baa litboa achar esrim vechamesh shana en lah kelum sheillu lo machala lo shatka kol zeman ze. vahare enah im hayyorshim kede shettomar nichlamti milletavan vehen immi babbayit: 
Lefichach im haya hayyoresh atzmo molich mezonoteha levet aviha umetappel bah yesh lah litboa ketubbatah vaafillu achar 25 shana mippene shezzo sheshshatka velo tava mippene shehi bosha min hayyoresh: 
Hi omeret betula nisseti veikkar ketubbati matayim vehabbaal o yorshav omrim beula nisset veen lah ella mea. im yesh edim sherau sheasu lah hamminhagot shennahagu anshe otah hair laasotan livtula kegon mine simcha o ketarim o malbush yadua o shear devarim sheen osin kach ella livtula hare zo notelet matayim. veim en lah edim baze hare zo notelet mane. veim haya habbaal kayyam yesh lah lehashebio shevuat hattora shehare hoda bemiktzat hattaana. veneeman hakkatan lehaid begadlo velomar zachur ani keshehayiti katan shennaasa liflonit minhag habbetulot. vechol haddevarim haellu bemakom sheen kotvin ketubba kemo sheamarnu: 
Haishsha sheamra levalah gerashtani neemenet, sheenah meizza paneha bifne balah. lefichach haishsha shehotzia shetar ketubba veen immah get veamra levalah gerashtani veavad gitti ten li ketubbati vehu omer lo gerashtich chayyav litten lah ikkar ketubba. aval eno noten lah hattosefet ad shettavi reaya sheggershah o sheyyatza get im hakketubba mittachat yadah: 
Amar lah habbaal kach haya gerashti venatatti lah kol hakketubba ikkar vetosefet vechatva li shover veavad shovri. mittoch sheyyachol lomar lo gerashti velo yitchayyev betosefet neeman umashbiah binkitat chefetz venoten lah et haikkar venishba hu shevuat hesset al hattosefet: 
Hotzia get veen beyadah shetar ketubba. im derech oto makom shello yichtevu ketubba gova ikkar ketubbatah bagget shebbeyadah. veim darkan lichtov ketubba afillu ikkar en lah ad shettotzi shetar ketubba kemo shebbearnu. venishba habbaal shevuat hesset al taanatah veniftar: 
Hotzia shete gittin ushete ketubbot gova shete ketubbot. hotzia shete ketubbot veget echad enah gova ella ketubba achat. vee zo mehen gova im shetehen shavot bittela haacharona et harishona veenah torefet ella mizzeman haacharona. veim haya beachat mishshetehen tosefet al chavertah gova beezo mehen shettirtze utevattel hashsheniyya: 
Hotzia shete gittin uchetubba achat en lah ella ketubba achat. shehamegaresh et ishto vehechezirah setam al ketubbatah harishona hechezirah. hotzia get uchetubba achar mitat habbaal. im get kodem lichtubba gova beget ze ikkar ketubba im en darkan lichtov ketubba vegova kol ma sheyyesh bichtubbatah zo shehare zachta bah bemitato. veim ketubba kadma et hagget en lah ella ketubba achat. sheal ketubbatah harishona hechezirah: 
Haishsha neemenet lomar met bali kede shettinnase kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot gerushin. umittenae hakketubba sheim tinnase leacher achar moto tittol kol ma shekkatav lah bichtubbatah. lefichach im baa levet din veamra met bali hattiruni lehinnase velo hizkira shem ketubba baolam mattirin otah lehinnase umashbiin otah venotnin lah ketubbatah. baa veamra met bali tenu li et ketubbati af lehinnase en mattirin otah sheal iske hakketubba baa vahare ze bechezkat shello met. veen datah lehinnase ella littol ketubba mechayyim bilvad. baa veamra met bali hattiruni lehinnase utenu li et ketubbati mattirin otah lehinnase venotnin lah ketubbatah mippene sheikkar devareha al iske hannissuin baa. aval im baa veamra tenu li et ketubbati vehattiruni lehinnase mattirin otah veen notnin lah ketubba. veim tafsa en motziin miyyadah:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 17:
Mi shehaya nasuy nashim rabbot umet. kol shennisset battechilla kodemet littol ketubbatah. veen achat mehen notelet ella bishvua. veen laacharona ella ma sheshshiyyera shellefaneha vegam hi nishbaat venotelet hashshear. vechen im haya alav shetar chov. im haya hachov kodem gove baal chov techilla. veim hakketubba kadma gova haishsha battechilla vehannishar labbaal chov: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayta hakkarka shebbau ligbot mimmenna kenuya lo bishat nissuim uveshaa shellava hu. shehaddin noten shekkol hakkodem bishtar techilla zacha techilla. aval im nasa nashim zo achar zo velava ben kodem nissuin ben achar nissuin veachar shennasa velava kana karka kullan cholkin keechad sheshshibud kullan keechad ba. shebbeshaa shekkana haya meshubad lakkol veen kan din kedima: 
Vechen im haya zeman hakketubbot vehashshetarot kullan yom echad o shaa achat bemakom shekkotvim shaot cholkin keechad sheen sham kodem. uleolam kol shekkadam vezacha bemittaltelin kede chovo o kede ketubbatah en motziin miyyado sheen din kedima bemittaltelin: 
Mi sheggeresh et ishto vealav shetar chov uva baal chov vehaishsha ligbot vehayu lo maot vekarka kede hachov vehakketubba. baal chov notel maot vehaishsha notelet ketubbatah min hakkarka. veim en lo ella karka sheen bah kede ligbot shenehem velo haya bah din kedima notnin oto levaal chov. veim nishar laishsha kelum tittol veim lav tiddache mippene baal chov. shehare baal chov hifsid vehotzi meotav vehaishsha lo chasra davar sheyyoter mishshehaish rotze lissa ishsha rotze lehinnase: 
Vechen mi shemmet vehinniach ishsha uvaal chov vekarka sheen bah din kedima haishsha nidchet mippene baal chov vehu gove chovo techilla: 
Vechevan shettikkenu haggeonim shettigbe haishsha uvaal chov min hammittaltelin vehaddavar yadua sheen din kedima bemittaltelin im lo hinniach mittaltelin kede litten lishnehem notnin levaal chov kol chovo techilla. veim nishar laishsha ma shettittol bichtubbatah tittol veim lav tiddache: 
Hayu ketuvin bichtubbatah nichse tzon barzel vetaana sheavdu o shellekacham habbaal hare hi benichse tzon barzel shellah kishar baale chovot venishbaat shello lakcha otan velo natna velo machala vecholeket im baale chovot: 
Mi shemmet o geresh veyesh lo nashim rabbot veen sham din kedima veen lo kede kol hakketubbot ketzad hen cholkot. roim im kesheyechalek hammamon al minyan hannashim yegia lappechuta shebbahen kede ketubbatah o pachot cholkot beshave. veim haya hammamon yoter al ze cholkim mimmennu kede sheyyaggia lappechuta shebbahen kashshiur ketubbatah. vechozrot vecholkot et hammotar ben hannotarot al derech harishon. ketzad. mi shehaya nasuy arba nashim ketubbatah shel rishona arba meot veshel sheniyya shelosh meot veshel shelishit matayim veshel reviit mea nimtza hakkol elef vegeresh kullan o met. im hinniach arba meot o pachot cholkot beshave vechol achat notelet mea o pachot. hinniach shemone meot im techalek ben kullan beshave nimtzet harviit notelet matayim vahare en bichtubbatah ella mea ella ketzad osin. lokchin arba meot zuz vecholkin otan benehen beshave mea mea nimtzet harviit natla kede ketubbatah vehalcha lah nishar kan arba meot zuz veshalosh nashim shebbeyad kol achat mishshelashtan mea zuz im tachalok haarba meot ben shelashtan beshave nimtza hashshelishit notelet matayim usheloshim veshalosh ushelish vahare en bichtubbatah ella matayim. lefichach lokchin mearba hammeot shelosh meot vecholkin ben shelashtan beshave shennimtzet hashshelishit shennatla matayim shellah vehalcha lah nishar kan mea ushete nashim cholkin et hammea beshave ben rishona usheniyya. nimtza beyad harishona matayim vachamishshim vechen beyad hashsheniyya. venimtza beyad hashshelishit matayim uveyad harviit mea veal derech zo cholkot leolam afillu hen mea: 
Hearev leishsha bichtubbatah af al pi shekkanu miyyado eno chayyav leshallem shemmitzva asa vahare lo chasra kelum. veim arev shel ketubbat beno hu vekanu miyyado chayyav leshallem shehaav biglal beno meshabed atzmo vegomer umakne. vekabbelan shel ketubba chayyav leshallem af al pi shello kanu miyyado. vee ze hu kabbelan ze sheamar leishsha hinnasi leze vaani noten ketubba zo. aval im amar lah hareni arev ketubba zo. ani porea ketubba zo. ani chayyav bah vechayyotze baze patur ella im ken haya aviv. hamegaresh et ishto yaddirenna hanaa veachar kach tippara ketubbatah min hakkabbelan o meaviv im haya arev. shemma yachazirenah venimtzeu osin kenuneya al nechasav shel ze: 
Vechen hammakdish nechasav vegeresh et ishto yaddirenna hanaa veachar kach tippara min happode miyyad hahekdesh shemma yaasu kenuneya al hahekdesh. aval hamegaresh et ishto uvaa litrof min hallakochot en mechayyevin oto lehaddirah ella nishbaat vetorefet. veim ratzta tachazor levalah shekkevar yadu hallakochot sheyyesh alav ketubbat ishsha vehem hifsidu al atzmam shellakchu nechasim shettachat shibudah: 
Habbaal shemmachar nechasav veachar kach katva ishto lallokeach din udevarim en li immecha vehiskima lemaasav af al pi shekkanu mimmenna hare zo torefet. shello katva lo ella shello tihye benah leven balah ketata veyesh lah lomar nachat ruach asiti levali. aval im kanu miyyad haishsha techilla sheen lah shibud al makom ze veachar kach machar oto habbaal enah torefet oto. vechen im machar habbaal veamar leishto lichtov lallokeach din udevarim en li immecha velo katva velo hiskima lemaasav venifsad hammecher vechazar habbaal umachar leish acher ben otah sade ben sade acheret veachar shemmachar habbaal hiskima lemaasav vekanu miyyadah, sheen lah shibud al sade zo, enah yechola litrof sheenah yechola lomar nachat ruach asiti levali shehare barishona keshello ratzta lo halcha birtzon balah: 
Mi shehayu lo shete nashim umachar et sadehu vekanu miyyad harishona sheen lah shibud al sade zo veenah torefet oto min hallokeach vehaya hakkinyan moil sheenah yechola liton bo nachat ruach asiti levali veachar kach met habbaal o geresh shetehen hashsheniyya motzia miyyad hallokeach shehare lo kanu miyyadah lallokeach. veharishona motzia miyyad hashsheniyya mippene shehi kadma velo hesira shibudah ella meal hallokeach. ucheshettachzor hassade larishona chozer hallokeach umotziah miyyadah shehare kanu lo. vechozrot chalila ad sheyyaasu peshara benehen: 
Almana ben min hannissuin ben min haerusin nishbaat umocheret mikkarka balah venifraat ketubbatah ben bevet din mumchin ben bevet din sheenan mumchin. vehu sheyyihyu hashshelosha haanashim neemanin veyodin beshumat hakkarka. veacharayut hammecher al nichse yetomim. aval haggerusha lo timkor ella bevet din mumchin. vechol hammocheret bevet din lo timkor ella behacheraza. uvehilchot halevaa yitbaer mishpat mechirat bet din heach hi. aval hammocheret shello bevet din enah tzericha hacheraza veaf al pi chen tzarich shelosha shehem neemanim veyodim beshuma: 
Almana shemmachra karka bichtubbatah benah leven atzmah im machra shave beshave michrah kayyam venishbaat shevuat almana achar shemmachra. vehu shemmachra leacher aval im shama leatzmah lo asta kelum vaafillu hichriza: 
Hayta ketubbatah matayim umachra sheve mea bematayim o sheve matayim bemea nitkabbela ketubbatah veen lah kelum uvilvad shettishshava shevuat almana. hayta ketubbatah mea umachra sheve mea vedinar bemea michrah batel vaafillu amra ani achazir et haddinar layyorshim: 
Hayta ketubbatah arba meot zuz umachra laze bemane velaze bemane shave beshave velaacharon sheve mea vedinar bemea shel acharon batel veshel kullam kayyam: 
Yesh laishsha limkor ketubbatah o littenah bemattana im met habbaal o gershah yavo halla veyittol veim meta hi bechayye balah o kodem shennishbea en lo kelum: 
Hare shemmachra miktzat ketubbatah o mishkena miktzat ketubbatah o natna leacher miktzat ketubbatah mocheret mikkarka balah vetigbe hashshear ben bevet din mumchin ben bishlosha neemanim. umocheret lichtubbatah afillu peamim rabbot ben bevet din ben bishlosha neemanim veyodim shumat hakkarka: 
Hammocheret ketubbatah ben laacherim ben levalah lo ibbeda shear tenae ketubba. veim haya lah ben zachar yoresh keneged hakketubba hazzot shennimkera minnichse aviv yoter al chelko kedin tenay ze. aval hammochelet ketubbatah levalah ibbeda kol tenae ketubbatah vaafillu mezonot en lah alav. umochelet ketubbatah enah tzericha kinyan velo edim kishar kol hammochalim sheenan tzerichin lo edim velo kinyan ella bidvarim bilvad. vehu sheyyihyu devarim shehaddaat somechet alehen velo yihyu divre sechok vehittul o divre temah ella bedaat nechona:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 18: Almanna nizzonet minnichse yorshin kol zeman almenutah ad shettittol ketubbatah. umishshettitba ketubbatah bevet din en lah mezonot. vechen im machra ketubbatah kullah o mishkena ketubbatah o asta ketubbatah appotiki leacher. vehu shettomar lo po tigbe chovcha. ben sheasta devarim ellu bevet din mumchin ben shello bevet din ben sheasta bechayye balah ben sheasta leachar mitat balah en lah mezonot min hayyorshim. aval im machra miktzatah yesh lah mezonot. umishshettitares haalmana ibbeda mezonoteha:

Keshem shennizzonet achar moto minnechasav kach notnin lah kesut uchele tashmish umador (o yoshevet bemador) shehayta bo bechayye balah umishtammeshet becharim uchesatot baavadim uvishfachot shennishtammesha bahen bechayye balah. nafal hammador en hayyorshin chayyavin livnoto. veim amra hanichu li vaani evnennu mishshelli en shomin lah. vechen lo techazzek bidko velo titche oto ella teshev bo kema shehu o tetze. veyorshin shemmachru medor almana lo asu velo kelum:

Nafal habbayit o shello haya levalah bayit ella besachar notnin lah mador lefi kevodah. vechen mezonoteha uchesutah lefi kevodah. veim haya kevod habbaal gadol mikkevodah notnin lah lefi kevodo mippene sheola immo veenah yoredet afillu leachar mita:

Birkat habbayit merubba ketzad. chamishsha shehaya mezonot kol echad mehen kav besheyyochal levaddo im hayu chamishshetan bevayit echad veochlin beeruv maspik lahen arba kabbin. vehu haddin lishar tzarche habbayit. lefichach almana sheamra enenni zaza mibbet avi pisku li mezonot utenu li sham. yecholin hayyorshin lomar lah im at etzlenu yesh lach mezonot veim lav en anu notnim lach ella kefi birkat habbayit. veim hayta toenet mippene shehi yalda vehem yeladim notnin lah mezonot hammaspikin lah levaddah vehi bevet aviha. umotar mezonot haalmana umotar hakkesut layyorshin:

Almana shechalta im tzericha lirfua sheen lah kitzva hare zo kimzonot veyorshin chayyavin bah. veim hi tzericha refua sheyyesh lah kitzva hare zo mitrappea mikketubbatah. nishbet en hayyorshin chayyavin lifdotah afillu hayta yevama vaafillu nishbet bechayye balah vamet vehi bashshivyah en chayyavin lifdotah minnechasav ella nifdet mishshel atzmah o tittol ketubbatah vetifde atzmah:

Meta haalmana yorshe habbaal chayyavin bikvuratah. veim nishbea shevuat almana veachar kach meta yorsheha yorshin ketubbatah vehen chayyavin bikvuratah aval lo yorshe habbaal. maase yede haalmana layyorshin. veyoresh sheamar laalmana teli maase yadayich bimzonotayich en shomin lo. aval hi sheratzta baze shomin lah:
Vechol melachot shehaishsha osa levalah almana osa litomim chutz mimmezigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta veharechatzat panav yadav veraglav:
Metziat haalmana uferot nechasim shehichnisa labbaal leatzmah veen layyoresh bahem kelum:

Vehannechasim atzmam shehem nedunyatah notelet otan belo shevua veen layyorshim bahem din leolam ella im ken hotiru bechayye habbaal vehayu nichse tzon barzel shehammotar labbaal. veim meta haalmana belo shevua yorsheha yorshim nedunyatah af al pi shehu nichse tzon barzel. veim haya bahen motar hammotar leyorshe habbaal:

Almana shettafsa mittaltelin kede shettizzon mehen ben shettafsa mechayyim ben shettafsa achar moto afillu tafsa kikkar zahav en motziin miyyadah ella kotvin aleha bet din ma shettafsa ufoskin lah mezonot umechashshevin immah vehi nizzonet mimma shebbeyadah ad shettamut o ad shello yihyu lah mezonot. veyikchu hayyorshin et hashshear:

Vechen im tafsa mittaltelin bichtubbatah bechayye balah vamet gova mehen. aval im tafsa achar moto lichtubbatah enah gova mehen af al gav shettikkenu haggeonim shettigbe hakketubba utenae hakketubba min hammittaltelin. lefichach tizzon haalmana min hammittaltelin af al pi shello tafsa:

Veim hinniach balah mittaltelin velo tafsa otan hayyorshim notlin otan vehen maalin lah mezonot veenah yechola leakkev alehen velomar yihyu hammittaltelin munnachin bevet din ad sheizzon mehen shemma yovdu velo yihyu li mezonot. vaafillu hitneta alav beferush shettizzon min hammittaltelin enah meakkevet. vechaze danin tamid bechol batte dinin:
Aval im hinniach karka yechola hi leakkev alehen shello yimkeru veim machru enah motzia miyyad hallakochot sheen haishsha vehabbanot nizzonot ella minnechasim bene chorin:
Hinniach nashim rabbot af al pi shennesaan zo achar zo nizzonot beshave (kemo) sheen din kedima bemittaltelin:

Almana shennafla lifne yavam bishlosha chodashim harishonim nizzonet mishshel baal. veim hukkar haubbar vechen im henichah meubberet nizzonet veholechet ad shetteled. yalda ben shel kayyama nizzonet veholechet kol yeme almenutah kishar kol hannashim. lo nimtzet meubberet achar shelosha chodashim o shehippila enah nizzonet lo mishshel baal velo mishshel yavam ella tovaat yevamah lichnos o lachalotz:
Tava yevamah lichnos o lachalotz veamad bevet din uvarach o shechala o shehaya hayyavam bimdinat hayyam hare zo nizzonet mishshel yavam belo shevua kelal:
Nafla lifne yavam katan en lah mezonot ad sheyyigdal veyihye kishar hayyavamin:

Mi sheyyiched karka leishto bimzonoteha bishat mita veamar yihye makom peloni limzonot hare ribba lah mezonot. veim haya secharo pachot mimmezonot haruyot lah notelet hashshear mishshear nechasim. veim haya secharo yoter min harauy lah notelet hakkol. aval im amar lah yihye bemakom peloni bimzonoteha veshatka en lah ella perot oto makom bilvad shehare katzatz lah mezonot:

Almana shebbaa levet din litboa mezonot yesh mi shehora shepposkin lah mezonot veen mashbiin otah. veen rauy lismoch al horaa zo mippene shennitchallef lo haddavar beishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam. verabbotay horu sheen lah mezonot mibbet din ad shettishshava shehare zo baa lehippara minnichse yetomim vechol hannifra minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella bishvua. velaze dati nota vechen rauy ladun:

Almana shebbaa levet din litboa mezonot mashbiin otah battechilla umochrin belo hacheraza venotnin lah mezonot. vechen yesh lah limkor limzonot shello bevet din mumchin ella bishlosha anashim neemanim belo hacheraza. vechen im machra limzonot benah leven atzmah shave beshave michrah kayyam uchesheyyavou hayyorshin lehashebia otah nishbaat:

Vechamma mochrin limzonot kede lazun mehem shishsha chodashim lo yoter al ze. umochrin al menat sheyyihye hallokeach noten lah mezon sheloshim yom vechozeret umocheret paam sheniyya leshishsha chodashim. vechen mocheret veholechet leolam ad sheyyishshaer min hannechasim kede ketubbatah gova ketubbatah min hashshear veholechet lah:

Almana sheppasku lah bet din mezonot en mechashshevin immah al maase yadeha ad sheyyavou hayyorshim veyitbeuha. im matzu lah maase yadeha notlin oto veim lav holchin ledarkam. vaani omer sheim hayu hayyorshim ketannim bet din mechashshevin immah ufoskin maase yadeha kederech shepposkin lah mezonot:

Almana sheen shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadah en lah mezonot shemma machala ketubbatah o machra o mishkena otah. af al pi shello taan yoresh toanin anu lo veomrim lah havii ketubbatech vehishshavi uteli mezonotecha ella im en darkam lichtov ketubba:

Haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam uvaa veamra met bali ratzta nizzonet kedin kol haalmanot ratzta notelet ketubba. amra gershani bali enah neemenet venizzonet minnechasav ad kede ketubbatah mikkol panim. sheim adayin hi ishto yesh lah mezonot. veim gershah kemo sheamra yesh lah ketubba shehare ketubbatah beyadah. lefichach notelet mezonot ad kede ketubbatah veholechet lah:
Haishsha shehaya lah sefek gerushin umet balah enah nizzonet minnechasav sheen motziin miyyad hayyoresh missafek. aval bechayye balah yesh lah mezonot ad shettitgaresh gerushin gemurin:

Almana aniyya sheshshahata shete shanim velo tava mezonot o ashira sheshshahata shalosh shanim velo tava vittera veen lah mezonot bashshanim sheavru ella mishshaa shettava. veim shahata pachot mizze afillu beyom echad lo vittera ella tovaat venotelet mezon hashshanim sheavru:

Almana shettava mezonot min hayyorshim hem omrim natannu vehi omeret lo natalti kol zeman shello nisset al hayetomim lehavi reaya o tishshava shevuat hesset vetittol. mishshennisset aleha lehavi reaya o yishshavu hayyorshim shevuat hesset shennatnu lah:

Din tosefet ketubba kedin haikkar. lefichach almana shettava o machra o machala o mishkena tosefet ketubbatah im haikkar en lah mezonot. veim tava miktzat vehinnicha miktzat hare zo kemi shettava miktzat haikkar vehinnicha miktzato. vechol hammocheret o hammochelet setam machra umachala hattosefet im haikkar sheshshenehem ketubba shemam bechol makom:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 19:
Mittennae hakketubba sheyyihyu banim hazzecharim yorshoym ketubbat imman unedunyatah shehichnisa betorat nichse tzon barzel veachar kach cholkin shear hayerushsha im achehem beshave: 
Ketzad. nasa ishsha ketubbatah unedunyatah elef veyalda ben umeta bechayyav. veachar kach nasa ishsha acheret ketubbatah unedunyatah matayim veyalda ben umeta bechayyav. veachar kach met hu vehinniach alpayim. beno min harishona yoresh elef shebbichtubbat immo. uveno min hashsheniyya yoresh matayim shebbichtubbat immo vehashshear yorshim oto beshave. nimtza beyad ben harishona elef vearba meot. uveyad ben hashsheniyya shesh meot: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshehinniach yoter al kede shete ketubbot dinar echad o yoter kede sheyyachleku hashshear beshave. aval im lo hinniach yoter dinar cholkim hakkol beshave sheim yirshu ellu ketubbat imman veellu ketubbat imman velo yishshaer dinar echad lachalok oto ben hayyorshim nimtza tenay ze mevattel chilluk yerushsha ben habbanim beshave shehu min hattora: 
Vehu haddin lemi shennasa nashim rabbot ben bazo achar zo ben bevat achat umetu kullan bechayyav velo mehen banim zecharim im haya sham yoter al kede kol hakketubbot dinar kol echad veechad yoresh ketubbat immo vehashshear cholkin beshave: 
Amru hayetomim hare anu maalin al nichse avinu yoter dinar kede sheyyittelu ketubbat imman en shomin lahem. ella shamin et hannechasim bevet din kamma shehayu shavin bishat mitat avihen veaf al pi shennitrabbu o nitmaatu achare mitat avihen kodem sheyyavou lachalok en shamin otan ella kishat mitat avihen: 
Haya sham yoter al kede kol hakketubbot dinar o yoter af al pi sheyyesh alav shetar chov keneged hayyoter eno memaet ella kol echad mehen yoresh ketubbat immo: 
Mi shehaya nasuy shete nashim umeta achat mehen bechayyav veachat achar moto velo banim mishshetehen af al pi shello hinniach yeter al shete hakketubbot im nishbea hashsheniyya shevuat almana kodem shettamut baneha kodmim lirushshat ketubbatah. mippene sheenan yorshin ketubbat imman bitnay ze ella yerushsha shel tora veachar kach yorshin bene harishona ketubbat imman bitnay ze. veim nishar sham kelum cholkin oto beshave. veim meta kodem shettishshava bene harishona yorshim ketubbat imman bilvad vehashshear cholkin beshave: 
Haya nasuy shete nashim vehayu lo banim mehen vamet veachar kach metu hannashim im nishbeu veachar kach metu kol echad veechad yoresh ketubbat immo birushsha shel tora velo bitnay ze. lefichach en mashgichin im yesh sham motar o en sham. veyorshe harishona kodmin leyorshe hashsheniyya. veim lo nishbeu cholkin habbanim hakkol beshave veen sham yerushshat ketubba lefi sheen laalmana ketubba ad shettishshava: 
Achat nishbea veachat lo nishbea zo shennishbea baneha yorshin ketubbatah techilla vehashshear cholkin oto beshave. vechol hayyoresh ketubbat immo shemmeta bechayye aviv eno toref minnechasim meshubadim ella mibbene chorin kechol hayyorshin: 
Umittenae ketubba shettihyena habbanot nizzonot minnichse avihen achar moto ad sheyyitarsu o ad sheyyivgeru. bagra habbat af al pi shello nitarsa o nitarsa af al pi shello bagra en lah mezonot. uvat hannizzonet minnichse aviha leachar moto maase yadeha umetziatah leatzmah lo laachim: 
Poskin labbat mezonot uchesut umador minnichse aviha kederech shepposkin laalmana. umochrin limzon habbanot uchesutan belo hacheraza kederech shemmochrin limzon haalmana uchesutah. ella shehaishsha poskin lah lefi kevodah uchevod habbaal velabbanot poskin lahen davar hammaspik lahen bilvad. veen habbanot nishbaot: 
En habbanim yorshin ketubbat imman. velo habbanot nizzonot bitnaim ellu ad sheyyihye shetar ketubba yotze mittachat yadam. aval im en sham shetar ketubba en lah kelum. shemma machala imman ketubbatah. veim en darkam lichtov ketubba yesh lahen kefi hattenaim: 
Mi shetztzivva bishat mitato laakor echad mittenae ketubba. kegon sheamar el yizzonu benotav minnechasav o al tizzon almanato minnechasav o al yirshu banav ketubbat imman en shomin lo. natan kol nechasav bemattana laacherim hoil umattenat shechiv mera enah kona ella leachar mita kemo sheyyitbaer hare hammattana vechiyyuv hannechasim bitnain ellu bain keechad ulefichach almanato uvenotav nizzonot minnechasav uvanav yorshim ketubbat imman shemmeta bechayye balah: 
Bat hamemaenet hare hi kishar habbanot veyesh lah mezonot. aval bat hayevama uvat hashsheniyya uvat haarusa uvat haanusa en lahen mezonot achar mitat avihen bitnay ze. aval bechayye avihen hu chayyav bimzonotan kedin shear habbanim vehabbanot bechayye avihen: 
Hameares bat hannizzonet min haachin chayyav bimzonoteha mishsheat haerusin shehare en lah mezonot meacheha (ella ad shettitares o ad shettibbager vezo) enah bogeret kede shettizzon atzmah ella ketanna o naara veen adam rotze shettitbazze arusato vetelech vetishal al happetachim: 
Nisset habbat umeana o nitgarsha o nitalmena afillu hi shomeret yavam hoil vechazra levet aviha vaadayin lo bagra hare zo nizzonet minnichse aviha ad shettibbager o ad shettitares: 
Mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot yirshu habbanim kol hannechasim vehem zanin et achyotehem ad sheyyivgeru o ad sheyyitarsu. bamme devarim amurim beshehinniach nechasim sheefshar sheyyizzonu mehem habbanim vehabbanot keachat ad sheyyivgeru habbanot veellu hen hannikrain nechasim merubbin. aval im en bannechasim shehinniach ella pachot mizze motziin mehem mezonot labbanot ad sheyyivgeru venotnin hashshear labbanim. veim en sham ella kede mezon habbanot bilvad habbanot nizzonot mehen ad sheyyivgeru o ad sheyyitarsu vehabbanim yishalu al happetachim: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshehinniach karka aval im lo hinniach ella mittaltelin hoil uvetakkanat haggeonim hu sheyyizzonu habbanot min hammittaltelin hare habbanim vehabbanot nizzonot keechad min hannechasim haellu hammuatin. shello tikkenu lahem bemittaltelin ella sheyyihyu kevanim vechaze horu haggeonim: 
Hinniach karka vehayu hannechasim merubbin venitmaatu achar ken kevar zachu bahen yorshim. hayu muatin bishat mita venitrabbu achar kach habbanim yorshin otan. vaafillu lo nitrabbu im kadmu habbanim umachru nechasim muatin michran kayyam: 
Hayu hannechasim merubbin veyesh alav chov o shehitna im ishto sheyyazun et bittah en hachov velo mezonot bat ishto memaatin bannechasim ella yirshu habbanim hakkol veyittenu levaal chov chovo veyazunu bat eshet avihen ad zeman sheppasak veyazunu achyotehen ad sheyyivgeru o ad sheyyitarsu veyetzu mittachat yedehem: 
Hinniach almana uvat mimmenna o meishsha acheret veen bannechasim kede sheyyizzonu shetehen haalmana nizzonet vehabbat tishal al happetachim. vechen ani omer shemmezonot habbat kodmin lirushshat habben et ketubbat immo shemmeta bechayye aviv veaf al pi sheshshenehem mittenae hakketubba. vekal vachomer haddevarim im nidchet yerushsha shel tora mippene mezonot habbat lo tiddache yerushshat hakketubba shehi tenay bet din mippene mezonot habbat: 
Mi shemmet vehinniach banot gedolot uketannot velo hinniach ben en omrim yizzonu hakketannot ad sheyyivgeru veyachleku shear hannechasim beshave ella kullan cholkot beshave:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 20:
Tziuu chachamim sheyyitten adam minnechasav meat levitto kede shettinnase bo veze hu hannikra parnasa. hammassi et bitto setam lo yifchot lah mikkesut shepposkin leeshet ani shebbeyisrael kemo shebbearnu. bamme devarim amurim beshehaya haav ani aval im haya ashir hare ze rauy litten lah kefi ashro: 
Peresh al habbaal sheen lah kelum vesheyyachnisenna arumma en lah kelum. velo yomar habbaal keshettavo leveti achassenna ella mechassenna vehi bevet aviha: 
Haav shemmet vehinniach bat omdin dato kamma haya belibbo litten lah lefarnasa venotnin lah. uminnayin yodin umdan dato. mereav umeyuddaav umassao umattano uchevodo. vechen im hissi bat bechayyav omdin bah. veim lo yadu lo bet din umdan daat notnin lah minnechasav issur lefarnasatah: 
Hinniach banot rabbot kol shettavo lehinnase notnin lah issur hannechasim. veshelleachareha issur ma sheshshiyyera rishona. veshel achareha issur ma sheshshiyyera sheniyya. veim bau kullan lehinnase keachat rishona notelet issur. vehashsheniyya issur ma sheshshiyyera rishona. vehashshelishit issur ma sheshshiyyera sheniyya vechen afillu hen eser vechozrot vecholkot kol haissurim beshave. ushear hannechasim laachim: 
Issur ze shehu lefarnasa eno mittenae ketubba lefichach afillu lefi takkanat chachamim (harishonim) veacharonim enah notelet ella min hakkarka veyesh lah ligbot issur ze missechirut hakkarka veim ratzu haachin litten lah maot keneged issur hakkarka notnin: 
Habbat beissur ze kevaalat chov shel achin hi lefichach notelet oto min habbenonit belo shevua. veim metu haachin notelet oto min benehem mizzibburit uvishvua shehare hi nifraat minnichse yetomim vehabba lippara minnichse yetomim lo yippara ella mizzibburit uvishvua kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot halevaa: 
Vehaachim shemmachru o mishkenu karka avihem habbat torefet min hallakochot parnasatah kederech shettorfim kol baale chovot min hallakochot kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot halevaa: 
Mi shehissi banot gedolot venisharu ketannot umet belo ben en notlin parnasa liktannot veachar kach cholkot hannechasim ella cholkot kullan beshave: 
Mi shemmet vehinniach shete banot uven vekadma rishona venatla issur nechasim velo hispika hashsheniyya ligbot ad shemmet habben venaflu kol hannechasim lishtehen en hashsheniyya notelet issur ella cholkot beshave vezachta harishona beissur shellah: 
Mi shetztzivva bishat mita al tefarnesu benotay minnechasay shomim lo sheen ze mittenae ketubba: 
Mi shemmet vehinniach almana uvat kevar bearnu shemmezonot haalmana kodmin limzonot habbat. vechen im nisset habbat enah notelet issur nechasim mippene mezonot haalmana. vaafillu meta habbat achar shennisset en habbaal yoresh parnasa haruya lehinnaten lah shehare hannechasim kullan bechezkat haalmana shettehe nizzonet mehen: 
Ketanna yetoma shehissiatah immah o acheha ledatah venatnu lah mea o chamishshim zuz yechola hi mishshettagdil lehotzi miyyadam parnasa haruya lah. o beumdan daat haav o beissur hakkarkaot. vaafillu lo hayu haachin zanin otah. veaf al pi shello machata bishat nissuin mippene shehakketanna enah bat mechaa: 
Nisset habbat achar sheggadla ben naara ben bogeret velo tava parnasatah ibbeda parnasatah. veim michata beet nissueha hare zo motzia et harauy lah kol zeman shettirtze. bagra veodah bevet aviha ben shebbagra achar moto ben shehinnichah bogeret im pasku haachin millatet mezonoteha shehare en lah mezonot kemo shebbearnu veshatka velo tava parnasatah ibbeda parnasatah. veim michata lo ibbeda parnasatah. lo pasku haachim mezonoteha vezanu otah beveger af al pi shello michata lo ibbeda parnasatah kol zeman shehen zanin otah. sheyyesh lah liton mippene shehen zanin otah af al pi sheenan chayyavin vehi adayin lo nisset mippene ze lo tava parnasatah: 
Mi shetztzivva latet levitto kach vechach maot lefarnasatah likkach bahen karka ben shehaya shechiv mera ben shehaya bari umet vahare hammaot beyad hashshalish veamra habbat tenu otam levali kol ma sheyyirtze yaase bahen. im hayta gedola venisset harshut beyadah. veim adayin meoreset hi yaase shalish ma shehushlash beyado. veim adayin ketanna hi afillu nisset en shomin lah ella yaase hashshalish kemo shetztzivva haav:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 21: Metziat haishsha umaase yadeha levalah. uma hi osa lo. hakkol keminhag hammedina. makom sheddarkan leerog oreget. lirkom rokemet. litvot tzemer o pishtim tova. veim lo haya derech neshe hair laasot kol hammelachot haellu eno kofah ella litvot hatztzemer bilvad. shehappishtan mazzik et happe veet hassefatayim vehatteviyya hi hammelacha hameyuchedet lenashim shenneemar <small>(Shemot la 25)</small> "vechol ishsha chachmat lev beyadeha tavu":

Dachaka atzmah veasta yoter min harauy lah hammotar labbaal. haya lo mamon harebe afillu haya lah kamma shefachot enah yoshevet levattala belo melacha shehabbattala mevia lide zimma. aval en kofin otah laasot melacha kol hayyom kullo ella lefi rov hammamon memaetet bimlacha:

Hammaddir et ishto shello taase melacha kelal yotzi veyitten ketubba shehabbattala mevia lide zimma. vechen kol ishsha rochetzet levalah panav yadav veraglav umozeget lo et hakkos umatztzaat lo et hammitta veomedet umeshammeshet bifne balah kegon shettitten lo mayim o keli o tittol millefanav vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. aval enah omedet umeshammeshet bifne aviv o bifne beno:
Umelachot ellu osa otan hi beatzmah vaafillu hayu lah kamma shefachot en osin melachot ellu labbaal ella ishto:

Yesh melachot acherot shehaishsha osa levalah bizman shehen aniyyim veellu hen. ofa happat battannur, veezra tikken shettihye ishsha mashkemet veofa kede shettihye happat metzuya laaniyyim. umevashshelet et hattavshilin. umechabbeset et habbegadim. umenika et benah. venotenet teven lifne behemto aval lo lifne bekaro. umetachenet. ketzad metachenet. yoshevet barechayim umeshammeret hakkemach veenah tochenet. o mechammeret achar habbehema kede shello yibbatlu harechayim. veim haya darkan litchon berechayim shel yad tochenet:

Bamme devarim amurim baaniyyim aval im hichnisa lo shifcha achat o nechasim sherauy liknot mehen shifcha achat o shehayta lo shifcha achat o shehaya lo mamon kede liknot mimmennu shifcha achat enah metachenet velo ofa velo mechabbeset velo notenet teven lifne behemto. hichnisa lo shete shefachot o nechasim haruyin liknot mehen shete shefachot o shehayu lo shete shefachot o shehaya rauy liknot shete shefachot enah mevashshelet veenah menika et benah ella notenet oto lashshifcha lehenik:

Nimtzeu kol hammelachot shekkol ishsha osa otan levalah chamesh melachot. tova verochetzet panav yadav veraglav umozeget et hakkos umatztzaat et hammitta veomedet umeshammeshet befanav. vehammelachot shemmiktzat hannashim osot otan umiktzatan enan osot shesh melachot. metachenet umevashshelet veofa umechabbeset umenika venotenet teven lifne behemto:

Kol melachot shehaishsha osa levalah nidda ose levalah chutz mimmezigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta veharechatzat panav yadav veraglav gezera mishshum hirhur shemma yavo livol. lefichach matztzaat mittato keshehi nidda shello befanav umozeget et hakkos veenah notenet oto beyado kedarkah tamid ella mannachat oto al haaretz o al hakkeli o al hashshulchan vehu notlo:

Haishsha sheshshavra kelim beet sheasta melaachoteha betoch betah petura veen ze min haddin ella takkana sheim en atta omer ken en shalom betoch habbayit leolam ella nimtzet nizheret venimnaat merov hammelachot venimtzet ketata benehem:

Kol ishsha shettimmana millaasot melacha min hammelachot shehi chayyevet laasotan kofin otah veosa afillu beshot. taan hu sheenah osa vehi omeret sheenah nimnaat millaasot moshivin ishsha benehen o shechenim. vedavar ze kefi ma sheyyire haddayyan sheefshar baddavar:

Haishsha kol zeman shehi menika et benah pochatin lah mimmaase yadeha umosifin lah al mezonoteha yayin udevarim sheyyafin lechalav. pasku lah mezonot haruyot lah vahare hi mitavva leechol yoter o leechol maachalot acherot mippene choli hattaava sheyyesh lah bevitnah hare zo ochelet mishshellah kol ma shettirtze veen habbaal yachol leakkev velomar sheim tochal yoter midday o tochal maachalim raim yamut havvalad mippene shetztzaar gufah kodem:

Yalda teomim en kofin otah lehenik shenehem ella menika echad vesocher habbaal menika lashsheni. hare sheratzta haishsha lehenik ben chavertah im benah habbaal meakkev veeno mannicha ella lehenik beno bilvad:

Nadra shello lehenik et benah kofe otah umenikato ad sheyyihye ben 24 chodesh echad hazzachar veechad hannekeva. hi omeret ani enik et beni vehu eno rotze shettenik ishto kede shello titnavvel af al pi sheyyesh lah kamma shefachot shomin lah shetztzaar hu lah lifrosh mibbenah:

Hayta aniyya shehi chayyevet lehenik et benah vahare hu ashir sherauy lo shello tenik ishto af al pi sheen lo shefachot im lo ratzta lehenik socher menika o kone shifcha mippene shehaishsha ola im balah veenah yoredet:
Hi omeret rauy hu liskor o liknot shifcha vehu omer eno rauy. aleha lehavi reaya veen kan makom lishvua:

Haishsha shennitgarsha en kofin otah lehenik. ella im ratzta noten lah secharah umenikato. veim lo ratzta notenet lo et beno vehu metappel bo. bamme devarim amurim shello henika oto ad shehikkirah. aval im hikkirah vaafillu hu suma en mafrishin oto meimmo mippene sakkanat havvalad. ella kofin otah umenika oto besachar ad 24 chodesh:

Haggerusha en lah mezonot af al pi shehi menika et benah aval noten lah yoter al secharah devarim shehakkatan tzarich lahen mikkesut umaachol umashke vesicha vechayyotze baze. aval hameebberet en lah kelum. shalmu chodashav ugemalattu im ratzta hamegoreshet sheyyihye benah etzlah en mafrishin oto mimmenna ad sheyyihye ben shesh shanim gemurot. ella kofin et aviv venoten lo mezonot vehu etzel immo. veachar shesh shanim yesh laav lomar im hu etzli etten lo mezonot veim hu etzel immo lo etten lo mezonot. vehabbat etzel immah leolam vaafillu leachar shesh:

Ketzad. haya haav rauy litzdaka motziin mimmennu harauy lo beal karcho vezanin otah vehi etzel immah vaafillu nisset haem leacher bittah etzlah veaviha zan otah mishshum tzedaka ad sheyyamut haav vetizzon minnechasav achar moto bitnae ketubba vehi etzel immah. veim lo ratzta haem sheyyihyu baneha etzlah achar sheggemalatan echad zecharim veechad nekevot harshut beyadah venotenet otan laavihen o mashlechet otan lakkahal im en lahen av vehen metappelin bahen:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 22: Habbaal kodem lechol adam birushshat ishto. umeematay yizke birushshatah mishshettetze mershut haav. veaf al pi sheadayin lo nichnesa lachuppa hoil venaaset birshut balah yirashenna:

Ketzad. haishsha shennitarsa umesarah aviha levalah o lishluche balah. o mesaruha sheluche haav levalah o lishluchav umeta badderech kodem shettikkanes lachuppa af al pi shekketubbatah adayin bevet aviha balah yorshah. vechen im halach haav o sheluche haav im habbaal venichnas immah balah badderech lechatzer venityached immah sham leshem nissuin umeta hare ze yirashenna balah. aval im adayin haav im habbaal leholichah levet balah o shehalchu sheluche haav im sheluche habbaal o im habbaal afillu nichnas habbaal immah lechatzer lalun kederech shellanin ovre derachim befundak echad hoil vehaav o sheluchav immah vaadayin lo nityached immah leshem nissuin im meta yirashenna aviha af al pi shekketubbatah bevet balah:
Vechen im hayta bogeret o yetoma o almana vehalcha hi beatzmah mibbet aviha levet balah veen immah lo balah velo sheluchav umeta badderech en habbaal yoresh otah:

Hannose ishsha shehi asura lo hoil veyesh lo bah kiddushin im meta tachtav yirashenna. vechen hannose et hakketanna af al pi sheen kiddusheha kiddushin gemurim im meta tachtav yirashenna. aval happikkeach shennasa chereshet im meta lo yirashenna. vehacheresh shennasa pikkachat umeta yirashenna shehare hi bat daat uledatah nisset vezikketa lo mamonah:

Ketanna shennitkaddesha ledaat aviha venisset shello ledaat aviha ben befanav ben shello befanav yachol haav limchot kemo shebbearnu. vaafillu shatak haav im meta en habbaal yorshah ella im ken ratza haav benissueha:

Horu haggeonim shehaishsha shechalta uvikkesha mibbalah sheyyegarshenna vetetze belo ketubba kede shello yirashenna en shomin lah. vaafillu amra ani sona oto veeni rotza laamod immo en shomin lah. veen danin otah kedin moredet. vedin yafe hu ze:

Kol nechasim sheyyesh laishsha ben nichse tzon barzel ben nichse melog habbaal ochel kol perotehen bechayyeha veim meta bechayye balah yoresh balah hakkol. lefichach im machra haishsha nichse melog achar shennisset af al pi sheotan hannechasim naflu lah kodem shettitares habbaal motzi happerot miyyad hallakochot kol yeme chayyeha. aval lo guf hakkarka sheen lo kelum beguf nichse melog ad shettamut. meta bechayyav motzi hagguf miyyad hallakochot belo damim. veim haddamim shellakcha miyyad hallakochot kayyamin beatzman machaziran lallakochot. veeno yachol lomar shemma metzia hen:

Bamme devarim amurim binchasim hayeduin labbaal aval im naflu lah nechasim bimdina acheret velo yada bahen habbaal umachra otan michrah kayyam. vechen arusa shemmachra kodem hannissuin michrah kayyam sheen labbaal benichse arusato kelum ad sheyyichnos:

Haishsha shekkatva kol nechaseha leacher ben karov ben rachok kodem shettinnase af al pi sheim nitgarsha o nitalmena tevuttal hammattana kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mattana en habbaal ochel perotehen. veim meta bechayyav eno yorshan. shehare natna otan kodem shettinnase. ucheshettamut bechayye balah yikne mekabbel hammattana mattenato kinyan gamur. velo od ella afillu natna miktzat nechaseha o kullam kodem nissueha vechatva lamkabbel kene mehayyom velichsheertze shehare lo kana kinyan gamur ad shettirtze en habbaal ochel perot otah hammattana veim meta eno yorshah:

Shomeret yavam yesh lah limkor velitten bemattana nechasim shennaflu lah keshehi shomeret yavam. veen layyavam perot afillu benichse tzon barzel shehichnisa leachiv ad sheyyichnos. meta keshehi shomeret yavam yorsheha meaviha yorshin benichse melog shellah vachatzi nichse tzon barzel veyorshe habbaal yorshim ketubbatah vachatzi nichse tzon barzel. veyorshe habbaal chayyavin bikvuratah:

Shomeret yavam ketubbatah al kol nichse balah. lefichach en hayyavam yachol limkor benichse achiv ben kodem yibbum ben achar yibbum. veim machar o natan mattana o chalak im echav benichse hammet ben kodem yibbum ben achar yibbum lo asa kelum shekkevar nitchayyevu nechasim ellu laalmana ligbot mehen ketubbatah:
Kanas et yevimto vehinniach achiv perot mechubbarin lakkarka yimmachru veyillakach bahen karka vehayyavam ochel perotehen:

Hinniach perot telushin min hakkarka vechen im hinniach maot umittaltelin hakkol shel yavam. umishtammesh bahen kemo sheyyirtze veenah yechola leakkev. shehammittaltelin en hakketubba nigbet mehen ella betakkanat haggeonim veen koach betakkana zo lemano minnichse echav uleasran alav beacharayut zo shello yissa veyitten bahem:

Yevama shello hayta lah ketubba o shemmachala ketubbatah zacha benichse achiv umocher venoten kecheftzo. uchesheyyichnos et yevimto yichtov lah ketubba mea veyihyu kol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah kishar kol hannashim sheyyesh lahen ketubba:

Haishsha shemmachra o shennatna achar shennisset benichse tzon barzel ben levalah ben laacherim lo asta kelum. vechen baal shemmachar karka benichse ishto ben nichse tzon barzel ben nichse melog lo asa kelum:

Machar mittaltelin shel nichse tzon barzel af al pi sheeno rashshay im machar mimikkaro mimkar. machru shenehem benichse melog ben shellakach min haish techilla vechazar velakach min haishsha ben shellakach min haishsha vechazar velakach min haish michran kayyam:
Vechen haishsha shemmachra o natna nichse melog levalah mimkarah umattenatah kayyamin veenah yechola lomar benichse melog nachat ruach asiti levali. aval bishar nechasim yesh lah lomar:

Ketzad. haishsha shemmachra o natna levalah minnichse tzon barzel ben karka ben mittaltelin o sade sheyyiched lah bichtubbatah o sade shekkatav lah bichtubbatah o sade shehichnis lah shum mishshello lo kana balah. veaf al pi shekkanu miyyad haishsha birtzonah chozeret bechol et shettirtze. shello natna velo machra ella mippene shelom betah. lefichach en labbaal reaya benichse ishto kelal chutz minnichse melog kemo shebbearnu:

Nichse tzon barzel sheavdu o shennignevu umachala haishsha otam levaalah vekanu mimmenna beedim yerae li sheenah yechola lomar nachat ruach asiti levali. ha lema ze dome lemi shekkanu miyadah sheen lah acharayut shehechezira nechasim ellu nichse melog. shehare en habbaal mevi reaya littol kelum velo lehachazik bannechasim ella lehippater mitteviatah milleshallem. aval im natna lo mattana mittaltele tzon barzel hakkayyamin lo kana mippene sheyyesh lah lomar nachat ruach asiti levali:
Baal shemmachar karka leferot lo asa kelum. mippene shello hitkinu perot laish ella kede lehareviach behotzaat habbayit. lefichach im machar leferot velakach otan hammaot lischora shomin lo:

Hayu laishsha kesafim. im nichse tzon barzel hen hare ze nose venoten bahen. veim nichse melog hen ben shehichnisa otan lo ben shennaflu lah birushsha o nittenu lah bemattana o naflu lah mittaltelin o nittenu lah hare ellu yimmachru veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perotehen:
Vechen haishsha shechavlu bah acherim kol hammaot haruyot latet lah yillakach bahen karka vehabbaal ochel perotehen kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot chovel:

Naflu lah avadim af al pi shehen zekenim lo yimmachru mippene shevach bet aviha. naflu lah zetim ugefanim velo haya lah beguf hakkarka shehailanot bah kelum. im osin kede tippulan lo yimmachru mippene shevach bet aviha veim lav hare ellu yimmachru leetzim veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot:

Naflu lah perot mechubbarin lakkarka hare ellu shel baal. telushin min hakkarka shellah veyimmachru veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. aval hamegaresh et ishto vehayu lah perot mechubbarin lakkarka bishat gerushin hare ellu shellah. veim hayu telushin hare ellu shello:

Avde nichse melog uvehemat nichse melog habbaal chayyav bimzonot shellahen uvechol tzarchehem vehen osin lo vehu ochel perotehem. lefichach velad shifchat melog labbaal. velad behemat melog labbaal. veim gershah veratzta haishsha litten damim velittol velad hashshifcha mippene shevach bet aviha shomin lah:

Hichnisa lo shene kelim o shete shefachot betorat nichse tzon barzel veshamu otan alav beelef zuz vehukeru veamdu bealpayim vegershah notelet echad beelef shellah. vehashsheni im ratzta shettitten damav vetittol mishshum shevach bet aviha shomin lah:

Hannoten mattana leishto ben shennatan lah karka ben shennatan lah maot velakcha bahen karka en labbaal perot bemattana zo. vechen hannoten mattana leishsha al menat shello yihye habbaal ochel peroteha ella yihyu peroteha laishsha lema shettirtze en habbaal ochel perot mattana zo. vechen hammocheret ketubbatah betovat hanaa otan haddamim laishsha veen habbaal ochel perotehen:

Velad behemat melog shennignav venimtza haggannav veshillem shenayim hakkefel laishsha sheen ze peri shettikkenu lo chachamim. hachovel beishto kol hannezek vehatztzaar vehabboshet shellah veen habbaal ochel perot kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot chovel:

Hammocher karka leishto. im hayu hammaot shellakcha bahen et hakkarka mibbaal geluyin viduin labbaal kanta vehabbaal ochel perot otah hakkarka. veim hayu maot temunin lo kanta shehabbaal omer lo macharti ella kede lehareot hammaot shettamna. veotan hammaot shenniru yillakach bahen karka vehabbaal ochel perot:

Hare shennimtzeu maot o mittaltelin beyad haishsha hi omeret bemattana nittenu li vehu omer mimmaase yadayich hem shehem shelli hare zo neemenet. veyesh lo lehacharim al mi shettoenet davar sheeno chen. veyillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. veim amra al menat ken nittenu li al menat shello yihye levali reshut bahen ella eese bahen kol ma sheertze aleha lehavi reaya. shekkol mamon shennimtza beyad haishsha bechezkat habbaal hu sheyyochal perotav ad shettavi reaya:
Amra lo atta natatta li bemattana nishbaat shevuat hesset shennatan lah habbaal veeno ochel perotehen:

En mekabbelin pikdonot lo min hannashim velo min haavadim velo min hakketannim. veim avar vekibbel min haishsha yachazir laishsha. meta yachazir levalah. kibbel min haeved yachazir laeved veim met yachazir lerabbo. kibbel min hakkatan yikne lo bo sefer tora o davar sheochel perotehem. vechullam sheamru bishat mitatan pikkadon ze shel peloni hu im hayu bechezkat neemanin etzel ze shehappikkadon etzlo yaase kemo shetztziuu veim lav yitten leyorshehem:

Haishsha shehayu lah kesafim haruyot labbaal leechol perotehem hu omer kach vechach yillakach bahem vehi omeret eni lokachat bahen ella kach vechach lokchim davar shepperotav merubbim vitziato meuta. ben shehaya haddavar kirtzono o shehaya kirtzonah. veen lokchin ella davar sheggizo machalif shemma yochal hakkol venimtza hakkeren aved:

Haishsha shehichnisa levalah ez lachalavah verachel legizzatah vedekel leferotav af al pi sheen lah ella perot ellu bilvad hare ze ochel veholech ad shettichle hakkeren. vechen im hichnisa lo kele tashmish betorat nichse melog hare ze mishtammesh bahen velovesh umatztzia umechasse ad sheyyichle hakkeren. uchesheyyegaresh eno chayyav leshallem habbelaot shel nichse melog:

Horu haggeonim shennichse tzon barzel af al pi sheppechitatan al habbaal im hayu habbelaot kayyamin vehayu osin meen melachtan notelet keleha kema shehen. veim lo hayu osin meen melachtan hare hen kemo shennignevu o avdu shehu chayyav leshallem bidmehem sheshshamu otan alav bishat nissuin. uminhag pashut hu ze. vechol hannose al minhag ze kibbel alav acharayut hanneduneya. ucheshem sheeno meshallem happechat kach eno notel et hashshevach im hotiru demehen lefi minhag ze. yesh labbaal lachof miktzat avde ishto veammehoteha sheyyihyu meshammeshin oto bevet ishsha acheret shennasa ben shehayu avde melog ben shehayu avde tzon barzel. aval eno yachol leholichan leir acheret shello middaat ishto:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 23: Haisha shehitnet al balah levattel zechut middevarim shezzoche bahen habbaal im katav lah veodah arusa kodem hannissuin eno tzarich liknot miyyado. ella kol ma shekkatav lah kayyam. veim katav lah achar hannissuin tzarich liknot miyyado:

Hitna immah shello yihyu lo din udevarim binchaseha im machra venatna michrah umattenatah kayyam. aval ochel perotehen kol zeman shehen birshutah. veim kanu miyyado keshehi arusa sheen lo din udevarim binchaseha hare sillek atzmo migguf hakkarka veen lo binchaseha perot leolam. vaafillu irer al kinyano veamar lo ala bedati sheen li perot mippene kinyan ze ella sheim machra michrah kayyam sheen adam nose ishsha belo nechasim en shomin lo ella kevar sillek atzmo migguf hakkarka:
Hitna immah shello yochal perot nechaseha hare ze eno ochel perotehen aval mochrin et happerot velokchin bahen karka vehu ochel peroteha. shello sillek atzmo ella mipperot nechasim ellu bilvad:

Hitna immah shello yochal perot nechaseha velo pere perotehen lokchin happerot vekonin bahem karka velokchin perot karka zo vekonin bahem karka sheniyya vehu ochel perot ellu shehen pere pere perot. vechen haddavar tamid ad sheyyatne immah shello yihyu lo lo perot velo pere perotehen ad leolam. veachar kach lo yihyu lo perot bechayyeha aval im meta yirash hakkol:

Hitna immah shello yirashenna hare ze lo yirashenna aval ochel perot bechayyeha. vechen im hitna immah sheyyirash miktzat nechasim vechen im hitna immah sheim meta belo banim yachzeru nechasin levet aviha hakkol kayyam:

Bamme devarim amurim shehitna immah kodem shettinnase shehannachala habbaa lo laadam shello mimmishpachto matne aleha shello yirashenna kodem shettehe reuya lo. aval im hitna immah achar shennisset tenao batel veyirashenna kemo shebbearnu:
Hitna immah achar nissuin shello yihyu lo din udevarim binchaseha velo befere peroteha ad olam bechayyeha uvemotah hare ze eno ochel perot kelal. aval im meta yirashenna kemo shebbearnu:

Habbaal shehotzi hotzaot al nichse melog ben shehotzi meat veachal perot harebe ben shehotzi harebe veachal perot meat vaafillu achal gerogeret achat derech kavod o sheachal dinar echad afillu shello derech kavod vaafillu lo lakach bapperot mimma shehotzi ella chavila achat shel zemorot. ma shehotzi hotzi uma sheachal achal:

Vechen im naflu lah kesafim bemakom rachok vehotzi alehen hotzaot ad shehevian o ad shehotzian miyyad mi shehayu etzlo velakach bahen karka veachal peroteha kashshiur ma shehotzi hotzi uma sheachal achal. hotzi velo achal o sheachal pachot mikkashshiur shamin kamma shehishbichu veshoalin oto kamma hotzi. im hashshevach yeter al hahotzaa yishshava binkitat chefetz kamma hotzi venotel hahotzaa. veim hahotzaa yetera al hashshevach en lo min hahotzaa ella keshiur hashshevach uvishvua:

Bamme devarim amurim bimgaresh aval haishsha shemmarda al balah afillu achal harebe shamin lo kamma achal ufochet oto mimma sherauy litten lo min hahotzaa achar sheyyishshava venotlo. shello hikna lah kede shettittol vetetze meatzmah. vechen hammotzi hotzaot al nichse ishto ketanna umeana bo roin kamma achal vechamma hotzi vechamma hishbiach veshamin lo kearis shehare birshut yarad:

Minhagot rabbot yesh binduneya. yesh mekomot shennahagu sheyyichtevu bakketubbot hanneduneya yeter al dameha bishlish o bechomesh o bemechetza. kegon shettihye hanneduneya mea vechotvim shehichnisa mea vachamishshim kede leharebot bifne haam ucheshettavo ligbot lo tigbe ella hammea. veyesh mekomot shennahagu lichtov pachot. veim paska lehavi lo bemea kelim notenet sheve mea veesrim o mea vachamishshim vechotvin shehichnisa lo mea. veyesh mekomot shennahagu lichtov sheve mane bemane. veyesh mekomot shennahagu sheyyitten haish maot lefi hanneduneya davar katzuv shettitkashshet bo hakkalla vetikne bo besamim vechayyotze bahen. veyesh mekomot sheyyachnis haish shum mishshello laishsha veyitztaref lindunyatah lehitnaot bo:

Hannose setam kotev venoten keminhag hammedina. vechen hi sheppaska lehachenis notenet keminhag hammedina ucheshettavo ligbot ketubbatah magbin lah ma shebbichtubbatah keminhag hammedina. uvechol haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen minhag hammedina ikkar gadol hu veal piv danin vehu sheyyihye oto minhag pashut bechol hammedina:

Ish veishsha shehayu benehem shidduchin veamar lah kamma et machneset li kach vechach veamra lo vechamma atta noten li o kotev li kach vechach. vechen haav sheppasak al yede beno uvitto kamma atta noten levincha kach vechach vechamma atta noten levittecha kach vechach veamdu vekiddeshu kanu otan haddevarim veaf al pi shello haya benehen kinyan. veellu hen haddevarim hanniknim baamira:

Bamme devarim amurim besheppasak haav levitto ben ketanna uven gedola ufasak haav livno [2.] uvenissuin rishonim sheddato shel adam kerova etzel beno umerov simchato bannissuin harishonim gamar umakne lo baamira. aval ach sheppasak laachoto o ishsha sheppaska levittah vechen shear kerovim vechen haav sheppasak livno o levitto benissuin sheniyyim lo kanu otan haddevarim ad sheyyiknu mide happosek sheyyitten kach vechach:

Haav sheppasak al yad bitto lo kanta habbat otah hammattana ad sheyyichnos otah balah. vechen habben lo kana ad sheyyichnos. shekkol happosek eno posek ella al menat lichnos. lefichach happosek maot lachatano umet kodem sheyyichnos venafla lifne achiv leyibbum yachol haav lomar layyavam leachicha hayiti rotze litten ulecha eni rotze litten. vaafillu haya harishon am haaretz vehashsheni chacham. veaf al pi shehabbat rotza bo:

Happosek maot lachatano vehalach haav limdina acheret yechola hi lomar labbaal ani lo pasakti al atzmi ma ani yechola laasot o kenos belo neduneya o patreni beget. aval im paska hi al atzmah velo higgia yadah hare zo yoshevet ad shettimtza ma sheppaska o ad shettamut. velamma lo tiftor atzmah bemardut. shehammoredet vehi arusa habbaal rotze lechansah vehi enah rotza aval zo en habbaal rotze bah ad shettitten hanneduneya sheppaska vehi rotza bo shehare omeret lo o kenos o petor. bamme devarim amurim bigdola aval biktanna sheppaska al atzmah kofin oto litten get o yichnos belo neduneya:

Hannose ishsha ufaska immo sheyyihye zan et bittah kach vechach shanim chayyav lazun otam shanim shekkibbel al atzmo. vehu sheyyatnu al davar ze bishat hakkiddushin. aval shello bishat hakkiddushin ad sheyyiknu miyyado o ad sheyyichtov bishtar vechayyotze bo kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot mikkach umimkar. nitgarsha betoch hashshanim shekkibbel al atzmo lazun et bittah venisset leacher ufaska gam immo sheyyihye zan otah habbat kach vechach shanim lo yomar rishon im tavo leveti azunah ella molich mezonoteha lammakom shehi sham immah. vechen lo yomru shenehem hare anu zanin otah keachat ella echad zanah veechad noten lah deme mezonot:

Nisset habbat betoch zeman ze habbaal chayyav bimzonoteha. uvaale immah shenehem kol echad veechad noten lah deme mezonot. metu ellu sheppasku lazun otah im kanu miyyadan o shechiyyev atzmo bishtar hare zo kevaal chov bishtar vetorefet mezonoteha minnichsehen hameshubadim ad sof hazzeman sheppasku. veim pasku bishat hakkiddushin velo haya sham kinyan hare hem devarim shello nittenu likkatev veenah torefet bimzonoteha:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 24: Hannose et haaylonit velo hayu lo banim velo ishsha acheret lifrot velirbot mimmenna af al pi shekkofin oto umotzi hare hi kechol hannashim veyesh lah ketubba ushear tenae ketubba. vechen zoche habbaal bema shezzacha bishar hannashim:

Aval hannose ishsha velo hikkir bah venimtzet aylonit o mechayyave lavin. vechen hannose sheniyya ben hikkir bah ben lo hikkir bah. en lah ikkar ketubba velo tenay mittenae ketubba. aval tosefet yesh lah. veen lah mezonot vaafillu leachar moto. ucheshekkofin oto umafrishin benehem en motziin min habbaal perot sheachal:

Velamma en lahen ikkar veyesh lahen tosefet. haikkar shehu takkanat chachamim kede shello tihye kalla beenav lehotziah hoil velo hikkir bah en lah ikkar. aval tosefet shehu chiyyev atzmo bah kol zeman shettirtze vetaamod lefanav hare amda battenay shellah vahare hiknet lo hanaatah vahare hi omedet [lefanav] aval hattora asra otah alav uma hi yechola laasot. lefichach yesh lah tosefet sheen maaseha hen haggormin lah leheaser achar hannissuin ella asura hayta mikkodem:

Velamma lo chilleku bashsheniyya ben shehikkir bah ben shello hikkir bah ella amru en lah ikkar ketubba bechol makom. mippene shehi middivre sofrim asu bah chizzuk. aval im nasa achat mechayyave lavin; vehikkir bah. o achat mechayyave ase ben hikkir bah ben shello hikkir bah yesh lah ketubba. shechayyave lavin shehikkir bah ratza lazun binchasav vechayyave ase issuran kal. veyesh lishtehen mezonot leachar moto. vechen im lavta veachla chayyav leshallem. ucheshekkofin otan lehotzi motziin min habbaal kol perot sheachal mikkol nechaseha:
Hamemaenet en lah ketubba aval tosefet yesh lah. veen motziin min habbaal perot sheachal. veim lavta keshehayta tachtav veachla veachar kach meana en motziin otan mezonot min habbaal:
Mi shezzinneta tachat balah en lah ketubba lo ikkar velo tosefet velo echad mittenae ketubba shehare maaseha garmu lah leheaser al balah:

Veheach din nashim ellu binduneya shellahem. kol ishsha shennedunyatah kayyemet afillu zinneta notelet shellah veholechet. veim hayta sheniyya o echad mechayyave ase ben hikkir bah ben shello hikkir bah o shehayta aylonit o mechayyave lavin vehikkir bah hare hi bindunyatah kechol hannashim:

Nichse tzon barzel chayyav beachrayutan. venichse melog ma shennignav o sheavad avad lah veeno chayyav leshallem. hayta aylonit o mechayyave lavin velo hikkir bah kol ma sheavad o nignav o bala o shennishchak minnichse tzon barzel en habbaal chayyav leshallem. shehare hi natna lo reshut lihyotan etzlo. vechol ma sheavad o nignav minnichse melog chayyav leshallem. hefech mikkol hannashim mippene sheen sham ishut gemura lo zacha benichse melog:
Vehamemaenet en lah belayot kelal sheen motziin min habbaal davar mimma sheavad o nignav minnechaseha ben minnichse melog ben minnichse tzon barzel ella notelet hannimtza lah veyotza:

Mi shezzinneta tachat balah en lah ketubba lo ikkar velo tosefet. veen motziin mehabbaal davar mimma sheavad o nignav minnichse tzon barzel shellah. veen tzarich lomar nichse melog. velo hamezanna bilvad ella af haoveret al dat moshe o al dat yehudit o hayyotzet mishshum shem ra en lah ketubba lo ikkar velo tosefet velo tenay mittenae ketubba. vechol achat mehen notelet hannimtza lah minnedunyatah veyotza veen habbaal chayyav leshallem kelum lo ma sheppichet velo ma sheavad:

Veellu hen haddevarim sheim asta achat mehen avra al dat moshe. yotza bashshuk usear roshah galuy. o shennoderet o shennishbaat veenah mekayyemet. o sheshshimmesha mittatah vehi nidda. o sheenah kotza lah challa. o sheheechila et balah devarim asurim, en tzarich lomar shekatzim uremasim unevelot, ella devarim sheenan meussarin. veheach yodea davar ze kegon sheamra lo perot ellu peloni kohen tikkenam li veissa zo pelonit hifrisha li challatah ufeloni hechacham tiher li et hakketem veachar sheachal o ba aleha shaal oto peloni veamar lo hayu devarim meolam. vechen im huchzeka nidda bishchenoteha veamra levalah tehora ani uva aleha:

Vee zo hi dat yehudit hu minhag hatztzeniut shennahagu benot yisrael. veellu hen haddevarim sheim asta achat mehen avra al dat yehudit. yotza lashshuk o lemavoy mefullash veroshah parua veen aleha redid kechol hannashim. af al pi shessearah mechusse bemitpachat. o shehayta tova bashshuk uvered vechayyotze bo keneged paneha al paddachtah o al lechayeha kederech sheosot haakkum happerutzot. o shettova bashshuk umaret zerooteha livne adam. o shehayta mesacheket im habbachurim. o shehayta tovaat hattashmish bekol ram mibbalah ad sheshshechenoteha shomot otah medabberet al iske tashmish. o shehayta mekallelet avi balah bifne balah:

Ezra tikken shettihye ishsha chogeret besinnar tamid betoch betah mishshum tzeniut. veim lo chagra enah overet al dat moshe velo hifsida ketubbatah. vechen im yatzta beroshah parua mechatzer lechatzer betoch hammavoy hoil usearah mechusse bemitpachat enah overet al dat:

Haoveret al dat tzericha hateraa veedim veachar kach tafsid ketubbatah. avra beno levenah veyada shehi overet al dat vehitra bah belo edim vechazra veavra hu toen veomer achar hateraa avra vehi omeret lo avarti kelal o lo hitra bi. im ratza lehotzi hare ze noten ketubba achar shettishshava shello avra. sheim tode sheavra achar hateraa zo en lah kelum:

Ketzad hi yotza mishshum shem ra. kegon shehayu sham edim sheasta davar mechoar beyoter shehaddevarim marin shehayta sham avera af al pi sheen sham edut berura biznut. ketzad. kegon shehayta bechatzer levaddah verau rochel yotze venichnesu miyyad bishat yetziato umatzu otah omedet meal hammitta vehi loveshet hammichnasayim o chogeret azorah. o shemmatzu rok lach lemala min hakkila. o shehayu yotzim mimmakom afel. o maalin ze et ze min habbor vechayyotze bo. o sherauhu menashshek al pi chalukah o sherau otan menashshekin ze et ze o megappefin ze et ze o shennichnesu ze achar ze vehegifu delatot vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. im ratza habbaal lehotziah tetze belo ketubba. veen zo tzericha hateraa:

Overet al dat moshe o al dat yehudit vechen zot sheasta davar mechoar en kofin et habbaal lehotzi ella im ratza lo yotzi. veaf al pi shello hotzi en lahen ketubba shehakketubba takkanat chachamim hi kede shello tehe kalla beenav lehotziah. velo hikpidu ella al benot yisrael hatztzenuot aval ellu happerutzot en lahen takkana [zo] ella tehe kalla beenav lehotziah:

Mi sheraa ishto shezzinneta o sheamra lo achat mikkerovotav o mikkerovoteha shehu maaminam vesomechet dato alehem shezzinneta ishto. ben shehaya haomer ish ben shehayta ishsha hoil vesamcha dato ledavar ze shehu emet hare ze chayyav lehotzi veasur lo lavo aleha veyitten ketubba. veim hodet lo shezzinneta tetze belo ketubba. lefichach mashbiah binkitat chefetz shello zinneta tachtav im raa otah beatzmo veachar kach tigbe ketubbatah. aval bidvar acher eno yachol lehashebiah ella al yede gilgul:

Amra lo ishto shezzinneta tachtav birtzonah en mashgichin lidvareha shemma eneha natna beacher. aval ibbeda ketubbatah ikkar vetosefet veibbeda habbelaot shehare hodet biznut. veim haya maaminah vesomech dato al devareha hare ze chayyav lehotziah. veen bet din kofin et haish legaresh et ishto bedavar middevarim ellu ad sheyyavou shene edim veyaidu shezzinneta ishto zot bifnehem birtzonah veachar kach kofin oto lehotzi:

Haishsha shezzinneta tachat balah bishgaga o beones hare zo mutteret levalah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 13)</small> "vehi lo nitpasa" ha nitpasa mutteret. ben sheanasah akkum ben sheanasah yisrael. vechol shettechillat biatah beones af al pi shessofah beratzon vaafillu amra hanichu lo sheilmale lo anas oti hayiti socharto hare zo mutteret. shehayyetzer levashah umittechilla [hayta] beones:

Nashim shegganvu otan listim hare hen kishvuyyot shehen anusot umuttarot levalehen. veim henichum vehalchu lallistim meatzman hare ellu beratzon vaasurot levalehen. vedin hashshogeget vedin hanneeneset echad hu shehashshegaga tzad ones yesh bah:
Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya balah yisrael. aval eshet kohen sheshshagga o shenneensa asura levalah shehare naaset zona mikkol makom vehu asur bezona kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot issure bia:
Echad eshet yisrael o eshet kohen shenneensa ketubbatah kayyemet haikkar vehattosefet velo hifsida mikketubbatah kelum. vechofin et hakkohen litten lah ketubbatah ulegarshah:

Eshet kohen sheamra levalah neenasti o shagagti venivalti leacher eno choshesh lidvareha shemma eneha natna beacher. veim hayta neemenet lo o sheamar lo adam shehu somech al devarav yotzi veyitten ketubba:

Haomer leishto bifne shenayim al tissatri im ish peloni venichnesa immo leseter bifne shene edim veshahata kede tuma hare zo asura al balah ad sheyyashkenna me hammarim kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot sota. veim met kodem sheyyashkenna en lah ketubba. veaf al pi shello matzu davar mechoar. sheen lecha davar yoter mechoar mizze. vehayyom sheen sham me sota neesra alav issur olam vetetze belo ketubba lo ikkar velo tosefet shehare maaseha haraim garmu lah leheaser:

Amar lah beno levenah al tissatri im ish peloni veraa otah shennistera immo veshahata kede tuma hare zo asura alav bazzeman hazze sheen sham me sota. vechayyav lehotzi veyitten ketubba. veim hodet shennistera achar shehitra bah tetze belo ketubba ulefichach mashbiah al ze veachar kach yitten ketubba:
